Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Configure SCell according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for all downlink physical channels. The SS shall configure SCell (Cell 2) on the SCC as per TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.4 with UL CA. The SS activates SCC by sending the activation MAC-CE (Refer TS 36.321 , clauses 5.13, 6.1.3.8). Wait for at least 2 seconds (Refer TS 36.133 , clauses 8.3.3.2). Set the parameters according to T1 in Tables 7.2.4.5-1 and 7.2.4.5-2. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1.1. SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. SS shall transmit one message with a Timing Advance Command MAC Control Element for sTAG, T . The timing advance command, T , shall be set to 31 which indicate zero adjustment of the current N value for sTAG. The timing advance adjustment during T1 shall be N = 0. The UE shall transmit SRS and adjust its uplink timing at the beginning of sub-frame n+6 for a timing advance command T received in sub-frame n. Sub-frame n is the sub-frame where the UE received the time advance command. When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the timing advance command (T ) from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 7.2.4.5-1. SS shall transmit a sequence of messages with Timing Advance Command MAC Control Element for sTAG, T . The timing advance command, T , shall be set to 39 which indicate adjustment of the current N value for sTAG. The timing advance adjustment during T2 shall be N = 128. The UE shall transmit SRS and adjust its uplink timing at the beginning of sub-frame n+6 for a timing advance command T received in sub-frame n. Sub-frame n is the sub-frame where the UE received the time advance command. The result from the SRS and adjustment of the timing advance in step 12) is used to measure that the UE adjusts the timing of its transmission with a relative accuracy better than or equal to $ $ 4.0 $ $ T +TT to the signalled timing advance value compared to the timing of preceding uplink transmission. If the UE adjust the timing of its transmission within a relative accuracy greater than or equal to $ $ 4.5 $ $ T to the signalled timing advance value compared to the timing of preceding uplink transmission then the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of failure tests is increased by one. The SS shall transmit RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources. After the RRC connection release, the SS: []- transmits in Cell 1 a Paging message (including PagingRecord with ue-Identity) for the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.5.3A (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3), []or []- switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. 17. Repeat step 2-16 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > E-UTRAN FDD - UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for SCell in sTAG > Test description > Message contents
Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.6 with the following exceptions: 7.2.4.5 Test requirement Tables 7.2.4.4.1-1, 7.2.4.5-1 and 7.2.4.5-2 define the primary level settings for E-UTRAN FDD - UE timing advance adjustment accuracy test for SCell in sTAG. The UE shall apply the signalled Timing Advance value to the transmission timing at the designated activation time i.e. 6 sub-frames after the reception of the timing advance command. The UE shall adjust the timing of its transmission with a relative accuracy better than or equal to $ $4.5 $ $ T seconds to the signalled timing advance value compared to the timing of preceding uplink transmission. This requirement includes test tolerances. For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests shall be more than 90\% of the cases with a confidence level of 95\%.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > E-UTRAN TDD - UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for SCell in sTAG > Test purpose
Content: To verify the UE in RRC_CONNECTED state adjusts the timing of its transmissions with accuracy by meeting the E-UTRAN TDD timing advance adjustment accuracy requirements in an AWGN model.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > E-UTRAN TDD - UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for SCell in sTAG > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA TDD UE release 11 and forward that supports Uplink Carrier Aggregation and multiple timing advances.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > E-UTRAN TDD - UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for SCell in sTAG > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: The timing advance is initiated from E-UTRAN with MAC message that implies and adjustment of the timing advance according to 3GPP TS 36.321 clause 5.2. The UE shall adjust the timing of its uplink transmission timing at sub-frame n+6 for a timing advancement command received in sub-frame n. The UE shall adjust the timing of its transmission with a relative accuracy better than or equal to $ $4 $ $T seconds to the signalled timing advance value compared to the timing of preceding uplink transmission. The timing advance command is expressed in multiple of 16 $ $ T and is relative to the current uplink timing. In case of random access response, 11-bit timing advance command, T , for a TAG indicates N values by index values of T = 0, 1, 2,..., 1282, where an amount of the time alignment for the TAG is given by N = T $ $ 16 according to 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 4.2.3. N is defined in 3GPP TS 36.211 . In other cases, 6-bit timing advance command, T , for a TAG indicates adjustment of the current N value, N , to the new N value, N , by index values of T = 0, 1, 2,..., 63, where N = N + (T - 31) $ $ 16 according to 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 4.2.3. Adjustment of N value by a positive or a negative amount indicates advancing or delaying the uplink transmission timing for the TAG by a given amount respectively. For UE timers, the UE shall comply with the timer accuracies according to 3GPP TS 36.133 table 7.2.2-1. The requirements are only related to the actual timing measurements internally in the UE. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.3 and A.7.2.5.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > E-UTRAN TDD - UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for SCell in sTAG > Test description > Initial conditions
Content: Test Environment: Normal, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and 3GPP TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: 10 MHz for both PCell and SCell as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1. Connect the SS (node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A, Figure A.45. The general test parameter settings are set according to Table 7.2.5.4.1-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.0. Two Cells are used. Cell 1 is PCell on the primary component carrier, Cell 2 is SCell on the secondary component carrier. PCell is in the Primary Timing Advance Group (pTAG) and SCell is in the secondary Timing Advance Group (sTAG). Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power levels set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test. Cell 2 shall be powered OFF.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > E-UTRAN TDD - UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for SCell in sTAG > Test description > Test procedure
Content: The test consists of two cells. The test consists of two successive time periods, with time durations of T1 and T2 respectively. In each time period, timing advance commands for sTAG are sent to the UE and SRS are sent from the UE and received by the SS. By measuring the reception of the SRS, the transmit timing, and hence the timing advance adjustment accuracy, can be measured for SCell in sTAG. The UE Time Alignment Timer (timeAlignmentTimer IE), defined in 3GPP TS 36.321 clause 5.2, shall be configured so that it does not expire in the duration of the test. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Configure SCell according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for all downlink physical channels. The SS shall configure SCell (Cell 2) on the SCC as per TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.4 with UL CA. The SS activates SCC by sending the activation MAC-CE (Refer TS 36.321 , clauses 5.13, 6.1.3.8). Wait for at least 2 seconds (Refer TS 36.133 , clauses 8.3.3.2). Set the parameters according to T1 in Tables 7.2.5.5-1 and 7.2.5.5-2. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1.1. SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. SS shall transmit one message with a Timing Advance Command MAC Control Element for sTAG, T . The timing advance command, T , shall be set to 31 which indicate zero adjustment of the current N value for sTAG. The timing advance adjustment during T1 shall be N = 0. The UE shall transmit SRS and adjust its uplink timing at the beginning of sub-frame n+6 for a timing advance command T received in sub-frame n. Sub-frame n is the sub-frame where the UE received the time advance command. When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the timing advance command (T ) from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 7.2.5.5-1. SS shall transmit a sequence of messages with Timing Advance Command MAC Control Element for sTAG, T . The timing advance command, T , shall be set to 39 which indicate adjustment of the current N value for sTAG. The timing advance adjustment during T2 shall be N = 128. The UE shall transmit SRS and adjust its uplink timing at the beginning of sub-frame n+6 for a timing advance command T received in sub-frame n. Sub-frame n is the sub-frame where the UE received the time advance command. The result from the SRS and adjustment of the timing advance in step 12) is used to measure that the UE adjusts the timing of its transmission with a relative accuracy better than or equal to $ $ 4.5 $ $ T to the signalled timing advance value compared to the timing of preceding uplink transmission. If the UE adjust the timing of its transmission within a relative accuracy greater than or equal to $ $ 4.5 $ $ T to the signalled timing advance value compared to the timing of preceding uplink transmission then the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of failure tests is increased by one. The SS shall transmit RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources. After the RRC connection release, the SS: []- transmits in Cell 1 a Paging message (including PagingRecord with ue-Identity) for the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.5.3A (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3), []or []- switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. 17. Repeat step 2-16 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > HD-FDD UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for Category NB1 UE in Standalone Mode under Enhance Coverage > Test Purpose
Content: The purpose of the test is to verify E-UTRAN Timing Advance adjustment accuracy requirements for category NB1 UE in enhanced coverage in an AWGN model.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > HD-FDD UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for Category NB1 UE in Standalone Mode under Enhance Coverage > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of NB-IoT HD-FDD UE release 13 and forward of UE Category NB1 and higher.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > HD-FDD UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for Category NB1 UE in Standalone Mode under Enhance Coverage > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: The timing advance is initiated from E-UTRAN with MAC message that implies and adjustment of the timing advance, see TS 36.321 clause 5.2. UE shall adjust the timing of its uplink transmission timing at sub-frame n+12 for a timing advance command received in sub-frame n. In case repetitions are used on the downlink, sub-frame n refers to the last subframe in the repetition period in which the message containing the MAC control information was received. The UE shall not apply a TA command during an uplink repetition period. The UE shall adjust the timing of its transmissions with a relative accuracy better than or equal to $ $13.33* T seconds to the signalled timing advance value compared to the timing of preceding uplink transmission. The timing advance command is expressed in multiples of 16* T and is relative to the current uplink timing. In case of random access response, 11-bit timing advance command, T , indicates N values by index values of T = 0, 1, 2,..., 1282, where an amount of the time alignment is given by N = T $ $ 16 according to 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 16.1.2. N is defined in 3GPP TS 36.211 . In other cases, 6-bit timing advance command, T , indicates adjustment of the current N value, N , to the new N value, N , by index values of T = 0, 1, 2,..., 63, where N = N + (T - 31) $ $ 16 according to 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 16.1.2. Adjustment of N value by a positive or a negative amount indicates advancing or delaying the uplink transmission timing by a given amount respectively. For UE timers, the UE shall comply with the timer accuracies according to 3GPP TS 36.133 table 7.21.2-1. The requirements are only related to the actual timing measurements internally in the UE. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.22 and A.7.2.9.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > HD-FDD UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for Category NB1 UE in Standalone Mode under Enhance Coverage > Test description > Initial conditions
Content: Test Environment: Normal, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 8.1.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table Annex E-4 and 3GPP TS 36.508 clauses 8.1.3 and 8.1.4.2. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: 200 KHz. Connect the SS (node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A, Figure A.18 using only main UE Tx/Rx antenna. The general test parameter settings are set according to Table 7.2.9.4.1-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.0. There is one cell specified in the test. Ncell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > HD-FDD UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for Category NB1 UE in Standalone Mode under Enhance Coverage > Test description > Test procedure
Content: The test consists of a single cell. The test consists of two successive time periods, with time duration of T1 and T2 respectively. In each time period, timing advance commands are sent to the UE and the UE is scheduled in uplink subframes to transmit NPUSCH, which is received by the test equipment. By measuring the reception of the NPUSCH, the transmit timing, and hence the timing advance adjustment accuracy, can be measured. The UE Time Alignment Timer (timeAlignmentTimer IE), defined in 3GPP TS 36.321 clause 5.2, shall be configured so that it does not expire in the duration of the test. Ensure the UE is in State 2A-NB with CP CIoT Optimisation according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 8.1.5. Set the parameters according to T1 in Tables 7.2.9.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1.1. SS sends uplink scheduling information via NPDCCH DCI format N1 for C_RNTI to schedule uplink subframes according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 8.1.3.6, Table 8.1.3.6.1.2-2. SS shall transmit one message with a timing advance command, T . The timing advance command, T , shall be set to 31 which indicate adjustment of the current N value. The timing advance adjustment during T1 shall be N = 0. The UE shall transmit NPUSCH (NPUSCH Format 2 is used to carry ACK/NACK) and adjust its uplink timing at the beginning of sub-frame n+12 for a timing advance command T received in sub-frame n. Sub-frame n is the last subframe in the repetition period of NPDSCH in which the timing advance command is received by the UE. When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the timing advance command (T ) from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 7.2.9.5-1. SS shall transmit a sequence of messages with timing advance command, T . The timing advance command, T , shall be set to 39 which indicate adjustment of the current N value. The timing advance adjustment during T2 shall be N = 128. The UE shall transmit NPUSCH (NPUSCH Format 2 is used to carry ACK/NACK) and adjust its uplink timing at the beginning of sub-frame n+12 for a timing advance command T received in sub-frame n. Sub-frame n is the last subframe in the repetition period of NPDSCH in which the timing advance command is received by the UE. The result from the NPUSCH and adjustment of the timing advance in step 8) is used to measure that the UE adjusts the timing of its transmission with a relative accuracy better than or equal to $ $13.83 $ $ T to the signalled timing advance value compared to the timing of preceding uplink transmission. If the UE adjust the timing of its transmission within a relative accuracy greater than or equal to $ $ 13.83 $ $ T to the signalled timing advance value compared to the timing of preceding uplink transmission then the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of failure tests is increased by one. The SS shall transmit RRCConnectionRelease-NB message to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources. After the RRC connection release, the SS: - transmits in Ncell 1 a Paging message (including PagingRecord with ue-Identity) for the UE and ensures the UE is in State 2A-NB with CP CIoT Optimisation according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 8.1.5 (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 2A-NB with CP CIoT Optimisation according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 8.1.5), or - switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 2A-NB with CP CIoT Optimisation according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 8.1.5. Repeat step 2-12 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > HD-FDD UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for Category NB1 UE in Standalone Mode under Enhance Coverage > Test description > Message contents
Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 8.1.6 with the following exceptions.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > HD-FDD UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for Category NB1 UE in Standalone Mode under Enhance Coverage > Test requirement
Content: Tables 7.2.9.4.1-1, 7.2.9.5-1 and 7.2.9.5-2 define the primary level settings for HD-FDD UE timing advance adjustment accuracy test. The UE shall apply the signalled Timing Advance value to the transmission timing at subframe n+12, where subframe n is the last subframe in the repetition period of NPDSCH in which the timing advance command is received by the UE. The UE shall adjust the timing of its transmission with a relative accuracy better than or equal to $ $13.83 $ $ T seconds to the signalled timing advance value compared to the timing of preceding uplink transmission. This requirement includes test tolerances. For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests shall be more than 90\% of the cases with a confidence level of 95\%.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > E-UTRAN FDD UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for CE UE in CEModeB > Test purpose
Content: To verify the UE in RRC_CONNECTED state adjusts the timing of its transmissions with accuracy by meeting the E-UTRAN FDD timing advance adjustment accuracy requirements for CE UE in CEModeB in an AWGN model.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > E-UTRAN FDD UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for CE UE in CEModeB > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FD-FDD UE Release 13 and forward of UE category M1 and higher, including non-BL/CE UE. Applicability requires support CEModeB.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > E-UTRAN FDD UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for CE UE in CEModeB > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: The timing advance is initiated from E-UTRAN with MAC message that implies and adjustment of the timing advance according to 3GPP TS 36.321 clause 5.2. The UE shall adjust the timing of its uplink transmission timing at sub-frame n+6 for a timing advancement command received in sub-frame n. The UE shall adjust the timing of its transmission with a relative accuracy better than or equal to $ $4 $ $T seconds to the signalled timing advance value compared to the timing of preceding uplink transmission. The timing advance command is expressed in multiple of 16 $ $ T and is relative to the current uplink timing. In case of random access response, 11-bit timing advance command, T , for a cell indicates N values by index values of T = 0, 1, 2,..., 1282, where an amount of the time alignment for the cell is given by N = T $ $ 16 according to 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 4.2.3. N is defined in 3GPP TS 36.211 . In other cases, 6-bit timing advance command, T , indicates adjustment of the current N value, N , to the new N value, N , by index values of T = 0, 1, 2,..., 63, where N = N + (T - 31) $ $ 16 according to 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 4.2.3. Adjustment of N value by a positive or a negative amount indicates advancing or delaying the uplink transmission timing by a given amount respectively. For UE timers, the UE shall comply with the timer accuracies according to 3GPP TS 36.133 table 7.2.2-1. The requirements are only related to the actual timing measurements internally in the UE. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.3.2.2 and A.7.2.10.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > E-UTRAN FDD UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for CE UE in CEModeB > Test description > Initial conditions
Content: Test Environment: Normal, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and 3GPP TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: 10 MHz as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1. Connect the SS (node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A, Figure A.18 using only main UE Tx/Rx antenna. The general test parameter settings are set according to Table 7.2.10.4.1-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.0. There is one E-UTRA FDD carrier and one cell specified in the test. Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > E-UTRAN FDD UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for CE UE in CEModeB > Test description > Test procedure
Content: The test consists of a single cell. The test consists of two successive time periods, with time durations of T1 and T2 respectively. In each time period, timing advance commands are sent to the UE and PUSCH are sent from the UE and received by the SS. By measuring the reception of the PUSCH, the transmit timing, and hence the timing advance adjustment accuracy, can be measured. The UE Time Alignment Timer (timeAlignmentTimer IE), defined in 3GPP TS 36.321 clause 5.2, shall be configured so that it does not expire in the duration of the test. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF-CE with condition CEModeB according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3AA. Set the parameters according to T1 in Tables 7.2.10.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1.1. SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. SS shall transmit one message with a Timing Advance Command, T . The timing advance command, T , shall be set to 31 which indicate adjustment of the current N value. The timing advance adjustment during T1 shall be N = 0. The UE shall transmit PUSCH and adjust its uplink timing at the beginning of sub-frame n+6 for a timing advance command T received in sub-frame n. Sub-frame n is the sub-frame where the UE received the time advance command. When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the timing advance command (T ) from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 7.2.10.5-1. SS shall transmit a sequence of messages with Timing Advance Command, T . The timing advance command, T , shall be set to 39 which indicate adjustment of the current N value. The timing advance adjustment during T2 shall be N = 128. The UE shall transmit PUSCH and adjust its uplink timing at the beginning of sub-frame n+6 for a timing advance command T received in sub-frame n. Sub-frame n is the sub-frame where the UE received the time advance command. The result from the PUSCH and adjustment of the timing advance in step 9) is used to measure that the UE adjusts the timing of its transmission with a relative accuracy better than or equal to $ $4.5 $ $ T to the signalled timing advance value compared to the timing of preceding uplink transmission. If the UE adjust the timing of its transmission within a relative accuracy better than or equal to $ $4.5 $ $ T to the signalled timing advance value compared to the timing of preceding uplink transmission then the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of failure tests is increased by one. The SS shall transmit RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources. After the RRC connection release, the SS: transmits in Cell 1 a Paging message (including PagingRecord with ue-Identity) for the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-CE according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.5.3AB (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF-CE with condition CEModeB according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3AA), or switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF-CE with condition CEModeB according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3AA. Repeat step 2-13 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > E-UTRAN FDD UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for CE UE in CEModeB > Test requirement
Content: Tables 7.2.10.4.1-1, 7.2.10.5-1 define the primary level settings for E-UTRAN FDD Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for CE UE in CEModeB. The UE shall apply the signalled Timing Advance value to the transmission timing at the designated activation time i.e. 6 sub-frames after the reception of the timing advance command. The UE shall adjust the timing of its transmission with a relative accuracy better than or equal to $ $4.5 $ $ T seconds to the signalled timing advance value compared to the timing of preceding uplink transmission. This requirement includes test tolerances. For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests shall be more than 90\% of the cases with a confidence level of 95\%. When a repetition period is configured on the uplink, the UE shall not adjust the uplink transmission timing autonomously during an ongoing repetition period for which R 1.

Content: To verify the UE in RRC_CONNECTED state adjusts the timing of its transmissions with accuracy by meeting the E-UTRAN FDD timing advance adjustment requirements when ShortTTI-r15 is configured or ShortProcessingTime=TRUE in an AWGN model.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > E-UTRAN FDD - UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for sTTI and ShortProcessingTime > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 15 supporting sTTI or short processing time.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > E-UTRAN FDD - UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for sTTI and ShortProcessingTime > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: The timing advance is initiated from E-UTRAN with MAC message that implies and adjustment of the timing advance according to 3GPP TS 36.321 clause 5.2. When ShortTTI-r15 is not configured and ShortProcessingTime=TRUE, the UE adjusts its uplink timing at sub-frame n+5 for a timing advance command received in sub-frame n. When dl-STTI-Length-r15=slot, the UE adjusts its uplink timing at the first subframe boundary following n+8 slot for a timing advance command received in slot n. When dl-STTI-Length-r15=subslot and proc-Timeline-r15= nplus4set1, the UE adjusts its uplink timing at the first subframe boundary following n+16 subslot for a timing advance command received in subslot n. When dl-STTI-Length-r15=subslot and proc-Timeline-r15= nplus6set1 or proc-Timeline-r15= nplus6set2, the UE adjusts its uplink timing at the first subframe boundary following n+18 subslot for a timing advance command received in subslot n. This delay must be taken into account when measuring the timing advance adjustment accuracy, via the SRS sent from the UE. The UE shall adjust the timing of its transmission with a relative accuracy better than or equal to $ $4 $ $T seconds to the signalled timing advance value compared to the timing of preceding uplink transmission. The timing advance command is expressed in multiple of 16 $ $ T and is relative to the current uplink timing. In case of random access response, 11-bit timing advance command, T , indicates N values by index values of T = 0, 1, 2,..., 1282, where an amount of the time alignment is given by N = T $ $ 16 according to 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 4.2.3. N is defined in 3GPP TS 36.211 . In other cases, 6-bit timing advance command, T , indicates adjustment of the current N value, N , to the new N value, N , by index values of T = 0, 1, 2,..., 63, where N = N + (T - 31) $ $ 16 according to 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 4.2.3. Adjustment of N value by a positive or a negative amount indicates advancing or delaying the uplink transmission timing by a given amount respectively. For UE timers, the UE shall comply with the timer accuracies according to 3GPP TS 36.133 Table 7.2.2-1. The requirements are only related to the actual timing measurements internally in the UE. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.3 and A.7.2.13.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > E-UTRAN FDD - UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for sTTI and ShortProcessingTime > Test description > Initial conditions
Content: Test Environment: Normal, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and 3GPP TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: 10 MHz as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1. Connect the SS (node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A, Figure A.18 for UE with 2Rx RF band and Annex A, Figure A.75 (without using the faders) for 4Rx capable UE without any 2Rx RF bands. The general test parameter settings are set according to Table 7.2.13.4.1-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.0. There is one E-UTRA FDD carrier and one cell specified in the test. Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test. 7.2.13.4.2 Test procedure The test consists of a single cell. The test consists of 4 tests which apply to different UE capability in Table 7.2.13.4.2.1. Each test consists of two successive time periods, with time durations of T1 and T2 respectively. In each time period, timing advance commands are sent to the UE and SRS are sent from the UE and received by the SS. By measuring the reception of the SRS, the transmit timing, and hence the timing advance adjustment accuracy, can be measured. The UE Time Alignment Timer (timeAlignmentTimer IE), defined in 3GPP TS 36.321 clause 5.2, shall be configured so that it does not expire in the duration of the test. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Set the parameters according to T1 in Tables 7.2.13.5-1 and 7.2.13.5-2. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1.1. SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. SS shall transmit one message with a timing advance command, T . The timing advance command, T , shall be set to 31 which indicate adjustment of the current N value. The timing advance adjustment during T1 shall be N = 0. In test 1, the UE adjusts its uplink timing at sub-frame n+5 for a timing advance command received in sub-frame n. In test 2, the UE adjusts its uplink timing at the first subframe boundary following n+8 slot for a timing advance command received in slot n. In test 3, the UE adjusts its uplink timing at the first subframe boundary following n+16 subslot for a timing advance command received in subslot n. In test 4, the UE adjusts its uplink timing at the first subframe boundary following n+18 subslot for a timing advance command received in subslot n. When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the timing advance command (T ) from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 7.2.13.5-1. SS shall transmit a sequence of messages with timing advance command, T . The timing advance command, T , shall be set to 39 which indicate adjustment of the current N value. The timing advance adjustment during T2 shall be N = 128. In test 1, the UE adjusts its uplink timing at sub-frame n+5 for a timing advance command received in sub-frame n. In test 2, the UE adjusts its uplink timing at the first subframe boundary following n+8 slot for a timing advance command received in slot n. In test 3, the UE adjusts its uplink timing at the first subframe boundary following n+16 subslot for a timing advance command received in subslot n. In test 4, the UE adjusts its uplink timing at the first subframe boundary following n+18 subslot for a timing advance command received in subslot n. The result from the SRS and adjustment of the timing advance in step 9) is used to measure that the UE adjusts the timing of its transmission with a relative accuracy better than or equal to $ $ 4.5 $ $ T to the signalled timing advance value compared to the timing of preceding uplink transmission. If the UE adjust the timing of its transmission within a relative accuracy greater than or equal to $ $ 4.5 $ $ T to the signalled timing advance value compared to the timing of preceding uplink transmission then the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of failure tests is increased by one. The SS shall transmit RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources. After the RRC connection release, the SS: - transmits in Cell 1 a Paging message (including PagingRecord with ue-Identity) for the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.5.3A (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3), or - switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Repeat step 2-13 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.

Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.6 with the following exceptions: (test 1, test 2, test 3 and test 4) 7.2.13.5 Test requirement Tables 7.2.13.4.1-1, 7.2.13.5-1 and 7.2.13.5-2 define the primary level settings for E-UTRAN FDD - UE timing advance adjustment accuracy test for sTTI and ShortProcessingTime=TRUE. In test 1, the UE shall apply the signalled Timing Advance value to the transmission timing at the designated activation time i.e. 5 sub frames after the reception of the timing advance command in sub-frame n. In test 2, the UE shall apply the signalled Timing Advance value to the transmission timing at the designated activation time i.e. at the first subframe boundary following 8 slots after the reception of the timing advance command in slot n. In test 3, the UE shall apply the signalled Timing Advance value to the transmission timing at the designated activation time i.e. at the first subframe boundary following 16 subslots after the reception of the timing advance command in subslot n. Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > E-UTRAN TDD - UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for sTTI and ShortProcessingTime > Test purpose
Content: To verify the UE in RRC_CONNECTED state adjusts the timing of its transmissions with accuracy by meeting the E-UTRAN TDD timing advance adjustment requirements when ShortTTI-r15 is configured or ShortProcessingTime=TRUE in an AWGN model.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > E-UTRAN TDD - UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for sTTI and ShortProcessingTime > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA TDD UE release 15 supporting sTTI or short processing time.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > E-UTRAN TDD - UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for sTTI and ShortProcessingTime > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: The timing advance is initiated from E-UTRAN with MAC message that implies and adjustment of the timing advance according to 3GPP TS 36.321 clause 5.2. When ShortTTI-r15 is not configured and ShortProcessingTime=TRUE, the UE adjusts its uplink timing at sub-frame n+5 for a timing advance command received in sub-frame n. When dl-STTI-Length-r15=slot, the UE adjusts its uplink timing at the first subframe boundary following n+8 slot for a timing advance command received in slot n. The UE shall adjust the timing of its transmission with a relative accuracy better than or equal to $ $4 $ $T seconds to the signalled timing advance value compared to the timing of preceding uplink transmission. The timing advance command is expressed in multiple of 16 $ $ T and is relative to the current uplink timing. In case of random access response, 11-bit timing advance command, T , indicates N values by index values of T = 0, 1, 2,..., 1282, where an amount of the time alignment is given by N = T $ $ 16 according to 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 4.2.3. N is defined in 3GPP TS 36.211 . In other cases, 6-bit timing advance command, T , indicates adjustment of the current N value, N , to the new N value, N , by index values of T = 0, 1, 2,..., 63, where N = N + (T - 31) $ $ 16 according to 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 4.2.3. Adjustment of N value by a positive or a negative amount indicates advancing or delaying the uplink transmission timing by a given amount respectively. For UE timers, the UE shall comply with the timer accuracies according to 3GPP TS 36.133 table 7.2.2-1. The requirements are only related to the actual timing measurements internally in the UE. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.3 and A.7.2.14.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > UE Transmit Timing > E-UTRAN TDD - UE Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for sTTI and ShortProcessingTime > Test description > Initial conditions
Content: Test Environment: Normal, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and 3GPP TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1. There is one E-UTRA TDD carrier and one cell specified in the test. Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test. 7.2.14.4.2 Test procedure The test consists of 2 tests which apply to different UE capability in Table 7.2.14.4.2.1. Each test consists of two successive time periods, with time durations of T1 and T2 respectively. In each time period, timing advance commands are sent to the UE and SRS are sent from the UE and received by the SS. By measuring the reception of the SRS, the transmit timing, and hence the timing advance adjustment accuracy, can be measured. The UE Time Alignment Timer (timeAlignmentTimer IE), defined in 3GPP TS 36.321 clause 5.2, shall be configured so that it does not expire in the duration of the test. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Set the parameters according to T1 in Tables 7.2.14.5-1 and 7.2.14.5-2. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. SS shall transmit one message with a timing advance command, T . The timing advance command, T , shall be set to 31 which indicate adjustment of the current N value. The timing advance adjustment during T1 shall be N = 0. In test 1, the UE adjusts its uplink timing at sub-frame n+5 for a timing advance command received in sub-frame n. In test 2, the UE adjusts its uplink timing at the first subframe boundary following n+8 slot for a timing advance command received in slot n. When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the timing advance command (T ) from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 7.2.14.5-1. SS shall transmit a sequence of messages with timing advance command, T . The timing advance command, T , shall be set to 39 which indicate adjustment of the current N value. The timing advance adjustment during T2 shall be N = 128. In test 1, the UE adjusts its uplink timing at sub-frame n+5 for a timing advance command received in sub-frame n. In test 2, the UE adjusts its uplink timing at the first subframe boundary following n+8 slot for a timing advance command received in slot n. The result from the SRS and adjustment of the timing advance in step 9) is used to measure that the UE adjusts the timing of its transmission with a relative accuracy better than or equal to $ $ 4.5 $ $ T to the signalled timing advance value compared to the timing of preceding uplink transmission. If the UE adjust the timing of its transmission within a relative accuracy greater than or equal to $ $ 4.5 $ $ T to the signalled timing advance value compared to the timing of preceding uplink transmission then the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of failure tests is increased by one. The SS shall transmit RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources. After the RRC connection release, the SS: - transmits in Cell 1 a Paging message (including PagingRecord with ue-Identity) for the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.5.3A (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3), or - switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Repeat step 2-13 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync > Test purpose
Content: The purpose of this test is to verify that the UE properly detects the out of sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the serving cell. This test will partly verify the E-UTRAN FDD radio link monitoring requirements in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.6.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 8 and forward.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: When the downlink radio link quality estimated over the last 200 ms period becomes worse than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send an out-of-sync indication to the higher layers within 200 ms Q evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 clause 5.5.3.2. The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations shall be performed as specified in section 4.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.213 . Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least 10 ms. The transmitter power shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 section 5.3.11. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.6.2 and A.7.3.1.

Content: The test consists of four subtests with one cell configured; the difference between the subtests is the number of transmitter antennas and the propagation channel. Each subtest consists of three successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2 and T3 respectively. Figure 7.3.1.4-1 shows the three different time durations and the corresponding variation of the downlink SNR in the active cell to emulate out-of-sync states.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync > Test purpose
Content: The purpose of this test is to verify that the UE properly detects the out of sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the serving cell. This test will partly verify the E-UTRAN TDD radio link monitoring requirements in 3GPP TS 36.133 section 7.6.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA TDD UE release 8 and forward.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: When the downlink radio link quality estimated over the last 200 ms period becomes worse than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send an out-of-sync indication to the higher layers within 200 ms Q evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 clause 5.5.3.2. The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations shall be performed as specified in clause 4.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.213 . Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least 10 ms. The transmitter power shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 clause 5.3.11. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clauses 7.6.2 and A.7.3.3.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync > Test description
Content: The test consists of four subtests with one cell configured; the difference between the subtests is the number of transmitter antennas and the propagation channel. Each subtest consists of three successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2 and T3 respectively. Figure 7.3.3.4-1 shows the three different time durations and the corresponding variation of the downlink SNR in the active cell to emulate out-of-sync states.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 1 ms. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 7.3.3.5-1 for subtests 1 and 2 and according to T1 in Table and 7.3.3.5-2 for subtest 3 and 4. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1.1 for subtests 1 and 2 and according to B.2.2 for subtests 3 and 4. T1 starts. When T1 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T2 as specified in Table 7.3.3.5-1 for subtests 1 and 2 and according to T2 in Table 7.3.3.5-2 for subtests 3 and 4. T2 starts. When T2 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T3 as specified in Table 7.3.3.5-1 for subtests 1 and 2 and according to T3 in Table 7.3.3.5-2 for subtests 3 and 4. T3 starts. If the SS: [ a) ] detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm in each uplink subframe configured for CQI transmission (according CQI reporting mode PUCCH 1-0) during the period from time point A to time point B; and does not detect any uplink power higher than -48.5 dBm from time point C (240 ms after the start of T3) until T3 expires the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. When T3 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T1 as specified in Table 7.3.3.5-1 for subtests 1 and 2 and Table 7.3.3.5-2 for subtests 3 and 4. If the UE has not re-established the connection in at least 1s, the UE is switched off and then on. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Repeat steps 2-7 for all subtests until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: When DRX is used the Q evaluation period (T Q ) and the Q evaluation period (T Q ) is specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 Table 7.6.2.2-1 will be used. When the downlink radio link quality estimated over the last T Q period becomes worse than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send out-of-sync indication to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 clause 5.5.3.2. When the downlink radio link quality estimated over the last T Q period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send in-sync indications to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 clause 5.5.3.2. The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations shall be performed as specified in section 4.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.213 . Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least max(10 ms, DRX_cycle_length). Upon start of T310 timer as specified in section 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331, the UE shall monitor the link for recovery using the evaluation period and Layer 1 indication interval corresponding to the non-DRX mode until the expiry of T310 timer. The transmitter power shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 counter as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 section 5.3.11. Evaluation Period in DRX The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.6.2 and A.7.3.5.

In subtest 1 the UE shall stop transmitting uplink signal no later than time point C (duration D1 = 900 ms after the start of time duration T3). The uplink signal is verified on the basis of the UE output power: UE output power equal to or higher than Transmit minimum power -39 dBm (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.2.5) means uplink signal. UE output power equal to or less than Transmit OFF power -48.5 dBm (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.3.5) means no uplink signal. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\% with a confidence level of 95\%.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX > Test purpose
Content: The purpose of this test is to verify that the UE properly detects the in sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the serving cell when DRX is used. This test will partly verify the E-UTRAN FDD radio link monitoring requirements in 3GPP TS 36.133 section 7.6.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 8 and forward. Applicability requires support for FGI bit 5.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: When DRX is used the Q evaluation period (T Q ) and the Q evaluation period (T Q ) is specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 Table 7.6.2.2-1 will be used. When the downlink radio link quality estimated over the last T Q period becomes worse than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send out-of-sync indication to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 clause 5.5.3.2. When the downlink radio link quality estimated over the last T Q period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send in-sync indications to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 clause 5.5.3.2. The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations shall be performed as specified in section 4.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.213 . Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least max(10 ms, DRX_cycle_length). Upon start of T310 timer as specified in section 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331, the UE shall monitor the link for recovery using the evaluation period and Layer 1 indication interval corresponding to the non-DRX mode until the expiry of T310 timer. The transmitter power shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 counter as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 section 5.3.11. Evaluation Period in DRX The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.6.2 and A.7.3.6.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX > Test description
Content: The test consists of one subtest with one cell configured. The test consists of five successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2, T3, T4 and T5 respectively. Figure 7.3.6.4-1 shows the different time durations and the corresponding variation of the downlink SNR in the active cell to emulate in-sync states.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX > Test description > Initial conditions
Content: Test Environment: Normal, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1. The general test parameter settings for the test is set up according to Table 7.3.6.4-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 7.3.6.4.3 There is one cell specified in this test. Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 2 ms. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 7.3.6.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1.1. T1 starts. When T1 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T2 as specified in Table 7.3.6.5-1. T2 starts. When T2 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T3 as specified in Table 7.3.6.5-1. T3 starts. When T3 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T4 as specified in Table 7.3.6.5-1. T4 starts. When T4 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T5 as specified in Table 7.3.6.5-1. T5 starts. If the SS detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm in the On-duration part of every DRX cycle in the subframe according the configured CQI reporting mode (PUCCH 1-0) during the period from time point A to time point F (1120 ms after the start of time duration T5) the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. Repeat steps 2-7 for all subtests until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 1 ms. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 7.3.7.5-1 for subtest 1 and 2. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.2.2 for subtests 1 and according to B.1.1 for subtests 2. T1 starts. When T1 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T2 as specified in Table 7.3.7.5-1 for subtests 1 and 2. T2 starts. When T2 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T3 as specified in Table 7.3.7.5-1 for subtests 1 and 2. T3 starts. If the SS: a) detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm in the On-duration part of every DRX cycle in the uplink subframe according the configured CQI reporting mode (PUCCH 1-0) during the period from time point A to time point B; and [ a) ] For subtest 1: does not detect any uplink power higher than -48.5 dBm from time point C (900 ms after the start of T3) until T3 expires, For subtest 2: does not detect any uplink power higher than -48.5 dBm from time point C (6500 ms after the start of T3) until T3 expires, the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. When T3 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T1 as specified in Table 7.3.7.5-1 for subtests 1 and 2. If the UE has not re-established the connection in at least 1s, the UE is switched off and then on. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Repeat steps 2-7 for all subtests until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.

See Table 7.3.8.4.1-1 with the following changes: - Instead of antenna configuration 1x2 use 1x4. 7.3.8_1.4.2 Test procedure Same Test Procedure as in 7.3.8.4.2 with the following changes: - Instead of Table 7.3.8.5-1 use Table 7.3.8_1.5-1. 7.3.8_1.4.3 Message contents Same as 7.3.8.4.3. 7.3.8_1.5 Test requirement The UE behaviour in each test during time durations T1, T2, T3, T4 and T5 shall be as follows: During the period from time point A to time point F (1120 ms after the start of time duration T5) the UE shall transmit uplink signal at least once every DRX cycle, in the On-duration part of the cycle in the uplink subframe according to the configured CQI reporting mode (PUCCH 1-0). The uplink signal is verified on the basis of the UE output power: - UE output power equal to or higher than Transmit minimum power -39 dBm (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.2.5) means uplink signal The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\% with a confidence level of 95\%.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with Non MBSFN ABS (eICIC) > Test purpose
Content: To verify that the UE properly detects the out of sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the serving cell under time domain measurement resource restriction.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with Non MBSFN ABS (eICIC) > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 10 and forward. Applicability requires support for FGI bit 115.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with Non MBSFN ABS (eICIC) > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last 200 ms period becomes worse than the threshold Qout, Layer 1 of the UE shall send an out-of-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within 200 ms Qout evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 clause 5.5.3.2. The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the PCell shall be performed as specified in 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 4.2.1. Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least 10 ms. The transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 clause 5.3.11. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.6.2.1 and A.7.3.9.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with Non MBSFN ABS (eICIC) > Test description
Content: There are two E-UTRA cells in the test on the same RF channel. Cell 1 is the serving victim cell and Cell 2 is the neighbour aggressor cell. Non-MBSFN ABS pattern is configured in the aggressor cell (Cell 2). The UE is configured with a time domain measurement restriction pattern for performing serving cell (Cell 1) measurements. The UE is also configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode. The test consists of three successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2 and T3 respectively. Figure 7.3.9.4-1 shows the variation of the downlink SNR in the serving cell (Cell 1) to emulate out-of-sync states.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with Non MBSFN ABS (eICIC) > Test description > Initial conditions
Content: Test Environment: Normal, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E Table E-1 and TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: 10 MHz as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1. Connect the SS (node B emulator), AWGN noise sources and faders to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A Figure A.40 The general test parameter settings for the different subtests are set up according to Table 7.3.9.4.1-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 7.3.9.4.3 At this stage only Cell 1 is switched on. Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with Non MBSFN ABS (eICIC) > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to Cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 2 ms. Non-MBSFN ABS pattern is configured in the aggressor cell (Cell 2). The UE is configured by higher layers with a time domain measurement restriction pattern for performing serving cell (Cell 1) measurements. The patterns shall be configured prior to the start of T1. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF in Cell 1 according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Set the parameters for both Cell 1 and Cell 2 according to T1 in Table 7.3.9.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.2.2. T1 starts. When T1 expires the SS shall change the SNR values to T2 as specified in Table 7.3.9.5-1. T2 starts. When T2 expires the SS shall change the SNR values to T3 as specified in Table 7.3.9.5-1. T3 starts. If the SS: [ a) ] detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm in each subframe configured for CQI transmission (according CQI reporting mode PUCCH 1-0) during the period from time point A to time point B; and does not detect any uplink power higher than -48.5 dBm from time point C (240 ms after the start of T3) until T3 expires, the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. When T3 expires the SS shall change the SNR values to T1 as specified in Table 7.3.9.5-1. If the UE has not re-established the connection in at least 1s, the UE is switched off and then on. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF in Cell 1 according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Repeat steps 2-7 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with Non MBSFN ABS (eICIC) > Test description > Message contents
Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.6 with the following exceptions: 7.3.9.5 Test requirements The UE behaviour in each test during time durations T1, T2 and T3 shall be as follows: During the period from time point A to time point B the UE shall transmit uplink signal at least in all subframes configured for CQI transmission according to the configured CQI reporting mode (PUCCH 1-0). The UE shall stop transmitting uplink signal no later than time point C (240 ms after the start of time duration T3). The uplink signal is verified on the basis of the UE output power: UE output power equal to or higher than Transmit minimum power -39 dBm (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.2.5) means uplink signal UE output power equal to or less than Transmit OFF power -48.5 dBm (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.3.5) means no uplink signal. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\%.

The general test parameter settings for the different subtests are set up according to Table 7.3.13.4.1-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 7.3.13.4.3. At this stage only Cell 1 is switched on. Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with MBSFN ABS (eICIC) > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to Cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 2 ms. MBSFN ABS pattern is configured in the aggressor cell (Cell 2). The UE is configured by higher layers with a time domain measurement restriction pattern for performing serving cell (Cell 1) measurements. The patterns shall be configured prior to the start of T1. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF in Cell 1 according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Set the parameters for both Cell 1 and Cell 2 according to T1 in Table 7.3.13.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.2.2. T1 starts. When T1 expires the SS shall change the SNR values to T2 as specified in Table 7.3.13.5-1. T2 starts. When T2 expires the SS shall change the SNR values to T3 as specified in Table 7.3.13.5-1. T3 starts. If the SS: [ a) ] detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm in each subframe configured for CQI transmission (according CQI reporting mode PUCCH 1-0) during the period from time point A to time point B; and does not detect any uplink power higher than -48.5 dBm from time point C (240 ms after the start of T3) until T3 expires, the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. When T3 expires the SS shall change the SNR values to T1 as specified in Table 7.3.13.5-1. If the UE has not re-established the connection in at least 1s, the UE is switched off and then on. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF in Cell 1 according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Repeat steps 2-7 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with MBSFN ABS (eICIC) > Test description > Message contents
Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.6 with the following exceptions: 7.3.13.5 Test requirements The UE behaviour in each test during time durations T1, T2 and T3 shall be as follows: During the period from time point A to time point B the UE shall transmit uplink signal at least in all subframes configured for CQI transmission according to the configured CQI reporting mode (PUCCH 1-0). The UE shall stop transmitting uplink signal no later than time point C (240 ms after the start of time duration T3). The uplink signal is verified on the basis of the UE output power: UE output power equal to or higher than Transmit minimum power -39 dBm (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.2.5) means uplink signal. UE output power equal to or less than Transmit OFF power -48.5 dBm (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.3.5) means no uplink signal. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\%.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with MBSFN ABS (eICIC) > Test purpose
Content: To verify that the UE properly detects the out of sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the serving cell under time domain measurement resource restriction.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with MBSFN ABS (eICIC) > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA TDD UE release 10 and forward. Applicability requires support for FGI bit 115.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with MBSFN ABS (eICIC) > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last 200 ms period becomes worse than the threshold Qout, Layer 1 of the UE shall send an out-of-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within 200 ms Qout evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 clause 5.5.3.2. The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the PCell shall be performed as specified in 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 4.2.1. Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least 10 ms. The transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 clause 5.3.11. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.6.2.1 and A.7.3.14.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with MBSFN ABS (eICIC) > Test description
Content: There are two E-UTRA cells in the test on the same RF channel. Cell 1 is the serving victim cell and Cell 2 is the neighbour aggressor cell. MBSFN ABS pattern is configured in the aggressor cell (Cell 2). The UE is configured with a time domain measurement restriction pattern for performing serving cell (Cell 1) measurements. The UE is also configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode. The test consists of three successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2 and T3 respectively. Figure 7.3.14.4-1 shows the variation of the downlink SNR in the serving cell (Cell 1) to emulate out-of-sync states.
