Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with CRS assistance information and Non MBSFN ABS (feICIC) > Test purpose
Content: To verify that the UE properly detects the out of sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the PCell under time domain measurement resource restriction with CRS assistance information.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with CRS assistance information and Non MBSFN ABS (feICIC) > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA TDD and CRS interference handling UE release 11 and forward. Applicability requires support of FGI bit 115.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with CRS assistance information and Non MBSFN ABS (feICIC) > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last 200 ms period becomes worse than the threshold Qout, Layer 1 of the UE shall send an out-of-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within 200 ms Qout evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 clause 5.5.3.2. The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the PCell shall be performed as specified in 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 4.2.1. Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least 10 ms. The transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 clause 5.3.11. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.6.2.1 and A.7.3.18.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with CRS assistance information and Non MBSFN ABS (feICIC) > Test description
Content: There are three E-UTRA cells in the test on the same RF channel. There are three active cells in the test: Cell 1 is the PCell cell and Cell 2 and Cell 3 are the neighbour cells. Non-MBSFN ABS pattern is configured in both Cell 2 and Cell 3 in this test. The UE is configured by higher layers with a time domain measurement restriction pattern for performing PCell measurements. The UE is also configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with periodicity of 2 ms. The non-MBSFN ABS pattern, the time domain measurement resource restriction pattern and the CRS assistance information shall be configured prior to the start of T1. The test consists of three successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2 and T3 respectively. Figure 7.3.18.4-1 shows the variation of the downlink SNR in the serving cell (Cell 1) to emulate out-of-sync states.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with CRS assistance information and Non MBSFN ABS (feICIC) > Test description > Initial conditions
Content: Test Environment: Normal, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E Table E-1 and TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: 10 MHz as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1. Connect the SS (node B emulator), AWGN noise sources and faders to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A Figure A.48. The general test parameter settings for the different subtests are set up according to Table 7.3.18.4.1-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 7.3.18.4.3. At this stage only Cell 1 is switched on. Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with CRS assistance information and Non MBSFN ABS (feICIC) > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to Cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 2 ms. Non-MBSFN ABS pattern is configured in both Cell 2 and Cell 3 in this test. The UE is configured by higher layers with a time domain measurement restriction pattern for performing PCell (Cell 1) measurements. The Non-MBSFN ABS pattern, the time domain measurement resource restriction pattern and the CRS assistance information shall be configured prior to the start of T1. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF in Cell 1 according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3 with exceptions listed in 7.2A.6. Set the parameters for Cell 1, Cell 2 and Cell 3 according to T1 in Table 7.3.18.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.2.2. T1 starts. When T1 expires the SS shall change the SNR values to T2 as specified in Table 7.3.18.5-1. T2 starts. When T2 expires the SS shall change the SNR values to T3 as specified in Table 7.3.18.5-1. T3 starts. If the SS: [ a) ] detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm in each subframe configured for CQI transmission (according CQI reporting mode PUCCH 1-0) during the period from time point A to time point B; and does not detect any uplink power higher than -48.5 dBm from time point C (240 ms after the start of T3) until T3 expires, the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. When T3 expires the SS shall change the SNR values to T1 as specified in Table 7.3.18.5-1. If the UE has not re-established the connection in at least 1s, the UE is switched off and then on. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF in Cell 1 according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Repeat steps 2-7 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with CRS assistance information and Non MBSFN ABS (feICIC) > Test description > Message contents
Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.6 with the following exceptions: 7.3.18.5 Test requirements The UE behaviour in each test during time durations T1, T2 and T3 shall be as follows: During the period from time point A to time point B the UE shall transmit uplink signal at least in all uplink subframes configured for CQI transmission according to the configured CQI reporting mode (PUCCH 1-0). The UE shall stop transmitting uplink signal no later than time point C (240 ms after the start of the time duration T3). The uplink signal is verified on the basis of the UE output power: UE output power equal to or higher than Transmit minimum power -39 dBm (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.2.5) means uplink signal UE output power equal to or less than Transmit OFF power -48.5 dBm (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.3.5) means no uplink signal. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\%.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with CRS assistance information and Non MBSFN ABS (feICIC) > Test purpose

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with CRS assistance information and Non MBSFN ABS (feICIC) > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last 100 ms period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send an in-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within 100 ms Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 clause 5.5.3.2. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.6.2.1 and A.7.3.19.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with CRS assistance information and MBSFN ABS (feICIC) > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to Cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 2 ms. MBSFN ABS pattern is configured in both Cell 2 and Cell 3 in this test. The UE is configured by higher layers with a time domain measurement restriction pattern for performing PCell (Cell 1) measurements. The MBSFN ABS pattern, the time domain measurement resource restriction pattern and the CRS assistance information shall be configured prior to the start of T1. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF in Cell 1 according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3 with exceptions listed in 7.2A.6. Set the parameters for Cell 1, Cell 2, and Cell 3 according to T1 in Table 7.3.22.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.2.2. T1 starts. When T1 expires the SS shall change the SNR values to T2 as specified in Table 7.3.22.5-1. T2 starts. When T2 expires the SS shall change the SNR values to T3 as specified in Table 7.3.22.5-1. T3 starts. When T3 expires the SS shall change the SNR values to T4 as specified in Table 7.3.22.5-1. T4 starts. When T4 expires the SS shall change the SNR values to T5 as specified in Table 7.3.22.5-1. T5 starts. If the SS detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm in each subframe configured for CQI transmission (according CQI reporting mode PUCCH 1-0) during the period from time point A to time point F (420 ms after the start of time duration T5) the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. After T5 expires, repeat steps 2-7 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync for UE category 0 > Test purpose
Content: The purpose of this test is to verify that the FD-FDD category 0 UE properly detects the out of sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the PCell. This test will partly verify the E-UTRAN FDD radio link monitoring requirements in 3GPP TS 36.133 section 7.11.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync for UE category 0 > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 12 and forward of UE Category 0.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync for UE category 0 > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: The UE category 0 applicability of the requirements for performing radio link monitoring is defined in Section 3.1. When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last 200 ms period becomes worse than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send an out-of-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within 200ms Q evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last 100 ms period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send an in-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within 100 ms Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the PCell shall be performed as specified in clause 4.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.213 . Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least 10ms. The transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.11.1, 7.11.2 and A.7.3.26.

The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 2 ms.

Channel Bandwidth to be tested: 10 MHz as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1. Connect the SS (node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources or faders to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A figure A.10 using only main Tx/Rx antenna. The general test parameter settings for the different subtests are set up according to Table 7.3.27.4-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 7.3.27.4.3 There is one cell specified in this test. Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync for UE category 0 > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 2 ms. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 7.3.27.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B.2. T1 starts. When T1 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T2 as specified in Table 7.3.27.5-1. T2 starts. When T2 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T3 as specified in Table 7.3.27.5-1. T3 starts. When T3 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T4 as specified in Table 7.3.27.5-1. T4 starts. When T4 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T5 as specified in Table 7.3.27.5-1. T5 starts. If the SS detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm in each subframe configured for CQI transmission (according CQI reporting mode PUCCH 1-0) during the period from time point A to time point F (420 ms after the start of time duration T5) the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. After T5 expires, repeat steps 2-7 for both subtests until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync for UE category 0 > Test description > Message contents
Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.6 with the following exceptions: 7.3.27.5 Test requirement The UE behaviour in each test during time durations T1, T2, T3, T4 and T5 shall be as follows: During the period from time point A to time point F (420 ms after the start of time duration T5) the UE shall transmit uplink signal at least in all subframes configured for CQI transmission according to the configured CQI reporting mode (PUCCH 1-0). The uplink signal is verified on the basis of the UE output power: - UE output power equal to or higher than Transmit minimum power -39 dBm (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.2.5) means uplink signal The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\% with a confidence level of 95\%. 7.3.27_2 E-UTRAN FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync for UE Category 1bis 7.3.27_2.1 Test purpose The purpose of this test is to verify that the FD-FDD category 0 UE properly detects the in sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the PCell. The uplink signal is verified on the basis of the UE output power: - UE output power equal to or higher than Transmit minimum power -39 dBm (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.2.5) means uplink signal The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\% with a confidence level of 95\%.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE category 0 > Test purpose
Content: The purpose of this test is to verify that the FD-FDD category 0 UE properly detects the out of sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the serving cell when DRX is used. This test will partly verify the E-UTRAN FDD radio link monitoring requirements in 3GPP TS 36.133 section 7.11.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE category 0 > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 12 and forward of UE category 0. Applicability requires support for FGI bit 5.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE category 0 > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: The UE category 0 applicability of the requirements for performing radio link monitoring is defined in Section 3.1. When DRX is used for FD-FDD and TDD category 0 UEs, the Q evaluation period (T Q ) and the Q evaluation period (T Q ) is specified in 3GPP TS36.133 Table 7.11.2.2-1 will be used. When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last T Q period becomes worse than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send out-of-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last T Q period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send in-sync indications for the PCell to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the PCell shall be performed as specified in clause 4.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.213 . Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least max (10ms, DRX_cycle_length). Upon start of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 , the UE shall monitor the link for recovery using the evaluation period and Layer 1 indication interval corresponding to the non-DRX mode until the expiry or stop of T310 timer. The transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 . Evaluation Period in DRX for FD-FDD and TDD UE category 0 The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.11.1, 7.11.2 and A.7.3.28.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE category 0 > Test description
Content: There is one cell (cell 1), which is the active cell, in the test. The test consists of three successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2 and T3 respectively. Figure 7.3.28.4-1 shows the variation of the downlink SNR in the active cell to emulate out-of-sync and in-sync states. Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 2 ms. In the test, DRX configuration is enabled and DRX inactivity timer has already been expired, i.e. UE tries to decode PDCCH and to send periodic CQI during the period when On-duration timer is running. Time alignment timers shall be set to "infinity" so that UL timing alignment is maintained during the test.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE category 0 > Test description > Initial conditions
Content: Test Environment: Normal, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1. Message contents are defined in clause 7.3.28.4.3 There is one cell specified in this test. Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE category 0 > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 2 ms. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 7.3.28.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1. T1 starts. When T1 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T2 as specified in Table 7.3.28.5-1. T2 starts. When T2 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T3 as specified in Table 7.3.28.5-1. T3 starts. If the SS: [ a) ] detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm in each subframe configured for CQI transmission (according CQI reporting mode PUCCH 1-0) during the period from time point A to time point B; and does not detect any uplink power higher than -48.5 dBm from time point C (6500 ms after the start of T3) until T3 expires, the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. When T3 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T1 as specified in Table 7.3.28.5-1. If the UE has not re-established the connection in at least 1s, the UE is switched off and then on. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Repeat steps 2-7 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE category 0 > Test description > Message contents
Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.6 with the following exceptions: 7.3.28.5 Test requirement The UE behaviour in each test during time durations T1, T2 and T3 shall be as follows: During the period from time point A to time point B the UE shall transmit uplink signal at least once every DRX cycle, in the On-duration part of the cycle in the subframe according to the configured CQI reporting mode (PUCCH 1-0). The UE shall stop transmitting uplink signal no later than time point C (duration D = 6500 ms after the start of time duration T3. The uplink signal is verified on the basis of the UE output power: UE output power equal to or higher than Transmit minimum power -39 dBm (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.2.5) means uplink signal UE output power equal to or less than Transmit OFF power -48.5 dBm (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.3.5) means no uplink signal. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\% with a confidence level of 95\%. 7.3.28_2 E-UTRAN FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE Category 1bis 7.3.28_2.1 Test purpose The purpose of this test is to verify that the FD-FDD category 0 UE properly detects the out of sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the serving cell when DRX is used. Content: The purpose of this test is to verify that the HD-FDD category 0 UE properly detects the out of sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the PCell. This test will partly verify the E-UTRAN FDD radio link monitoring requirements in 3GPP TS 36.133 section 7.11.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync for UE category 0 > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA HD-FDD UE release 12 and forward of UE Category 0.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync for UE category 0 > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: The UE category 0 applicability of the requirements for performing radio link monitoring is defined in Section 3.1. When no DRX is used: The HD-FDD category 0 UE shall meet all applicable requirements specified in 3GPP TS.36.133 clause 7.11.2.1 under the following conditions - at least 1 DL subframe per radio frame of PCell is available at the UE during Q and Q evaluation periods. When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last 200 ms period becomes worse than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send an out-of-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within 200ms Q evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last 100 ms period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send an in-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within 100 ms Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the PCell shall be performed as specified in clause 4.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.213 . Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least 10ms. The transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.11.1, 7.11.2, 7.11.3 and A.7.3.30.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync for UE category 0 > Test description
Content: There is one cell (cell 1), which is the active cell, in the test. The test consists of three successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2 and T3 respectively. Figure 7.3.30.4-1 shows the variation of the downlink SNR in the active cell to emulate out-of-sync state. Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 10 ms.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync for UE category 0 > Test description > Initial conditions
Content: Test Environment: Normal, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: 10 MHz as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1. Connect the SS (node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources or faders to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A figure A.10 using only main Tx/Rx antenna. The general test parameter settings for the different subtests are set up according to Table 7.3.30.4-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 7.3.30.4.3. There is one cell specified in this test. Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync for UE category 0 > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of ms. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 7.3.30.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.2. T1 starts. When T1 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T2 as specified in Table 7.3.30.5-1. T2 starts. When T2 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T3 as specified in Table 7.3.30.5-1. T3 starts. If the SS: [ a) ] detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm in each subframe configured for CQI transmission (according CQI reporting mode PUCCH 1-0) during the period from time point A to time point B; and does not detect any uplink power higher than -48.5 dBm from time point C (240 ms after the start of T3) until T3 expires, the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. When T3 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T1 as specified in Table 7.3.30.5-1. If the UE has not re-established the connection in at least 1s, the UE is switched off and then on. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Repeat steps 2-7 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync for UE category 0 > Test description > Message contents
Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.6 with the following exceptions: 7.3.30.5 Test requirement The UE behaviour in each test during time durations T1, T2 and T3 shall be as follows: During the period from time point A to time point B the UE shall transmit uplink signal at least in all subframes configured for CQI transmission according the configured CQI reporting mode (PUCCH 1-0). The UE shall stop transmitting uplink signal no later than time point C (240 ms after the start of time duration T3). The uplink signal is verified on the basis of the UE output power: UE output power equal to or higher than Transmit minimum power -39 dBm (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.2.5) means uplink signal. UE output power equal to or less than Transmit OFF power -48.5 dBm (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.3.5) means no uplink signal. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\% with a confidence level of 95\%.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync for UE category 0 > Test purpose
Content: The purpose of this test is to verify that the HD-FDD category 0 UE properly detects the in sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the PCell. This test will partly verify the E-UTRAN FDD radio link monitoring requirements in 3GPP TS 36.133 section 7.11.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync for UE category 0 > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA HD-FDD UE release 12 and forward of UE category 0.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync for UE category 0 > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: The UE category 0 applicability of the requirements for performing radio link monitoring is defined in Section 3.1. When no DRX is used: The HD-FDD category 0 UE shall meet all applicable requirements specified in 3GPP TS.36.133 clause 7.11.2.1 under the following conditions: - at least 1 DL subframe per radio frame of PCell is available at the UE during Q and Q evaluation periods. When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last 200 ms period becomes worse than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send an out-of-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within 200 ms Q evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last 100 ms period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send an in-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within 100 ms Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the PCell shall be performed as specified in clause 4.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.213 . Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least 10ms. The transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.11.1, 7.11.2, 7.11.3 and A.7.3.31.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync for UE category 0 > Test description
Content: There is one cell (cell 1), which is the active cell, in the test. The test consists of five successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2, T3, T4 and T5 respectively. Figure 7.3.31.4-1 shows the variation of the downlink SNR in the active cell to emulate out-of-sync and in-sync states. Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 10 ms.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE category 0 > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA HD-FDD UE release 12 and forward of UE category 0. Applicability requires support for FGI bit 5.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE category 0 > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: The UE category 0 applicability of the requirements for performing radio link monitoring is defined in Section 3.1. When DRX is used for HD-FDD category 0 UEs, the Q evaluation period (T Q ) and the Q evaluation period (T Q ) specified in Table 7.3.32.3-1 will be used. When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last T Q period becomes worse than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send out-of-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last T Q period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send in-sync indications for the PCell to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the PCell shall be performed as specified in clause 4.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.213 . Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least max(10ms, DRX_cycle_length). Upon start of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 , the UE shall monitor the link for recovery using the evaluation period and Layer 1 indication interval corresponding to the non-DRX mode until the expiry or stop of T310 timer. The transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 . Evaluation Period in DRX for HD-FDD UE category 0 The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.11.1, 7.11.2, 7.11.3 and A.7.3.32.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE category 0 > Test description
Content: There is one cell (cell 1), which is the active cell, in the test. The test consists of three successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2 and T3 respectively. Figure 7.3.32.4-1 shows the variation of the downlink SNR in the active cell to emulate out-of-sync and in-sync states. Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 5 ms. In the test, DRX configuration is enabled and DRX inactivity timer has already been expired, i.e. UE tries to decode PDCCH and to send periodic CQI during the period when On-duration timer is running. Time alignment timers shall be set to "infinity" so that UL timing alignment is maintained during the test.

Repeat steps 2-7 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync for UE category 0 > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: The UE category 0 applicability of the requirements for performing radio link monitoring is defined in Section 3.1. When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last 200 ms period becomes worse than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send an out-of-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within 200ms Q evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last 100 ms period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send an in-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within 100 ms Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the PCell shall be performed as specified in clause 4.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.213 . Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least 10ms. The transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.11.1, 7.11.2 and A.7.3.35.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync for UE category 0 > Test description
Content: There is one cell (cell 1), which is the active cell, in the test. The test consists of five successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2, T3, T4 and T5 respectively. Figure 7.3.35.4-1 shows the variation of the downlink SNR in the active cell to emulate out-of-sync and in-sync states. Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 1 ms.

Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. After T5 expires, repeat steps 2-7 for both subtests until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE category 0 > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: The UE category 0 applicability of the requirements for performing radio link monitoring is defined in Section 3.1. When DRX is used for FD-FDD and TDD category 0 UEs, the Q evaluation period (T Q ) and the Q evaluation period (T Q ) is specified in 3GPP TS36.133 Table 7.11.2.2-1 will be used. When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last T Q period becomes worse than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send out-of-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last T Q period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send in-sync indications for the PCell to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the PCell shall be performed as specified in clause 4.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.213 . Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least max(10ms, DRX_cycle_length). Upon start of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 , the UE shall monitor the link for recovery using the evaluation period and Layer 1 indication interval corresponding to the non-DRX mode until the expiry or stop of T310 timer. The transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 . Evaluation Period in DRX for TDD and TDD UE category 0 The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.11.1, 7.11.2 and A.7.3.36.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE category 0 > Test description
Content: There is one cell (cell 1), which is the active cell, in the test. The test consists of three successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2 and T3 respectively. Figure 7.3.36.4-1 shows the variation of the downlink SNR in the active cell to emulate out-of-sync and in-sync states. Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 1 ms. In the test, DRX configuration is enabled and DRX inactivity timer has already been expired, i.e. UE tries to decode PDCCH and to send periodic CQI during the period when On-duration timer is running. Time alignment timers shall be set to "infinity" so that UL timing alignment is maintained during the test.

If the SS detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm in each subframe configured for CQI transmission (according CQI reporting mode PUCCH 1-0) during the period from time point A to time point F (1120 ms after the start of time duration T5) the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. After T5 expires, repeat steps 2-7 for both subtests until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD-FDD DC Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX in synchronous DC > Test purpose
Content: The purpose of this test is to verify that the UE properly detects the out of sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the PSCell when DRX is used in synchronous dual connectivity. Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD-FDD DC Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX in synchronous DC > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 12 and forward that supports Dual Connectivity.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD-FDD DC Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX in synchronous DC > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: When DRX is used the Q evaluation period (T Q ) and the Q evaluation period (T Q ) is specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 Table 7.6.2.2-1 will be used. When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell or PSCell estimated over the last T Q period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send in-sync indications for the PCell or PSCell to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 clause 5.5.3.2. The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations shall be performed as specified in section 4.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.213 . Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least max (10 ms, DRX_cycle_length). Upon start of T310 timer or T313 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 , the UE shall monitor the link of PCell or PSCell for recovery using the evaluation period and Layer 1 indication interval corresponding to the non-DRX mode until the expiry or stop of T310 timer or T313 timer. The transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer and the transmitter power of PSCell if configured shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T313 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 . Evaluation Period in DRX The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.6.2 and A.7.3.38.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD-FDD DC Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX in synchronous DC > Test description
Content: There are two cells, cell 1 is PCell and cell 2 is PSCell, in the test. The test consists of three successive time periods with time duration of T1, T2 and T3 respectively. Figure 7.3.38.4-1 shows the variation of the downlink SNR in the PCell and PSCell to emulate out-of-sync and in-sync states. Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1 and cell 2. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 2 ms. In the test, DRX configuration is enabled and DRX inactivity timer has already been expired, i.e. UE tries to decode PDCCH and to send periodic CQI during the period when On-duration timer is running. Time alignment timers shall be set to "infinity" so that UL timing alignment is maintained during the test.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD-FDD DC Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX in synchronous DC > Test description > Initial conditions
Content: Test Environment: Normal, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: The largest aggregated bandwidth combination supported by UE from Table 7.3.38.5-1 as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1 for different DC configurations (per band) as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 5.4.2. Connect the SS (node B emulator) and faders to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A, Figure A.40 (without connection the AWGN sources) as appropriate. The general test parameter settings for the different subtests are set up according to Table 7.3.38.4-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 7.3.38.4.3. There are two cells specified in this test, Cell 1 and Cell2. Cell 1 is the PCell on RF channel 1and Cell 2 is the PSCell on RF channel 2. Cell1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD-FDD DC Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX in synchronous DC > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1 and cell 2. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF-DC2 if UE supports DC Split DRB bearer, according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.2B; else ensure the UE is in state 3A-RF-DC1, according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.2A. The SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message configuring the UE with the message content defined in clause 7.3.38.4.3. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 7.3.38.5-1 as appropriate for BW dependant parameters. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.2.2. T1 starts. When T1 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T2 as specified in Table 7.3.38.5-1. T2 starts. When T2 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T3 as specified in Table 7.3.38.5-1. T3 starts. If the SS on Cell2: [ a) ] detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm in the On-duration part of every DRX cycle in the subframe according the configured CQI reporting mode (PUCCH 1-0) during the period from time point A to time point B; and does not detect any uplink power higher than -48.5 dBm from time point C (900 ms after the start of T3) until T3 expires, the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. When T3 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T1 as specified in Table 7.3.38.5-1. If the UE has not re-established the connection in at least 1s, the UE is switched off and then on. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF-DC2 if UE supports DC Split DRB bearer, according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.2B; else ensure the UE is in state 3A-RF-DC1, according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.2A. Repeat steps 2-9 for all subtests until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD-FDD DC Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX in synchronous DC > Test description > Message contents

Connect the SS (node B emulator) and faders to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A, Figure A.40 (without connection the AWGN sources) as appropriate. The general test parameter settings for the different subtests are set up according to Table 7.3.40.4-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 7.3.40.4.3. There are two cells specified in this test, Cell 1 and Cell2. Cell 1 is the PCell on RF channel 1and Cell 2 is the PSCell on RF channel 2. Cell1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD-TDD DC Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX in synchronous DC > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1 and cell2. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF-DC2 if UE supports DC Split DRB bearer, according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.2B; else ensure the UE is in state 3A-RF_DC1, according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.2A. The SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message configuring the UE with the message content defined in clause 7.3.40.4.3. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 7.3.40.5-1 as appropriate for BW dependant parameters. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.2.2. T1 starts. When T1 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T2 as specified in Table 7.3.40.5-1. T2 starts. When T2 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T3 as specified in Table 7.3.40.5-1. T3 starts. If the SS on Cell2: [ a) ] detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm in the On-duration part of every DRX cycle in the subframe according the configured CQI reporting mode (PUCCH 1-0) during the period from time point A to time point B; and does not detect any uplink power higher than -48.5 dBm from time point C (900 ms after the start of T3) until T3 expires, The number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. When T3 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T1 as specified in Table 7.3.40.5-1. If the UE has not re-established the connection in at least 1s, the UE is switched off and then on. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF-DC2 if UE supports DC Split DRB bearer, according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.2B; else ensure the UE is in state 3A-RF-DC1, according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.2A. Repeat steps 2-9 for all subtests until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD-TDD DC Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX in synchronous DC > Test description > Message contents
Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.6 with the following exceptions: 7.3.40.5 Test requirement The UE behaviour during time durations T1, T2, and T3 shall be as follows: During time durations T1, T2 and T3, the UE shall transmit uplink signal at least in all subframes configured for CQI transmission on Cell1. During the period from time point A to time point B the UE shall transmit uplink signal at least once every DRX cycle, in the On-duration part of the cycle in the uplink subframe on Cell2. The UE shall stop transmitting uplink signal no later than time point C (duration D1 = 900 ms after the start of time duration T3) on PSCell. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\%.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX in synchronous dual connectivity > Test purpose
Content: The purpose of this test is to verify that the UE properly detects the out of sync and in sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the PSCell when DRX is used in dual connectivity. This test will partly verify the E-UTRAN FDD radio link monitoring requirements in 3GPP TS36.133 clause 7.6.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX in synchronous dual connectivity > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 12 and forward that supports Dual Connectivity.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX in synchronous dual connectivity > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: When DRX is used the Q evaluation period (T Q ) and the Q evaluation period (T Q ) is specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 Table 7.6.2.2-1 will be used. When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell or PSCell estimated over the last T Q period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send in-sync indications for the PCell or PSCell to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 clause 5.5.3.2. The In-sync and in-sync evaluations shall be performed as specified in section 4.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.213 . Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least max(10 ms, DRX_cycle_length). Upon start of T310 timer or T313 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 , the UE shall monitor the link of PCell or PSCell for recovery using the evaluation period and Layer 1 indication interval corresponding to the non-DRX mode until the expiry or stop of T310 timer or T313 timer. The transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer and the transmitter power of PSCell if configured shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T313 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 . Evaluation Period in DRX The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.6.2 and A.7.3.41.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX in synchronous dual connectivity > Test description
Content: There are two cells, cell 1 is PCell and cell 2 is PSCell, in the test. The test consists of five successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2, T3, T4 and T5 respectively. Figure 7.3.38.4-1 shows the variation of the downlink SNR in the PSCell to emulate In-sync and in-sync states. Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1 and cell 2. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 2 ms. In the test, DRX configuration for PCell and PSCell is enabled and DRX inactivity timer has already been expired, i.e. UE tries to decode PDCCH and to send periodic CQI during the period when On-duration timer is running. Time alignment timers shall be set to "infinity" so that UL timing alignment is maintained during the test.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX in synchronous dual connectivity > Test description > Initial conditions

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX in synchronous dual connectivity > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1 and cell 2. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF-DC2 if UE supports DC Split DRB bearer, according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.2B; else ensure the UE is in state 3C-RF, according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.2A. The SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message configuring the UE with the message content defined in clause 7.3.41.4.3. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 7.3.41.5-1 for subtests 1 and 2 respectively. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B.2.2. T1 starts. When T1 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T2 as specified in Table 7.3.41.5-1. T2 starts. When T2 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T3 as specified in Table 7.3.41.5-1. T3 starts. When T3 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T4 as specified in Table 7.3.41.5-1. T4 starts. When T4 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T5 as specified in Table 7.3.41.5-1. T5 starts. If the SS on Cell 2 detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm in each subframe configured for CQI transmission (according CQI reporting mode PUCCH 1-0) during the period from time point A to time point F (1120 ms after the start of time duration T5) the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. After T5 expires, repeat steps 2-9 for both subtests until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FDD-FDD DC Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX in asynchronous DC > Test description
Content: There are two cells in the test. Cell 1 is PCell in MCG and cell 2 is PSCell in SCG. Before the test starts the UE is connected to cell 1 on radio channel 1 and to cell 2 on radio channel 2. The test consists of five successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2, T3, T4 and T5 respectively. The downlink SNR in cell 1 keeps constant in the test. Figure 7.3.42.4-1 shows the variation of the downlink SNR in cell 2 to emulate In-sync and in-sync states. Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1 and cell 2 in asynchronous dual connectivity. For both cell 1 and cell 2, the UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 2 ms. In the test, DRX configuration is enabled and DRX inactivity timer has already been expired, i.e. UE tries to decode PDCCH and to send periodic CQI during the period when On-duration timer is running. Time alignment timers shall be set to "infinity" so that UL timing alignment is maintained during the test.

Content: Test Environment: Normal, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: The largest aggregated bandwidth combination supported by UE from Table 7.3.44.5-1 as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1 for different DC configurations (per band) as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 5.4.2. Connect the SS (node B emulator) and faders to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A, Figure A.40 (without connection the AWGN sources) as appropriate. The general test parameter settings for the different subtests are set up according to Table 7.3.44.4-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 7.3.44.4.3. There are two cells specified in this test, Cell 1 and Cell2. Cell 1 is the PCell on RF channel 1and Cell 2 is the PSCell on RF channel 2. Cell1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD-FDD DC Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX in synchronous DC with PCell in FDD > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1 and cell 2. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF-DC2 if UE supports DC Split DRB bearer, according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.2B; else ensure the UE is in state 3A-RF-DC1, according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.2A. The SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message configuring the UE with the message content defined in clause 7.3.44.4.3. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 7.3.44.5-1 as appropriate for BW dependant parameters. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.2.2. T1 starts. When T1 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T2 as specified in Table 7.3.44.5-1. T2 starts. When T2 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T3 as specified in Table 7.3.44.5-1. T3 starts. If the SS on Cell2: [ a) ] detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm in the On-duration part of every DRX cycle in the subframe according the configured CQI reporting mode (PUCCH 1-0) during the period from time point A to time point B; and does not detect any uplink power higher than -48.5 dBm from time point C (900 ms after the start of T3) until T3 expires, the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. When T3 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T1 as specified in Table 7.3.44.5-1. If the UE has not re-established the connection in at least 1s, the UE is switched off and then on. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF-DC2 if UE supports DC Split DRB bearer, according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.2B; else ensure the UE is in state 3A-RF-DC1, according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.2A. Repeat steps 2-9 for all subtests until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD-FDD DC Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX in synchronous DC with PCell in FDD > Test description > Message contents
Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.6 with the following exceptions: 7.3.44.5 Test requirement The UE behaviour during time durations T1, T2, and T3 shall be as follows: During time durations T1, T2 and T3, the UE shall transmit uplink signal at least in all subframes configured for CQI transmission on Cell1. During the period from time point A to time point B the UE shall transmit uplink signal at least once every DRX cycle, in the On-duration part of the cycle in the uplink subframe on Cell2. The UE shall stop transmitting uplink signal no later than time point C (duration D1 = 900 ms after the start of time duration T3) on PSCell. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\%.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD-FDD DC Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX in synchronous DC with PCell in TDD > Test purpose
Content: The purpose of this test is to verify that the UE properly detects the out of sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the PSCell when DRX is used in synchronous dual connectivity. This test will partly verify the E-UTRA radio link monitoring requirements in 3GPP TS36.133 clause 7.6.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD-FDD DC Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX in synchronous DC with PCell in TDD > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD and TDD UE release 12 and forward that supports Dual Connectivity.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD-FDD DC Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX in synchronous DC with PCell in TDD > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: When DRX is used the Q evaluation period (T Q ) and the Q evaluation period (T Q ) is specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 Table 7.6.2.2-1 will be used. When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell or PSCell estimated over the last T Q period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send in-sync indications for the PCell or PSCell to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 clause 5.5.3.2. The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations shall be performed as specified in section 4.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.213 . Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least max (10 ms, DRX_cycle_length). Upon start of T310 timer or T313 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 , the UE shall monitor the link of PCell or PSCell for recovery using the evaluation period and Layer 1 indication interval corresponding to the non-DRX mode until the expiry or stop of T310 timer or T313 timer. The transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer and the transmitter power of PSCell if configured shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T313 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 . Evaluation Period in DRX The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.6.2 and A.7.3.45.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD-FDD DC Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX in synchronous DC with PCell in TDD > Test description
Content: There are two cells, cell 1 is PCell and cell 2 is PSCell, in the test. The test consists of three successive time periods with time duration of T1, T2 and T3 respectively. Figure 7.3.45.4-1 shows the variation of the downlink SNR in the PCell and PSCell to emulate out-of-sync states. Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1 and cell 2. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 2 ms on cell 1 and 1ms on cell 2. In the test, DRX configuration is enabled and DRX inactivity timer has already been expired, i.e. UE tries to decode PDCCH and to send periodic CQI during the period when On-duration timer is running. Time alignment timers shall be set to "infinity" so that UL timing alignment is maintained during the test.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN TDD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX for PSCell in synchronous DC with PCell in FDD > Test description > Test procedure

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync for CE UE in CEMode A > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 13 and forward of UE category M1 and higher, including non-BL/CE UE.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync for CE UE in CEMode A > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: Editor's note: The test requirements in this section refer explicitly to Category M1, but they are applicable to Category M2 and non-BL/CE UEs. Pending discussion in RAN4 is needed to update the wording. The UE category CAT-M1 applicability of the requirements for performing radio link monitoring is defined in Section 3.6 of 3GPP TS 36.133 . When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last 400 ms period becomes worse than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send an out-of-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within 400 ms Q evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last 200 ms period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send an in-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within 200 ms Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the PCell shall be performed as specified in clause 4.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.213 . Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least 10ms. The transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.19.1, 7.19.2, 7.19.3 and A.7.3.53.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync for CE UE in CEMode A > Test description
Content: There is one cell (cell 1), which is the active cell, in the test. The test consists of three successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2 and T3 respectively. Figure 7.3.48.4-1 shows the variation of the downlink SNR in the active cell to emulate out-of-sync and in-sync states. Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode without repetition with a reporting periodicity of 2 ms. In the test, the RRC parameter numberPRB-Pairs is set to 6 and the RRC parameter mPDCCH-NumRepetition is set to 8. Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync for CE UE in CEMode A > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 2 ms. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF-CE with the condition CEModeA according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3AA. SS sends a RRC Reconfiguration message configuring M-PDCCH aggregation level and M-PDCCH repetition level as defined in Table 7.3.48.4.1-1. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 7.3.48.5-1. When T2 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T3 as specified in Table 7.3.48.5-1. T3 starts. If the SS: [ a) ] detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm in each subframe configured for CQI transmission (according CQI reporting mode PUCCH 1-0) during the period from time point A to time point B; and does not detect any uplink power higher than -48.5 dBm from time point C (440 ms after the start of T3) until T3 expires; the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. When T3 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T1 as specified in Table 7.3.48.5-1. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\% with a confidence level of 95\%.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-Sync for CE UE in CEModeA > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 13 and forward of UE category M1 and higher, including non-BL/CE UE.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-Sync for CE UE in CEModeA > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: Editor's note: The test requirements in this section refer explicitly to Category M1, but they are applicable to Category M2 and non-BL/CE UEs. Pending discussion in RAN4 is needed to update the wording. The UE category CAT-M1 applicability of the requirements for performing radio link monitoring is defined in Section 3.6 of 3GPP TS 36.133 . When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last 400 ms period becomes worse than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send an out-of-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within 400 ms Q evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last 200 ms period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send an in-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within 200 ms Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the PCell shall be performed as specified in clause 4.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.213 . Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least 10ms. The transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.19.1, 7.19.2, 7.19.3 and A.7.3.49.
