Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync for CE UE in CEModeA > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA HD-FDD UE release 13 and forward of UE category M1 and higher, including non-BL/CE UE.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync for CE UE in CEModeA > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: Editor's note: The test requirements in this section refer explicitly to Category M1, but they are applicable to Category M2 and non-BL/CE UEs. Pending discussion in RAN4 is needed to update the wording. The UE category CAT-M1 applicability of the requirements for performing radio link monitoring is defined in Section 3.6 of 3GPP TS 36.133 . When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last 400 ms period becomes worse than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send an out-of-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within 400 ms Q evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last 200 ms period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send an in-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within 200 ms Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the PCell shall be performed as specified in clause 4.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.213 . Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least 10ms. The transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.19.1, 7.19.2, 7.19.3 and A.7.3.53.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync for CE UE in CEModeA > Test description
Content: There is one cell (cell 1), which is the active cell, in the test. The test consists of three successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2 and T3 respectively. Figure 7.3.52.4-1 shows the variation of the downlink SNR in the active cell to emulate out-of-sync and in-sync states. Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode without repetition with a reporting periodicity of 20 ms. In the test, the RRC parameter numberPRB-Pairs is set to 6 and the RRC parameter mPDCCH-NumRepetition is set to 8. UE shall successfully complete the RRC reconfiguration accordingly prior to the start of time duration T1.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync for CE UE in CEModeA > Test description > Initial conditions
Content: Test Environment: Normal, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: 10 MHz as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1. Connect the SS (node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources or faders to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A figure A.10 using only main Tx/Rx antenna. The general test parameter settings for the different subtests are set up according to Table 7.3.52.4-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 7.3.52.4.3 There is one cell specified in this test. Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync for CE UE in CEModeA > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 20 ms. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF-CE with the condition CEModeA according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3AA. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 7.3.52.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1. T1 starts. When T1 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T2 as specified in Table 7.3.42.5-1. T2 starts. When T2 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T3 as specified in Table 7.3.52.5-1. T3 starts. If the SS: [ a) ] detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm in each subframe configured for CQI transmission (according CQI reporting mode PUCCH 1-0) during the period from time point A to time point B; and does not detect any uplink power higher than -48.5 dBm from time point C (440 ms after the start of T3) until T3 expires; the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. When T3 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T1 as specified in Table 7.3.52.5-1. If the UE has not re-established the connection in at least 1s, the UE is switched off and then on. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF-CE with CE ModeA activated according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3AA. Repeat steps 2-8 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync for CE UE in CEModeA > Test description > Message contents
Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.6 with the following exceptions: 7.3.52.5 Test requirement The UE behaviour in each test during time durations T1, T2 and T3 shall be as follows: During the period from time point A to time point B the UE shall transmit uplink signal at least in all subframes configured for CQI transmission according to the configured CQI reporting mode (PUCCH 1-0). The UE shall stop transmitting uplink signal no later than time point C (440 ms after the start of time duration T3). The uplink signal is verified on the basis of the UE output power: UE output power equal to or higher than Transmit minimum power -39 dBm (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.2.5) means uplink signal UE output power equal to or less than Transmit OFF power -48.5 dBm (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.3.5) means no uplink signal. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\% with a confidence level of 95\%.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync for CE UE in CEModeA > Test purpose
Content: The purpose of this test is to verify that the HD-FDD CE UE properly detects the in sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the serving cell. This test will partly verify the E-UTRAN FDD radio link monitoring requirements in 3GPP TS 36.133 section 7.19.

Content: There is one cell (cell 1), which is the active cell, in the test. The test consists of five successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2, T3, T4 and T5 respectively. Figure 7.3.53.4-1 shows the variation of the downlink SNR in the active cell to emulate out-of-sync and in-sync states. Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. UE shall successfully complete the RRC reconfiguration accordingly prior to the start of time duration T1.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync for CE UE in CEModeA > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 20 ms. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF-CE with the condition CEModeA according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3AA. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 7.3.53.5-1. T4 starts. When T4 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T5 as specified in Table 7.3.53.5-1. T5 starts. If the SS detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm in each subframe configured for CQI transmission (according CQI reporting mode PUCCH 1-0) during the period from time point A to time point F (740 ms after the start of time duration T5) the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. After T5 expires, repeat steps 2-8 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync for CE UE in CEModeA > Test description > Message contents
Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.6 with the following exceptions: 7.3.53.5 Test requirement The UE behaviour in each test during time durations T1, T2, T3, T4 and T5 shall be as follows: During the period from time point A to time point F (740 ms after the start of time duration T5) the UE shall transmit uplink signal at least in all subframes configured for CQI transmission according to the configured CQI reporting mode (PUCCH 1-0). The uplink signal is verified on the basis of the UE output power: - UE output power equal to or higher than Transmit minimum power -39 dBm (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.2.5) means uplink signal The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\% with a confidence level of 95\%.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for CE UE in CEmodeA > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA HD-FDD UE release 13 and forward of UE category M1 and higher, including non-BL/CE UE. Applicability requires support for FGI bit 5.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for CE UE in CEmodeA > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: Editor's note: The test requirements in this section refer explicitly to Category M1, but they are applicable to Category M2 and non-BL/CE UEs. Pending discussion in RAN4 is needed to update the wording. The requirements defined in this subclause for performing radio link monitoring are applicable for UE category M1 defined in Section 3.1. When DRX is used for HD-FDD category M1 with CE mode A UEs, the Q evaluation period (T Q ) and the Q evaluation period (T Q ) specified in Table 7.3.54.3-1 will be used. When eDRX_CONN cycle is used for HD-FDD category M1 with CE mode A UEs, the Q evaluation period (T Q ) and the Q evaluation period (T Q ) specified in Table 7.3.54.3-2 will be used. When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last T Q period becomes worse than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send out-of-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last T Q period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send in-sync indications for the PCell to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the PCell shall be performed as specified in clause 4.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.213 . When DRX is used, two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least max (10 ms, DRX_cycle_length). When eDRX_CONN is used, two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least max (10 ms, eDRX_CONN cycle length). Upon start of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 , the UE shall monitor the link for recovery using the evaluation period and Layer 1 indication interval corresponding to the non-DRX mode until the expiry or stop of T310 timer. The transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 . Evaluation Period in DRX for HD-FDD UE category M1 with CE mode A evaluation period when eDRX_CONN cycle is configured for HD-FDD UE category M1 with CE mode A The normative reference for this requirement can be found in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.19.3 and A.7.3.54.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for CE UE in CEmodeA > Test description
Content: There is one cell (cell 1), which is the active cell, in the test. The test consists of three successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2 and T3 respectively. Figure 7.3.54.4-1 shows the variation of the downlink SNR in the active cell to emulate out-of-sync states. Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 20 ms without repetition. In the test, DRX configuration is enabled and DRX inactivity timer has already been expired, i.e. UE tries to decode MPDCCH and to send periodic CQI during the period when On-duration timer is running. Time alignment timers shall be set to "infinity" so that UL timing alignment is maintained during the test. In the test, the RRC parameter numberPRB-Pairs is set to 4 and the RRC parameter mPDCCH-NumRepetition is set 4. UE shall successfully complete the RRC reconfiguration accordingly prior to the start of time duration T1.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for CE UE in CEmodeA > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. T3 starts. If the SS: [ a) ] detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm for carrier frequency less than 3GHz or -38.7 dBm for carrier frequency higher than 3GHz, but less than 4.2GHz (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.2.5) in each subframe configured for CQI transmission (according CQI reporting mode PUCCH 1-0) during the period from time point A to time point B; and does not detect any uplink power higher than -48.5 dBm for carrier frequency less than 3GHz) or higher than -48.2 dBm for carrier frequency higher than 3GHz, but less than 4.2GHz (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.3.5) from time point C (6520 ms after the start of T3) until T3 expires, the number of successful tests is increased by one. If the UE has not re-established the connection in at least 1s, the UE is switched off and then on. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Repeat steps 2-7 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.

Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 20 ms. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF-CE according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 7.3.55.5-1. The SS shall select randomly one set of values (Set 1 or Set 2) for both MPDCCH aggregation level and MPDCCH repetition level. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B.1. T1 starts. When T1 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T2 as specified in Table 7.3.55.5-1. T2 starts. When T2 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T3 as specified in Table 7.3.55.5-1. T3 starts. When T3 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T4 as specified in Table 7.3.55.5-1. T4 starts. When T4 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T5 as specified in Table 7.3.55.5-1. T5 starts. If the SS detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm for carrier frequency less than 3GHz or -38.7 dBm for carrier frequency higher than 3GHz, but less than 4.2GHz (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.2.5) in each subframe configured for CQI transmission (according CQI reporting mode PUCCH 1-0) during the period from time point A to time point F (1140 ms after the start of time duration T5) the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. After T5 expires, repeat steps 2-7 for both subtests until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.

Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.6 with the following exceptions: 7.3.55.5 Test requirement The UE behaviour in each test during time durations T1, T2, T3, T4 and T5 shall be as follows: During the period from time point A to time point F (1140 ms after the start of time duration T5) the UE shall transmit uplink signal at least once every DRX cycle, in the On-duration part of the cycle in the subframe according to the configured CQI reporting mode (PUCCH 1-0). The uplink signal is verified on the basis of the UE output power: - UE output power equal to or higher than Transmit minimum power -39 dBm for carrier frequency less than 3 GHz or -38.7 dBm for carrier frequency higher than 3GHz, but less than 4.2GHz (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.2.5) means uplink signal The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\% with a confidence level of 95\%. 7.3.56 E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync for CE UE in CEModeA
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX for CE UE in CEModeA > Test purpose
Content: The purpose of this test is to verify that the TDD CE UE properly detects the out of sync and in sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the PCell in CEModeA. This test will partly verify the E-UTRAN TDD radio link monitoring requirements for UE defined in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.19.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX for CE UE in CEModeA > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA TDD UE release 13 and forward of UE category M1 and higher, including non-BL/CE UE.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX for CE UE in CEModeA > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: Editor's note: The test requirements in this section refer explicitly to Category M1, but they are applicable to Category M2 and non-BL/CE UEs. Pending discussion in RAN4 is needed to update the wording. The UE category CAT-M1 applicability of the requirements for performing radio link monitoring is defined in Section 3.6 of 3GPP TS 36.133 . When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last 400 ms period becomes worse than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send an out-of-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within 400 ms Q evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last 200 ms period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send an in-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within 200 ms Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the PCell shall be performed as specified in clause 4.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.213 . Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least 10ms. The transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.19.1, 7.19.2, 7.19.3 and A.7.3.56.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX for CE UE in CEModeA > Test description
Content: There is one cell (cell 1), which is the active cell, in the test. The test consists of three successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2 and T3 respectively. Figure 7.3.56.4-1 shows the variation of the downlink SNR in the active cell to emulate out-of-sync and in-sync states. Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 1 ms. UE shall successfully complete the RRC reconfiguration accordingly prior to the start of time duration T1.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX for CE UE in CEModeA > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 1 ms. When T2 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T3 as specified in Table 7.3.56.5-1. T3 starts. If the SS: [ a) ] detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm in each subframe configured for CQI transmission (according CQI reporting mode PUCCH 1-0) during the period from time point A to time point B; and does not detect any uplink power higher than -48.5 dBm from time point C (440 ms after the start of T3) until T3 expires, the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. When T3 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T1 as specified in Table 7.3.56.5-1. If the UE has not re-established the connection in at least 1s, the UE is switched off and then on. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF-CE with CE ModeA activated according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3AA. Repeat steps 2-8 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E- UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for CE UE in CEModeA > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: Editor's note: The test requirements in this section refer explicitly to Category M1, but they are applicable to Category M2 and non-BL/CE UEs. Pending discussion in RAN4 is needed to update the wording. The UE category CAT-M1 applicability of the requirements for performing radio link monitoring in subclause 7.19 of 3GPP TS 36.133 is defined in Section 3.6 of 3GPP TS 36.133 . When DRX is used for FD-FDD and TDD category M1 UEs, the Q evaluation period (T Q ) and the Q evaluation period (T Q ) specified in Table 7.3.58.3-1 (3GPP TS 36.133 Table 7.19.2.2 1) will be used. When eDRX_CONN cycle is used for FD-FDD and TDD UE category M1 UEs, the Q evaluation period (T Q ) and the Q evaluation period (T Q ) specified in Table 7.3.58.3-2 (3GPP TS 36.133 Table 7.19.2.2-2) will be used. When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last T Q period becomes worse than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send out-of-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last T Q period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send in-sync indications for the PCell to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the PCell shall be performed as specified in clause 4.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.213 . When DRX is used, two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least max(10 ms, DRX_cycle_length). When eDRX_CONN is used, two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least max(10 ms, eDRX_CONN cycle length). Upon start of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 , the UE shall monitor the link for recovery using the evaluation period and Layer 1 indication interval corresponding to the non-DRX mode until the expiry or stop of T310 timer. The transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 . Evaluation Period in DRX for FD-FDD and TDD UE category M1 evaluation period when eDRX_CONN cycle is configured for FD-FDD and TDD UE category M1 The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.19.1, 7.19.2 and A.7.3.58. Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E- UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for CE UE in CEModeA > Test description
Content: There is one cell (cell 1), which is the active cell, in the test. The test consists of three successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2 and T3 respectively. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 1 ms without repetition. In the test, DRX configuration is enabled and DRX inactivity timer has already been expired, i.e. UE tries to decode MPDCCH and to send periodic CQI during the period when On-duration timer is running. Time alignment timers shall be set to "infinity" so that UL timing alignment is maintained during the test. UE shall successfully complete the RRC reconfiguration accordingly prior to the start of time duration T1.

Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.0 Message contents are defined in clause 7.3.59.4.3 There is one cell specified in this test. Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E- UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX for CE UE in CEModeA > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. The UE shall be configured for periodic CQI reporting in PUCCH 1-0 mode with a reporting periodicity of 1 ms without repetition. In the test, DRX configuration is enabled and DRX inactivity timer has already been expired, i.e. UE tries to decode MPDCCH and to send periodic CQI during the period when On-duration timer is running. Time alignment timers shall be set to "infinity" so that UL timing alignment is maintained during the test. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF-CE according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. SS sends a RRC Reconfiguration message configuring M-PDCCH aggregation level and M-PDCCH repetition level as defined in Table 7.3.59.4.1-1 Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 7.3.59.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B.1. T1 starts. When T1 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T2 as specified in Table 7.3.59.5-1. T2 starts. When T2 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T3 as specified in Table 7.3.59.5-1. T3 starts. When T3 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T4 as specified in Table 7.3.59.5-1. T4 starts. When T4 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T5 as specified in Table 7.3.59.5-1. T5 starts. If the SS detects uplink power equal to or higher than [-39 dBm] (as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.2.5 for carrier frequency less than GHz) in each subframe configured for CQI transmission (according CQI reporting mode PUCCH 1-0) during the period from time point A to time point F (1120 ms after the start of time duration T5) the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. After T5 expires, repeat steps 2-7 for both subtests until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E- UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX for CE UE in CEModeA > Test description > Message contents
Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.6 with the following exceptions: 7.3.59.5 Test requirement The UE behaviour in each test during time durations T1, T2, T3, T4 and T5 shall be as follows: During the period from time point A to time point F (1120 ms after the start of time duration T5) the UE shall transmit uplink signal at least once every DRX cycle, in the On-duration part of the cycle in the subframe according to the configured CQI reporting mode (PUCCH 1-0). The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\%.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE category NB1 In-band mode in normal coverage > Test purpose
Content: The purpose of this test is to verify that the HD-FDD category NB1 UE properly detects the out of sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the NB-IoT Cell. This test will partly verify the NB-IoT HD-FDD radio link monitoring requirements in clause TS36.133 clause 7.23.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE category NB1 In-band mode in normal coverage > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of NB-IoT HD FDD UE release 13 and forward of UE category NB1 and higher. Applicability requires support for FGI bit 5.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE category NB1 In-band mode in normal coverage > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: The requirements defined in this subclause for performing radio link monitoring are applicable for Category NB1 UE defined in Section 3.1 of 3GPP TS36.133. The UE shall meet all applicable requirements specified in this clause under the following condition: - at least 1 DL subframe per radio frame of serving NB-IoT cell is available at the UE during Q and Q evaluation periods. The UE shall estimate the downlink radio link quality and compare it to the thresholds Q and Q for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the NB-IoT cell. The threshold Q is defined as the level at which the downlink radio link cannot be reliably received and shall correspond to 10\% block error rate of a hypothetical NPDCCH transmission with transmission parameters specified in Table 7.3.60.3-1. The threshold Q is defined as the level at which the downlink radio link quality can be significantly more reliably received than at Q and shall correspond to 2\% block error rate of a hypothetical NPDCCH transmission with transmission parameters specified in Table 7.3.60.3-1. When DRX is used for HD-FDD Category NB1 UE UEs, the Q evaluation period (T Q ) and the Q evaluation period (T Q ) is specified in Table 7.3.60.3-2 will be used. When the downlink radio link quality of the NB-IoT cell estimated over the last T Q period becomes worse than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send out-of-sync indication for the NB-IoT cell to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . When the downlink radio link quality of the NB-IoT cell estimated over the last T Q period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send in-sync indications for the NB-IoT cell to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the NB-IoT cell shall be performed as specified in 3GPP TS36.213 , clause 4.2.1. Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least max( ms, DRX_cycle_length). Upon start of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 , the UE shall monitor the link for recovery using the evaluation period and Layer 1 indication interval corresponding to the non-DRX mode until the expiry or stop of T310 timer. The transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 . Evaluation Period in DRX for HD-FDD Category NB1 UE The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.23 and A.7.3.60.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE category NB1 In-band mode in normal coverage > Test description
Content: The test consists of one subtest with one NB-IOT cell (Ncell 1) and one EUTRAN cell (cell 1) configured. The test consists of four successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2, T3 and T4 respectively, excluding the transition time duration dT, where the SNR increases or decreases gradually in small steps. Figure 7.3.60.4-1 shows the different time durations and the corresponding variation of the downlink SNR in the active cell to emulate out-of-sync state with the following testing procedure: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to nCell1 Starting at point A, the SNR is decreased in small steps from SNR1 to SNR2 within dT At the start of the time duration T2, the UE is provided with a UL grant with NPDCCH NOTE 1: The UE is expected to decode the NPDCCH and complete the UL transmission during T2 according to the UL grant. The UE shall not be provisioned with any more UL grants until the start of time period T4. Starting at point B, the SNR is decreased in small steps from SNR2 to SNR3 within dT During T3, the SNR is kept as SNR3 NOTE 2: The UE is expected to detect OOS and declare RLF during T3. Starting at point C, the SNR is increased in small steps from SNR3 to SNR1 with dT At the start of the time period T4, the UE will be provided with another UL grant with NPDCCH NOTE 3: The UE is not expected to decode the UL grant and conduct any UL transmission during T4, since the UE is expected to declare RLF during T3. In the test, DRX configuration is enabled and DRX inactivity timer has already been expired, i.e. UE tries to decode the NPDCCH and complete the UL transmission when On-duration timer is running. Time alignment timers shall be set to "infinity" so that UL timing alignment is maintained during the test.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE category NB1 In-band mode in normal coverage > Test description > Initial conditions
Content: Test Environment: Normal, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-4 and TS 36.508 clauses 8.1.3 and 8.1.4.2. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: E-UTRA Bandwidth is 10 MHz, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1.1, except for bands within band group FDD_N where 5 MHz bandwidth is used. Ncell bandwidth is as specified in Table 7.3.60.5-1. Connect the SS (node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A figure A.10 using only main Tx/Rx antenna and without using the faders. The general test parameter settings are set up according to Table 7.3.60.4-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 7.3.60.4.3 There are two cells specified in this test. Ncell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test. Cell 1 is a EUTRAN cell.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE category NB1 In-band mode in normal coverage > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully be synchronized to Ncell 1. The UE is scheduled in every possible uplink subframe to transmit NPUSCH, which is received by the test equipment. Ensure the UE is in State 2A-NB according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 8.1.5. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 7.3.60.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1.1. T1 starts. When T1 expires, the 1st time window dT starts. During dT the SS shall change the SNR towards the SNR value as specified in Table 7.3.60.5-1. When dT expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T2 (SNR2) as specified in Table 7.3.60.5-1. T2 starts. At the start of T2 the UE shall be provided with a UL grant on NPDCCH. The UE shall decode NPDCCH and complete the UL transmission, according to the UL grant, before T2 expires. If the UL transmission is not completed the number of failed test is increased by one, if so restart test from step 1. No more UL grants are given until start of T4. When T2 expires, the 2nd time window dT starts. During dT the SS shall change the SNR towards the SNR value as specified in Table 7.3.60.5-1. When dT expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T3 (SNR3) as specified in Table 7.3.60.5-1. T3 starts. During T3 the UE is expected to detect OOS and declare RLM. When T3 expires, the 3rd time window dT starts. During dT the SS shall change the SNR towards the SNR value as specified in Table 7.3.60.5-1. When dT expires the SS shall keep the SNR value corresponding to T4 as specified in Table 7.3.60.5-1. T4 starts. At the start of T4 the UE shall be provided with another UL grant on NPDCCH. If the SS detects uplink power equal to or higher than -48.2 dBm in the On-duration part of every DRX cycle in the uplink subframe scheduled to transmit NPUSCH during the period T4 the number of failed tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of successful tests is increased by one. After T4 expires the UE is switched off and then on. Ensure the UE is in State 2A-NB according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 8.1.5. Repeat steps 2-12 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE category NB1 In-band mode in normal coverage > Test description > Message contents
Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.6 and clause 8.1.4.3 using condition "Inband_Different" with the following exceptions: Table 7.3.60.4.3-2: RRCConnectionSetup-NB: E-UTRAN HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync with DRX for UE Category NB1 In-Band mode in normal coverage 7.3.60.5 Test requirement The UE behaviours in each test shall be as follows: The UE shall complete the NPUSCH transmission during T2 according to the received UL grant; The UE shall not conduct any NPUSCH transmission during T4 A correct event is defined as UE behaves correctly in all above steps. The correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\%.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync with DRX for Category NB1 In-Band mode in Enhanced Coverage > Test description
Content: There is one NB-IoT cell (Ncell 1), which is the active cell, and an E-UTRA cell (Cell 1), in the test. Figure 7.3.62.4-1 shows the variation of the downlink SNR in the active cell to emulate out-of-sync and in-sync states. By measuring the reception of the NPUSCH, detection of out of sync and in sync requirements can be measured. In the test, DRX configuration is enabled and DRX inactivity timer has already been expired, i.e. UE tries to decode NPDCCH and to send NPUSCH during the period when On-duration timer is running. Time alignment timers shall be set to "infinity" so that UL timing alignment is maintained during the test. The test setup in each test during time durations T1, T2 and T3 are as follows: During the period from time point A to time point B, the SNR is decreasing linearly from SNR1 to SNR2. During the period from time point C to time point D, the SNR is increasing linearly from SNR2 to SNR1. During the period T3, the test system shall send the UE a grant to transmit in uplink. UE under test is expected to decode the uplink grant and switch to uplink and complete the uplink transmission. During the period from time point A to time point D, the UE shall not be provisioned with any UL grant. Thereafter UE switches back to downlink.

During T3 the SS shall send the UE continuous grants to transmit on the uplink. The UE is expected to decode the uplink grant, switch to uplink and complete the corresponding uplink transmission. If the SS detects uplink transmissions from the UE according to the subframes scheduled for NPUSCH transmission by the uplink grant, during the period from time point D until T3 expires, the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. Repeat steps 2-7 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync with DRX for Category NB1 In-Band mode in Normal Coverage > Test purpose
Content: The purpose of this test is to verify that the HD-FDD category NB1 UE configured in normal coverage properly detects the out of sync and in sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the NB-IoT Cell when DRX is used. This test will partly verify the HD-FDD radio link monitoring requirements in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.23.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync with DRX for Category NB1 In-Band mode in Normal Coverage > Test applicability
Content: This test case applies to all types of NB-IoT HD-FDD UE release 13 and forward of UE category NB1 and higher. Applicability requires support for FGI bit 5.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync with DRX for Category NB1 In-Band mode in Normal Coverage > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: When DRX is used for HD-FDD Category NB1 UEs, the Q evaluation period (T Q ) and the Q evaluation period (T Q ) is specified in Table 7.3.63.3-1 will be used. When the downlink radio link quality of the NB-IoT cell estimated over the last T Q period becomes worse than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send out-of-sync indication for the NB-IoT cell to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . When the downlink radio link quality of the NB-IoT cell estimated over the last T Q period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send in-sync indications for the NB-IoT cell to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the NB-IoT cell shall be performed as specified in clause 4.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.213 . Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least max(10ms, DRX_cycle_length). Upon start of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 , the UE shall monitor the link for recovery using the evaluation period and Layer 1 indication interval corresponding to the non-DRX mode until the expiry or stop of T310 timer. The transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 . Evaluation Period in DRX for HD-FDD Category NB1 UE The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.23.2 and A.7.3.63.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync with DRX for Category NB1 In-Band mode in Normal Coverage > Test description
Content: There is one NB-IoT cell (Ncell 1), which is the active cell, and an E-UTRA cell (Cell 1), in the test. The test consists of three successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2 and T3 respectively, excluding the transition time duration dT, where the SNR increases or decreases gradually in small steps. Figure 7.3.63.4-1 shows the variation of the downlink SNR in the active cell to emulate out-of-sync and in-sync states. Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to Ncell 1. The UE is scheduled in designated uplink subframes to transmit NPUSCH, which is received by the test equipment. By measuring the reception of the NPUSCH, detection of out of sync and in sync requirements can be measured. In the test, DRX configuration is enabled and DRX inactivity timer has already been expired, i.e. UE tries to decode NPDCCH and to send NPUSCH during the period when On-duration timer is running. Time alignment timers shall be set to "infinity" so that UL timing alignment is maintained during the test. The test setup in each test during time durations T1, T2 and T3 are as follows: During the period from time point A to time point B, the SNR is decreasing linearly from SNR1 to SNR2. During the period from time point C to time point D, the SNR is increasing linearly from SNR2 to SNR1. During the period T3, the test system shall send the UE a grant to transmit in uplink. UE under test is expected to decode the uplink grant and switch to uplink and complete the uplink transmission. During the period from time point A to time point D, the UE shall not be provisioned with any UL grant. Thereafter UE switches back to downlink.

Ncell bandwidth is as specified in Table 7.3.63.5-1. There are two cells specified in this test. Ncell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test. Cell 1 is an E-UTRA cell.

The UE shall not be provisioned with any more UL grants until the start of time period T4. Starting at point C, the SNR is increased in small steps from SNR3 to SNR1 with dT At the start of the time period T4, the UE will be provided with another UL grant with NPDCCH NOTE 3: The UE is not expected to decode the UL grant and conduct any UL transmission during T4, since the UE is expected to declare RLF during T3. Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync without DRX for UE Category NB1 Standalone mode in Normal Coverage > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to Ncell 1. The UE is scheduled in every possible uplink subframe to transmit NPUSCH, which is received by the test equipment. Ensure the UE is in State 2A-NB according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 8.1.5. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 7.3.66.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1.1. T1 starts. When T1 expires, the 1st time window dT starts. During dT the SS shall change the SNR towards the SNR value as specified in Table 7.3.66.5-1. When dT expires the SS shall keep the SNR value corresponding to T2 as specified in Table 7.3.66.5-1. T2 starts. At the start of T2 the UE shall be provided with a UL grant on NPDCCH. The UE shall decode NPDCCH and complete the UL transmission, according to the UL grant, before T2 expires. If the UL transmission is not completed the number of failed test is increased by one, if so restart test from step 1. No more UL grants are given until start of T4. When T2 expires, the 2nd time window dT starts. During dT the SS shall change the SNR towards the SNR value as specified in Table 7.3.66.5-1. When dT expires the SS shall keep the SNR value corresponding to T3 as specified in Table 7.3.66.5-1. T3 starts. During T3 the UE is expected to detect OOS and declare RLM. When T3 expires, the 3rd time window dT starts. During dT the SS shall change the SNR towards the SNR value as specified in Table 7.3.66.5-1. When dT expires the SS shall keep the SNR value corresponding to T4 as specified in Table 7.3.66.5-1. T4 starts. At the start of T4 the UE shall be provided with another UL grant on NPDCCH. If the SS detects uplink power equal to or higher than -48.2dBm in the uplink subframe scheduled to transmit NPUSCH during the period T4 the number of failed tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of successful tests is increased by one. After T4 expires the UE is switched off and then on. Ensure the UE is in State 2A-NB according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 8.1.5. Repeat steps 2-12 for all subtests until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync without DRX for UE Category NB1 Standalone mode in Normal Coverage > Test description > Message contents
Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 8.1.6 and clause 8.1.4.3 using condition "Standalone" with the following exceptions: 7.3.66.5 Test requirement The UE behaviours in each test shall be as follows: The UE shall complete the NPUSCH transmission during T2 according to the received UL grant; The UE shall not conduct any NPUSCH transmission during T4 A correct event is defined as UE behaves correctly in all above steps. The correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\%.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync without DRX for UE Category NB1 guard band mode in Enhanced Coverage > Test description
Content: There is one NB-IoT cell (Ncell 1), which is the active cell, and one E-UTRA cell in the test. The test consists of four successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2, T3 and T4 respectively, excluding the transition time duration dT, where the SNR increases or decreases gradually in small steps. Figure 7.3.67.4-1 shows the variation of the downlink SNR in the active cell to emulate out-of-sync state. Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to Ncell 1. The UE is scheduled in every possible uplink subframe to transmit NPUSCH, which is received by the test equipment. By measuring the reception of the NPUSCH, detection of out of sync requirements can be measured. In the test, DRX configuration is disabled. Time alignment timers shall be set to "infinity" so that UL timing alignment is maintained during the test. The test setup in each test during time durations T1, T2, T3 and T4 are as follows: Starting at point A, the SNR is decreased in small steps from SNR1 to SNR2 within dT At the start of the time duration T2, the UE is provided with a UL grant with NPDCCH NOTE 1: The UE is expected to decode the NPDCCH and complete the UL transmission during T2 according to the UL grant. The UE shall not be provisioned with any more UL grants until the start of time period T4. Starting at point B, the SNR is decreased in small steps from SNR2 to SNR3 within dT During T3, the SNR is kept as SNR3 NOTE 2: The UE is expected to detect OOS and declare RLF during T3. Starting at point C, the SNR is increased in small steps from SNR3 to SNR1 with dT At the start of the time period T4, the UE will be provided with another UL grant with NPDCCH NOTE 3: The UE is not expected to decode the UL grant and conduct any UL transmission during T4, since the UE is expected to declare RLF during T3. T1 SNR1 SNR2 A B Qout Qin SNR3 C D T2 T3 T4 dT dT dT 7.3.67.4.1 Initial conditions Test Environment: Normal, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 8.1.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-4 and TS 36.508 clauses 8.1.4.2 and 8.1.3.1. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: E-UTRA Bandwidth is 10 MHz, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1.1, except for bands within band group FDD_N where 5 MHz bandwidth is used. Ncell bandwidth is as specified in Table 7.3.67.5-1. Connect the SS (node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A, Figure A.10 using only main Tx/Rx antenna and without faders. The general test parameter settings are set up according to Table 7.3.67.4.1-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 7.3.67.4.3. There are two cells specified in this test. Ncell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test. Cell 1 is a EUTRAN cell.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Early Out-of-sync reporting Test for CE UE in CEMode A
Content: Editor's note: This test case is incomplete. The following aspects are either missing or not yet determined: - Minimum conformance requirements contain square brackets (RAN4 dependant)
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Early Out-of-sync reporting Test for CE UE in CEMode A > Test purpose
Content: The purpose of this test is to verify that the HD-FDD CE UE configured in CEModeA properly detects an early out of sync event and makes correct reporting of it for the purpose of monitoring the downlink radio link quality of the PCell in CEModeA. This test will partly verify the E-UTRAN FDD radio link monitoring requirements for Cat-M1 UE defined in clause 7.19 in 36.133 .
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Early Out-of-sync reporting Test for CE UE in CEMode A > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA HD-FDD CE UE, including both BL and non-BL CE UEs.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Early Out-of-sync reporting Test for CE UE in CEMode A > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: Editor's note: The test requirements in this section refer explicitly to Category M1, but they are applicable to Category M2 and non-BL/CE UEs. Pending discussion in RAN4 is needed to update the wording. The UE category CAT-M1 applicability of the requirements for performing radio link monitoring is defined in Section 3.6 of 3GPP TS 36.133 . UE configured with rlm-ReportConfig has to - Estimate the downlink radio link quality and compare it to the thresholds Q and Q for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the PCell. The threshold Q is defined as the level at which the downlink radio link cannot be reliably received and shall correspond to \% block error rate of a hypothetical MPDCCH transmission with transmission parameters specified in Table 7.19.2-2. The threshold Q is defined as the level at which the downlink radio link quality can be significantly more reliably received than at Q and shall correspond to \% block error rate of a hypothetical MPDCCH transmission with transmission parameters specified in Table 7.19.2-2. When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last T Q period becomes worse than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send an out-of-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the out-of-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last T Q period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall send an in-sync indication for the PCell to the higher layers within T Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the in-sync indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the PCell shall be performed as specified in clause 4.2.1 in . Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least max(10ms, r *G). The transmitter power of the UE shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer as specified in clause 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331 . T Q = 5*r *G ms and T Q = 5*r *G ms, provided the below conditions are met, where r *G is MPDCCH monitoring cycle length and parameters r and G are as specified in : r *G $ $ 80 ms, and G 1, and UE is not receiving PDSCH, otherwise T Q = 400 ms and T Q = 200 ms. A UE configured with rlm-ReportConfig has to additionally meet the following requirements When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last Q evaluation period becomes worse than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall trigger event E1 and send a report to the higher layers within Q evaluation period. A Layer 3 filter shall be applied to the E1 event indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . When the downlink radio link quality of the PCell estimated over the last Q period becomes better than the threshold Q , Layer 1 of the UE shall trigger event E2 and send a report to the higher layers within Q evaluation period. A L3 filter shall be applied to the event E2 indications as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.19.3.1 and A.7.3.69.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Early Out-of-sync reporting Test for CE UE in CEMode A > Test description
Content: There is one cell (cell 1), which is the active cell, in the test. The test consists of three successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2 and T3 respectively. Figure 7.3.69.-1 shows the variation of the downlink SNR in the active cell to emulate early out-of-sync and early in-sync states. Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. In the test, the RRC parameter numberPRB-Pairs is set to 6 and the RRC parameter mPDCCH-NumRepetition is set to 8. In addition, the UE is configured with rlm-ReportConfig. UE shall successfully complete the RRC reconfiguration accordingly prior to the start of time duration T1.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Early Out-of-sync reporting Test for CE UE in CEMode A > Test description > Initial conditions
Content: Test Environment: Normal, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: 10 MHz as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1. Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Early Out-of-sync reporting Test for CE UE in CEMode A > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to cell 1. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF-CE with the condition CEModeA according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3AA. SS sends a RRC Reconfiguration message configuring M-PDCCH aggregation level and M-PDCCH repetition level as defined in Table 7.3.69.4.1-1 and configuration to detect early-out-of-sync. UE successfully responds with RRC Reconfiguration Complete message. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 7.3.69.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1. T1 starts. When T1 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T2 as specified in Table 7.3.69.5-1. T2 starts. When T2 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T3 as specified in Table 7.3.69.5-1. T3 starts. If UE transmits UEAssistanceInformation indicating detection of the early-out-of-sync within Q time period, then the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise the number of failed tests is increased by one. When T3 expires the SS shall change the SNR value to T1 as specified in Table 7.3.69.5-1. If the UE has not re-established the connection in at least 1s, the UE is switched off and then on. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF-CE with CEModeA activated according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3AA. Repeat steps 2-8 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > E-UTRAN HD-FDD Early Out-of-sync reporting Test for CE UE in CEMode A > Test description > Message contents
Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.6 with the following exceptions: 7.3.69.5 Test requirement Tables 7.3.69.4.1-1 and 7.3.69.5-1 define the primary level settings including test tolerances. The UE shall compare the downlink radio link quality of the PCell over the last Q evaluation, which is defined in 7.19.3.1, with the threshold Q . When the estimated quality becomes worse than the threshold starting from time point B, Layer 1 of the UE shall trigger event E1 and send a report to the higher layers within Q evaluation period. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\% with the confidence level of 95\%.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Radio Link Monitoring > TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync with DRX for UE Category NB1 In-Band mode in Enhanced Coverage > Test requirement

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Interruption for Dual Connectivity > E-UTRAN FDD-FDD DC interruption at transitions between active and non-active during DRX in synchronous DC > Test purpose
Content: To verify Dual Connectivity UE's ability to complete PCELL interruption during PSCell DRX transitions within the missed ACK/NACK rate for FDD PCell in dual connectivity requirements.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Interruption for Dual Connectivity > E-UTRAN FDD-FDD DC interruption at transitions between active and non-active during DRX in synchronous DC > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 12 and forward that supports Dual Connectivity. Applicability requires support for FGI bit 5.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Interruption for Dual Connectivity > E-UTRAN FDD-FDD DC interruption at transitions between active and non-active during DRX in synchronous DC > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: When PCell is in non-DRX and PSCell is in DRX, interruptions on PCell and the activated SCell in MCG if configured due to transitions from active to non-active and from non-active to active during PSCell DRX are allowed with up to 1 \% probability of missed ACK/NACK when the configured PSCell DRX cycle is less than 640 ms, and 0.625 \% probability of missed ACK/NACK is allowed when the configured PSCell DRX cycle is 640 ms or longer. Each interruption shall not exceed 1 subframe.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Interruption for Dual Connectivity > E-UTRAN FDD-FDD DC interruption at transitions between active and non-active during DRX in synchronous DC > Test description > Initial conditions
Content: Test Environment: Normal, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E Table E-1 and 3GPP TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: The largest aggregated bandwidth combination supported by UE from Table 7.4.1.5 1 as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause [4.3.1] for different DC configurations (per band) as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 5.4.2. Connect the SS (node B emulator) and faders to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A, Figure A.14 as appropriate. The general test parameter settings are set up according to Table 7.4.1.4.1-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 7.4.1.4.3. There are two E-UTRA FDD carriers and two cells in the test. Cell 1 is PCell on the primary component carrier, Cell 2 is PSCell on the secondary component carrier, Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power levels set according to clauses C.0 and C.1 for this test.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Interruption for Dual Connectivity > E-UTRAN FDD-FDD DC interruption at transitions between active and non-active during DRX in synchronous DC > Test description > Test procedure
Content: The test consists of two cells: Cell1 and Cell2. Cell1 is PCell and Cell2 is PSCell. PCell is continuously scheduled in DL while PSCell is not scheduled and has DRX configured. The test consists of one time period, with duration of T1. Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to Cell1 and Cell2. Cell1 shall be configured as PCell and Cell2 shall be configured as PSCell. Prior to start of T1 the DRX inactivity timer for the PSCell have already expired. During T1 the UE shall be continuously scheduled on PCell while not scheduled on PSCell: Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF-DC1 according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3A. Configure MCG and SCG according to Annex C.0, C.1 for all downlink physical channels. The SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to configure PCell (Cell1) and PSCell (Cell2) on the MCG and SCG as per 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3A with the message content exceptions defined in clause 7.4.1.4.3. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. The SS would ensure continuous transmission on PCell, while not scheduling on PSCell at least for 200 ms to ensure inactivity timer is expired on the UE for PSCell. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 7.4.1.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to clause B.1.1. T1 starts. SS schedules on PCell continuously and UE shall start sending ACK/NACK reports. The SS shall monitor ACK/NACK/DTX on PCell. If more than 99\% of uplink transmissions are received by SS then count a success for the event "ACK/NACK". Otherwise count a fail for the event "ACK/NACK". If no two consecutive DTX is observed by the SS, then count a success for the event "DTX". Otherwise count a fail for the event "DTX". After the RRC connection release, the SS: transmits in Cell 1 a Paging message (including PagingRecord with UE-Identity) for the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.5.3A (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF-DC1 according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3A); or switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF-DC1 according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3A. Repeat step 3-9 until a test verdict has been achieved Each of the events "ACK/NACK" and "DTX" is evaluated independently for the statistic, resulting in an event verdict: pass or fail. Each event is evaluated only until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in clause G.2 is achieved. Different events may require different times for a verdict. If all events pass, the test passes. If one event fails, the test fails.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Interruption for Dual Connectivity > E-UTRAN FDD-FDD DC interruption at transitions between active and non-active during DRX in synchronous DC > Test description > Message contents
Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.6 with the following exceptions: Table 7.4.1.4.3-2: RRCConnectionReconfiguration: Additional E-UTRAN FDD-FDD DC interruption at transitions between active and non-active during DRX in synchronous DC requirements 7.4.1.5 Test requirement Table 7.4.1.4.1-1 and 7.4.1.5-1 define the primary level settings including test tolerances for E-UTRAN FDD-FDD DC interruption at transitions between active and non-active during DRX in synchronous cells test. The UE shall be continuously scheduled in PCell during the entire length of T1. UE shall not be scheduled in PSCell during T1. During the time duration T1 the UE shall transmit at least 99\% of ACK/NACK on PCell. The UE shall not miss transmitting two consecutive ACK/NACK. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\%.

Content: When PCell is in non-DRX and PSCell is in DRX, interruptions on PCell and the activated SCell in MCG if configured due to transitions from active to non-active and from non-active to active during PSCell DRX are allowed with up to 1 \% probability of missed ACK/NACK when the configured PSCell DRX cycle is less than 640 ms, and 0.625 \% probability of missed ACK/NACK is allowed when the configured PSCell DRX cycle is 640 ms or longer. Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Interruption for Dual Connectivity > E-UTRAN FDD-FDD Interruption at transitions between active and non-active during DRX in asynchronous dual connectivity > Test Description > Test procedure
Content: The test consists of two cells: Cell1 and Cell2. Cell1 is PCell and Cell2 is PSCell. PCell is continuously scheduled in DL while PSCell is not scheduled and has DRX configured. The test consists of one time period, with duration of T1. Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to Cell1 and Cell2. Cell1 shall be configured as PCell and Cell2 shall be configured as PSCell. Prior to start of T1 the DRX inactivity timer for the PSCell has already expired. During T1 the UE shall be continuously scheduled on PCell while not scheduled on PSCell: Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF-DC1 according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3A. Configure MCG and SCG according to Annex C.0, C.1 for all downlink physical channels. The SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to configure PCell (Cell1) and PSCell (Cell2) on the MCG and SCG as per TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3A with the message content exceptions defined in clause 7.4.4.3. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. The SS would ensure continuous transmission on PCell, while not scheduling on PSCell at least for 200 ms to ensure inactivity timer is expired on the UE for PSCell. 5a. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 7.4.3.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B.1.1. T1 starts. SS schedules on PCell continuously and UE shall start sending ACK/NACK reports. The SS shall monitor ACK/NACK/DTX on PCell. If more than 99\% of uplink transmissions are received by SS then count a success for the event "ACK/NACK". Otherwise count a fail for the event "ACK/NACK". If no two consecutive DTX is observed by the SS, then count a success for the event "DTX". Otherwise count a fail for the event "DTX". After the RRC connection release, the SS: transmits in Cell 1 a Paging message (including PagingRecord with UE-Identity) for the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.5.3A (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF-DC1 according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3A); or switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF-DC1 according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3A. Repeat step 3-9 until a test verdict has been achieved. Each of the events "ACK/NACK" and "DTX" is evaluated independently for the statistic, resulting in an event verdict: pass or fail. Each event is evaluated only until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in Annex G.2 is achieved. Different events may require different times for a verdict. If all events pass, the test passes. If one event fails, the test fails.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Proximity-based Services > E-UTRAN FDD - Interruptions due to ProSe Direct Discovery > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE FFS.
Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Proximity-based Services > E-UTRAN FDD - Interruptions due to ProSe Direct Discovery > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: For this test, the UE is triggered by the test loop function or the upper layers to monitor ProSe Direct Discovery. The test parameters are given in Table 7.5.3.3-1 and Table 7.5.3.3-2 below. There is one active cell (PCell) in this test and 24 active Sidelink transmissions in this test (with 12 active Sidelink UEs per configured discovery subframe). Two tests (Test 1 and Test 2) are defined to verify interruptions due to synchronous (Test 1) and asynchronous (Test 2) ProSe Direct Discovery. The tests consist of three successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2 and T3 respectively. During T1, the UE is in RRC_IDLE and monitoring the ProSe Direct Discovery announcements from other active Sidelink UEs on the ProSe Direct Discovery resources. During T2, the test system establishes a RRC connection with the UE. No PDSCH traffic is scheduled for UE during T2, and the UE is expected to transmit SidelinkUEInformation indicating discRxInterest during T2. On reception of SidelinkUEInformation, the test system shall RRC reconfiguration message to the UE and wait for the UE to respond with RRC reconfiguration complete message before transitioning to T3. If the UE does not transmit SidelinkUEInformation for up to sec, the test system shall transition to T3. During T3, the UE is scheduled with PDSCH traffic on PCell downlink. The test system will count the missed ACK/NACKs during T3 to verify the allowed interruptions during ProSe Direct Discovery. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.16.3.1 and A.7.5.3.

Title Path: Timing and Signalling Characteristic > Proximity-based Services > E-UTRAN FDD - Interruptions due to ProSe Direct Discovery > Test description > Test procedure
Content: There is one active cell (PCell) in this test and 24 active Sidelink transmissions in this test (with 12 active Sidelink UEs per configured discovery subframe). Two tests (Test 1 and Test 2) are defined to verify interruptions due to synchronous (Test 1) and asynchronous (Test 2) ProSe Direct Discovery. Ensure the UE is in FFS according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause FFS. Set the parameters according to Test 1 time period T1 in Tables 7.5.3.5-1, as appropriate. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1.1. UE is in idle mode in T1 and is monitoring ProSe Direct Discovery announcements from other active Sidelink UEs. On the expiry of T1, TE pages the UE and establishes a RRC Connection with the UE. TE doesn't schedule any PDSCH traffic to the UE. UE is expected to send a Sidelink UEInformation indicating discRxInterest, upon reception, TE is expected to send a RRC Connection reconfiguration message to the UE. Once the UE sends RRC reconfiguration complete message or secs have elapsed after start of T2, start T3. During T3, TE schedules PDSCH traffic on PCell and counts ACK/NACK and record the same. For Test 1, at least 98.75\% of all expected ACK/NACKs during T3 shall be transmitted by the ProSe UE. For Test 2, at least 97.5\% of all expected ACK/NACKs during T3 shall be transmitted by the ProSe UE. Repeat steps 1 to 8 for Test 2. A UE is considered pass if it meets the test requirements defined in 7.5.3.5 for both Test 1 and Test 2.
