The purpose of this test is to verify that the UE correctly detects event W1 (WLAN becomes better than a threshold) for unknown cell (unknown neighbour AP) and event W3 (All WLAN inside WLAN mobility set becomes worse than a threshold) for known cell (serving AP) defined in 3GPP TS 36.331 within the requirements stated in clause 8.25.1.3.

Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > E-UTRAN FDD-WLAN measurements > E-UTRAN FDD-WLAN Event Triggered Reporting in non-DRX under AWGN > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: In the RRC_CONNECTED state when no DRX is used the measurement period for WLAN RSSI shall be T as defined in Table 8.25.1.3-1. The value of T depends upon whether the WLAN RSSI measurement is performed on the serving access point (AP) or on a neighbour AP and in case of the neighbour AP whether the neighbour AP is known or unknown to the UE: Measurement of known single neighbor AP is time-sensitive and is performed on the AP for which information about the operating channel is known to the UE; and Measurement of unknown neighbor AP is not time-sensitive and is performed on the AP for which information about the operating channel is not known to the UE. The UE shall be capable of performing WLAN RSSI measurements for certain minimum number of APs during T as defined in Table 8.25.1.3-1 provided that the beacon frame of the measured AP is available at the UE at least once every 102.4 ms. The UE physical layer shall be capable of reporting WLAN RSSI measurements to higher layers with the measurement period of T . The WLAN RSSI measurement accuracy for all measured access points shall be fulfilled according to the accuracy as specified in clause 5.1.16 of shall meet the performance requirement defined in . The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.1.2.4.19 and A.8.25.1.

Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN FDD-FS3 Activation and deactivation of known FS3 SCell with FDD PCell in non-DRX > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: The delay within which the UE shall be able to activate the deactivated LAA SCell depends upon the specified conditions. The requirements in this clause shall apply for E-UTRA carrier aggregation of one FDD PCell or one TDD PCell and one SCell following the frame structure type 3 . The delay within which the UE shall be able to activate the deactivated SCell depends upon the specified conditions. Upon receiving SCell activation command in subframe n, the UE shall be capable to transmit valid CSI report and apply actions related to the activation command as specified in for the SCell being activated no later than in subframe n+T , provided the following conditions are met for the SCell: During the period equal to max(5 measCycleSCell, 5 DRX cycles) before the reception of the SCell activation command: the UE has sent a valid measurement report for the SCell being activated and the SCell being activated remains detectable according to the cell identification conditions specified in clause 8.3.3.2 of , SCell being activated also remains detectable during the SCell activation delay according to the cell identification conditions specified in clause 8.3.3.2 of . T = 16 ms + T + (L+2) * T , where: T =6 ms is the DMTC duration , T is the periodicity of the DMTC , L is the number of times the discovery signal occasion is not available at the UE during the SCell activation time. Otherwise upon receiving the SCell activation command in subframe n, the UE shall be capable to transmit a valid CSI report and apply actions related to the activation command as specified in for the SCell being activated no later than in subframe n+T , provided the SCell can be successfully detected on the first attempt. In this case, Tactivate_basic_FS3 is defined as follows. T = 16 ms + T + (L+3) * T , where: T = 6 ms is the DMTC duration , T is the periodicity of the DMTC , L is the number of times the discovery signal occasion is not available at the UE during the SCell activation time. If there is no reference signal received for the CSI measurement over the delay corresponding to the minimum requirements specified above, then the UE shall report corresponding valid CSI for the activated SCell on the next available uplink reporting resource after receiving the reference signal. If there are no uplink resources for reporting the valid CSI in subframe n+T then the UE shall use the next available uplink resource for reporting the corresponding valid CSI. The valid CSI is based on the UE measurement and corresponds to any CQI value specified in with the exception of CQI index = 0 (out of range) provided: the conditions in clause 7.7 of are met over the entire SCell activation delay and the conditions for CQI reporting defined in clause 7.2.3 of are met. In addition to CSI reporting defined above, UE shall also apply other actions related to the activation command specified in for an SCell at the first opportunities for the corresponding actions once the SCell is activated. The PCell interruption specified in clause 7.8.2 of shall not occur before subframe n+5 and not occur after subframe n+9 when PCell belongs to E-UTRA FDD. The PCell interruption specified in clause 7.8.2 of shall not occur before subframe n+5 and not occur after subframe n+11 when PCell belongs to E-UTRA TDD. Starting from the subframe specified in clause 4.3 of and until the UE has completed the SCell activation, the UE shall send CSI with CQI index = 0 (out of range) if the UE has available uplink resources to report for the SCell. Upon receiving SCell deactivation command or upon expiry of the sCellDeactivationTimer in subframe n, the UE shall accomplish the deactivation actions specified in for the SCell being deactivated no later than in subframe n+8. The PCell interruption specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.8.2 shall not occur before subframe n+5 and not occur after subframe n+9 when PCell belongs to E-UTRA FDD. The PCell interruption specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.8.2 shall not occur before subframe n+5 and not occur after subframe n+11 when PCell belongs to E-UTRA TDD. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.7.10 and A.8.26.1.

Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN FDD-FS3 Activation and deactivation of known FS3 SCell with FDD PCell in non-DRX > Test description > Test procedure
Content: The test consists of three successive time periods, with duration of T1, T2 and T3, respectively. Before the test starts the UE is connected to Cell1 on radio channel 1 (PCC) but is not aware of Cell 2 on radio channel 2. The UE is only monitoring the PCC. Cell 1 has constant signal levels throughout the test, and Cell 2 transmits discovery signal with LBT model.The UE shall be continuously scheduled in the PCell throughout the whole test. During T2 the Test procedure requires the UE to send the first CSI report for SCell in a subframe (m+8), but also allows a subframe (m+10) if the subframe (m+8) was subject to interruption. The SS determines whether the CSI report in subframe (m+8) was interrupted or not by monitoring ACK/NACK sent in PCell in subframe (m+8). Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 8.26.1.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.1.1 and B.2.2. T1 starts. Configure SCC according to Annex C.0, C.1 for all downlink physical channels. The SS shall configure SCell (Cell 2) on the SCC as per 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.4 with the message content exceptions defined in clause 8.26.1.4.3. The SS shall configure transmission of PDSCH with a maximum number of 1 HARQ transmission. The SS activates SCell by sending the activation MAC-CE (Refer TS 36.321 , clauses 5.13, 6.1.3.8) in a subframe \# denoted m which is an even number. If the SS receives ACK for MAC-CE sent by the UE, T2 starts in subframe m, and the test proceeds to step 7, otherwise go to step 10. The UE shall start sending CSI reports for SCell and the SS shall monitor CSI reports for SCell1 sent from the UE and ACK/NACK sent in PCell during SCell activation. If the first CSI report for SCell is received by the SS in a subframe (m+8), or (m+10) if the subframe (m+8) was subject to interruption, and CSI report with non-zero CQI index is received by the SS earlier than or equal to subframe (m+ T ), or the next available uplink resource if there are no uplink resources for reporting the valid CSI in a subframe (m+ T ) and DTX is not observed by the SS anywhere outside the subframes (m+5) to (m+13) up to the end of T2, and $ $2 non-consecutive DTX subframes are observed by the SS anywhere during the subframes (m+5) to (m+13) up to the end of T2, Then the number of successes for the event "Activation" is increased by one. Otherwise, count a fail for the event "Activation" and go to step 10. When T2 expires, the SS deactivate SCell by sending the deactivation MAC-CE (Refer TS 36.321 , clauses 5.13, 6.1.3.8) in a subframe \# denoted n which is an even number. If the SS receives ACK for MAC-CE sent by the UE, T3 starts in subframe n, and the test proceeds to step 9, otherwise go to step 10. The UE shall stop sending CSI reports for SCell and the SS shall monitor CSI reports for SCell sent from the UE and ACK/NACK sent in PCell during SCell1 deactivation. If the last CSI report is received by the SS earlier than or equal to subframe (n+8), and $ $2 inconsecutive DTX subframes are observed by the SS anywhere during the subframes (n+5) to (n+13) up to the end of T3 Then the number of successes for the event "Deactivation" is increased by one. Otherwise, count a fail for the event "Deactivation". When T3 expires, or Activation in step 6 was not acknowledged, or a fail was counted for the event "Activation" in step 7, or Deactivation in step 8 was not acknowledged, the SS shall transmit a RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources. Set Cell 2 physical cell identity = ((current cell 2 physical cell identity + 1) mod 14 + 2) for next iteration of the test procedure loop. After the RRC connection release, the SS: transmits in Cell 1 a Paging message (including PagingRecord with UE-Identity) for the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.5.3A (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3); or switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Repeat steps 2-12 until a test verdict has been achieved. Each of the events "Activation" and "Deactivation" is evaluated independently for the statistic, resulting in an event verdict: pass or fail. Each event is evaluated only until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in Annex G.2 is achieved. Different events may require different times for a verdict. If all events pass, the test passes. If one event fails, the test fails.
Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN FDD-FS3 Activation and deactivation of known FS3 SCell with FDD PCell in non-DRX > Test description > Message contents
Content: 8.26.1.5 Test requirement Table 8.26.1.4.1-1 and Table 8.26.1.5-1 define the primary level settings including test tolerances for E-UTRAN FDD activation and deactivation of known LAA SCell in non-DRX test. During T2 the UE shall send the first CSI report for SCell in a subframe (m+8), or in a subframe (m+10) if the suframe (m+8) was subject to interruption. Whether CSI report in subframe (m+8) was interrupted or not is checked by monitoring ACK/NACK sent in PCell in subframe (m+8). During T3 the UE shall stop sending CSI reports for SCell at latest in a subframe (n+8). During T2 interruption of PCell during SCell activation shall not happen outside the subframes (m+5) to (m+9). Figures 8.26.1.5-1 and 8.26.1.5-2 show the deriviation of the Test procedure requreiment for DTX during T2, based on the core requirements for interruption. The applicable figure is selected according to the CA configuration. NOTE: The differences between activation and deactivation are as follows: Activation 🡺 Deactivation First CSI 🡺 Last CSI Latest valid CSI report 🡺 Not exist (no need to check since CSI report was already stopped) Activation command for SCell ACK for MAC-CE for SCell activation Possible interruption period by SCell activation Allowed interruption timing (1 subframe in m+5 +9) on UE by SCell activation That is, possible DTX timing on SS First CSI report timing (could be invalid CQI) at m+8 (might be m+10 due to interruption) Corresponding DTX timing on PUCCH by allowed interruption timing by SCell activation Possible DTX reception period on SS due to interruption by SCell1 activation During T3 interruption of PCell during SCell deactivation shall not happen outside the subframes (n+5) to (n+9). Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN TDD-FS3 Activation and deactivation of known FS3 SCell with TDD PCell in non-DRX > Test description > Test procedure
Content: The test consists of three successive time periods, with duration of T1, T2 and T3, respectively. Before the test starts the UE is connected to Cell1 on radio channel 1 (PCC) but is not aware of Cell 2 on radio channel 2. The UE is only monitoring the PCC. Cell 1 has constant signal levels throughout the test, and Cell 2 transmits discovery signal with LBT model. The UE shall be continuously scheduled in the PCell throughout the whole test. During T2 the Test procedure requires the UE to send the first CSI report for SCell in a subframe (m+8), or in a subframe (m+9) if the subframe (m+8) was subject to interruption, or in a subframe (m+13) if the subframes (m+8) and (m+9) were subject to interruption. The SS determines whether the CSI report was interrupted or not by monitoring ACK/NACK sent in PCell at the same time as the first CSI report. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 8.26.2.4.1-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.0. T1 starts. The SS shall configure SCell (Cell 2) on the SCC as per 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.4 with the message content exceptions defined in clause 8.26.2.4.3. The SS shall configure transmission of PDSCH with a maximum number of 1 HARQ transmission. The SS activates SCell by sending the activation MAC-CE (Refer TS 36.321 , clauses 5.13, 6.1.3.8) in a subframe \# denoted m which is an even number. If the SS receives ACK for MAC-CE sent by the UE, T2 starts in subframe m, and the test proceeds to step 6, otherwise go to step 9. The UE shall start sending CSI reports for SCell and the SS shall monitor CSI reports for SCell sent from the UE and ACK/NACK sent in PCell during SCell activation. If the first CSI report for SCell1 is received by the SS in a subframe (m+8), or (m+9) if the subframe (m+8) was subject to interruption and CSI report with non-zero CQI index is received by the SS earlier than or equal to subframe (m+ T ), or the next available uplink resource if there are no uplink resources for reporting the valid CSI in a subframe (m+ T ) and DTX or "NACK/DTX" (defined in 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 10.1) are not observed by the SS anywhere outside the subframes (m+5), (m+9) up to the end of T2, or DTX or "NACK/DTX" (defined in 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 10.1) are not observed by the SS outside the subframes (m+6), (m+13) up to the end of T2, or DTX or "NACK/DTX" (defined in 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 10.1) are not observed by the SS outside the subframes (m+7), (m+13) up to the end of T2, or DTX or "NACK/DTX" (defined in 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 10.1) are not observed by the SS outside the subframe (m+8) up to the end of T2, or DTX or "NACK/DTX" (defined in 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 10.1) are not observed by the SS outside the subframe (m+9) up to the end of T2, or DTX or "NACK/DTX" (defined in 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 10.1) are not observed by the SS outside the subframes (m+10), (m+14) up to the end of T2, or DTX or "NACK/DTX" (defined in 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 10.1) are not observed by the SS outside the subframes (m+11), (m+18) up to the end of T2, Then the number of successes for the event "Activation" is increased by one. Otherwise, count a fail for the event "Activation" and go to step 9. When T2 expires, the SS deactivate SCell by sending the deactivation MAC-CE (Refer TS 36.321 , clauses 5.13, 6.1.3.8) in a subframe \# denoted n which is an even number. If the SS receives ACK for MAC-CE sent by the UE, T3 starts in subframe n, and the test proceeds to step 8, otherwise go to step 9. The UE shall stop sending CSI reports for SCell and the SS shall monitor CSI reports for SCell sent from the UE and ACK/NACK sent in PCell during SCell deactivation. If the last CSI report is received by the SS earlier than or equal to subframe (n+8), and DTX or "NACK/DTX" (defined in 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 10.1) are not observed by the SS anywhere outside the subframes (n+5), (n+9) up to the end of T3, or either DTX or "NACK/DTX" (defined in 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 10.1) are not observed by the SS outside the subframes (n+6), (n+13) up to the end of T3, or either DTX or "NACK/DTX" (defined in 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 10.1) are not observed by the SS outside the subframes (n+7), (n+13) up to the end of T3, or either DTX or "NACK/DTX" (defined in 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 10.1) are not observed by the SS outside the subframes (n+8) up to the end of T3, or either DTX or "NACK/DTX" (defined in 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 10.1) are not observed by the SS outside the subframes (n+9) up to the end of T3, or either DTX or "NACK/DTX" (defined in 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 10.1) are not observed by the SS outside the subframes (n+10), (n+14) up to the end of T3, or either DTX or "NACK/DTX" (defined in 3GPP TS 36.213 clause 10.1) are not observed by the SS outside the subframes (n+11), (n+18) up to the end of T3, Then the number of successes for the event "Deactivation" is increased by one. Otherwise, count a fail for the event "Deactivation". When T3 expires, or Activation in step 5 was not acknowledged, or a fail was counted for the event "Activation" in step 6, or Deactivation in step 7 was not acknowledged, the SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources. Set Cell 2 physical cell identity = ((current cell 2 physical cell identity + 1) mod 14 + 2) for next iteration of the test procedure loop. After the RRC connection release, the SS: transmits in Cell 1 a Paging message (including PagingRecord with UE-Identity) for the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.5.3A (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3); or switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Repeat steps 2-11 until a test verdict has been achieved. Each of the events "Activation" and "Deactivation" is evaluated independently for the statistic, resulting in an event verdict: pass or fail. Each event is evaluated only until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in Annex G.2 is achieved. Different events may require different times for a verdict. If all events pass, the test passes. If one event fails, the test fails.

Content: Table 8.26.2.4.1-1 and Table 8.26.2.5-1 define the primary level settings including test tolerances for E-UTRAN TDD activation and deactivation of known LAA SCell in non-DRX test. During T2 the UE shall send the first CSI report for SCell in a subframe (m+8), or in a subframe (m+9) if the subframe (m+8) was subject to interruption, or in a subframe (m+13) if the subframes (m+8) and (m+9) were subject to interruption when an intra-band SCell is activated. NOTE: During T2 if there are no uplink resources for reporting the valid CSI in a subframe (m+ T )ms, L is the number of times the discovery signal occasion is not available at the UE during the SCell activation time, then the UE shall use the next available uplink resource for reporting the corresponding valid CSI. Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN FDD-FS3 Event triggered reporting on deactivated FS3 SCell and FDD PCell interruption in non-DRX > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: When no DRX is in use the UE shall be able to identify a new detectable cell on a secondary component carrier within the cell identification time T , where the cell identification of a cell shall include detection of the cell and additionally performing a single measurement with measurement period of T . T is the time period for cell identification as specified in Table 8.26.3.3-1, T is the time period for measurements as shown in Table 8.26.3.3-2, T is the discovery signal measurement timing configuration periodicity of higher layer, L is the number of configured discovery signal occasions which are not available during T for cell identification at the UE due to the absence of the necessary radio signals from the cell, M is the number of configured discovery signal occasions which are not available during T for the measurements at the UE due to the absence of the necessary radio signals from the cell. The requirements in this clause apply, provided that L and M are such that: the cell identification period T does not exceed 75*measCycleSCell, and the time period T for measurements does not exceed 60*measCycleSCell. A cell shall be considered detectable when the following conditions are met during the discovery signal occasions which are available during T : RSRP related side condition given in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.19 are fulfilled for a corresponding Band, SCH_RP is according to 3GPP TS 36.133 Annex B.2.12 for a corresponding Band and SCH \^ E s/Iot is according to Table 8.26.3.3-1. The measurement period for deactivated SCell measurements is T according to the parameter measCycleSCell shown in Table 8.26.3.3-2. The UE shall be capable of performing RSRP and RSRQ measurements for 2 identified cells on a secondary component carrier, and the UE physical layer shall be capable of reporting measurements to higher layers within the measurement period of T . The measurement accuracy for all measured cells shall be as specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.19. A UE may reconfigure the receiver bandwidth or turn on/off one of the RF chains when performing measurements on one SCC with deactivated SCell. This may cause interruptions on PCell that are specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.8. Reported measurements contained in event triggered measurement reports shall meet the requirements in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9. The UE shall not send any event triggered measurement reports, as long as no reporting criteria are fulfilled. The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between an event that will trigger a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface. This requirement assumes that the measurement report is not delayed by other RRC signalling on the DCCH. This measurement reporting delay excludes a delay uncertainty resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH. The delay uncertainty is: 2 x TTI . This measurement reporting delay excludes a delay which is caused by no UL resources for UE to send the measurement report or by the LBT procedure performed by the UE in order to determine that the channel is clear for performing uplink transmission. The event triggered measurement reporting delay, measured without L3 filtering shall be less than T defined in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.12.2.4.1. When L3 filtering is used or IDC autonomous denial is configured or LBT is performed by the UE on the carrier used for the measurement reporting an additional delay can be expected. If a cell which has been detectable at least for the time period T defined in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.12.2.4.1 becomes undetectable for a period $ $ 8 seconds and then the cell becomes detectable again and triggers an event, the event triggered measurement reporting delay shall be less than T provided the timing to that cell has not changed more than $ $ 50 Ts and the L3 filter has not been used. When L3 filtering is used or LBT is performed by the UE on the carrier used for the measurement reporting an additional delay can be expected. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clauses 8.12.2.4 and A.8.26.3.
Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN FDD-FS3 Event triggered reporting on deactivated FS3 SCell and FDD PCell interruption in non-DRX > Test description > Initial conditions
Content: Test Environment: Normal, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and 3GPP TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1 for different CA bandwidth classes. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: The largest aggregated bandwidth combination supported by UE from Table 8.26.3.5-1 as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1 for different CA configurations as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 5.4.2A. Connect the SS (node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A, Figure group A.41 as appropriate. The general test parameter settings are set up according to Table 8.26.3.4.1-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 8.26.3.4.3. Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN FDD-FS3 Event triggered reporting on deactivated FS3 SCell and FDD PCell interruption in non-DRX > Test description > Test procedure
Content: In the test there are three synchronous cells: Cell1, Cell2 and Cell3. Cell1 is PCell on the FDD primary component (RF Channel 1), Cell2 is deactivated SCell on the secondary component (RF Channel 2) for frame structure 3, and Cell3 is the neighbour cell on the secondary component (RF Channel 3) for frame structure 3. Cell 2 and Cell 3 transmit discovery signal with LBT model. In the measurement control information it is indicated to the UE that event-triggered reporting with Event A6 is used. The test consists of two successive time periods, with time durations of T1 and T2 respectively. During time duration T1, the UE shall not have any timing information of Cell 3. Starting T2, Cell 3 becomes detectable and the UE is expected to detect and send a measurement report. PCell is indicated by the network using IE allowInterruptions and PDCCH indicating a new transmission on the PCell shall be sent continuously to ensure that the UE sends ACK/ NACKs throughout the test. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Configure SCC according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for all downlink physical channels. The SS shall configure the SCell (Cell 2) on the SCC as per 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.4. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 8.16.3.5-1 as appropriate. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.1.1. T1 starts. The SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message with Event A6 configured. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the power setting from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 8.16.3.5-1. UE shall transmit a MeasurementReport message triggered by Event A6. If the overall delays measured from the beginning of time period T2 is less than 4002 + L* measCycleSCell ms and at least 99.5\% of all expected ACK/NACKS are detected by the system simulator from the start of T1 until the measurement report is received during T2 then the number of successful tests is increased by one. If the UE fails to report the event within the overall delays measured requirement or less than 99.5\% of all expected ACK/NACKS are detected by the system simulator then the number of failure tests is increased by one. After the SS receives the MeasurementReport message in step 8) or when T2 expires, the SS shall transmit RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources. Set Cell 3 physical cell identity = ((current cell 3 physical cell identity + 1) mod 14 + 2) for next iteration of the test procedure loop. If physical cell identity of Cell 3 = physical cell identity of Cell 2 then skip this physical cell identity value for Cell 3. After the RRC connection release, the SS: transmits in Cell 1 a Paging message (including PagingRecord with UE-Identity) for the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.5.3A (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3); or switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Repeat step 3-11 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.
Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN FDD-FS3 Event triggered reporting on deactivated FS3 SCell and FDD PCell interruption in non-DRX > Test description > Message contents
Content: 8.26.3.5 Test requirement Table 8.26.3.4.1-1 and Table 8.26.3.5-1 define the primary level settings including test tolerances for E-UTRAN FDD FDD Event triggered reporting on configured but deactivated SCell with PCell interruption in non-DRX test. The UE shall send one Event A6 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than 4 + L* measCycleSCell s from the beginning of time period T2, where L is the number of times the discovery signal occasion is not available at the UE during the Event A6 triggered measurement report time. The overall delays measured is defined as the time from the beginning of time period T2, to the moment the UE send one Event A6 triggered measurement report to Cell 3. The overall delays measured test requirement is expressed as: Overall delays measured = measurement reporting delay + TTI insertion uncertainty Measurement reporting delay = 4 + L* measCycleSCell s TTI insertion uncertainty = TTI = 1 ms; 2xTTI = 2 ms The overall delays measured shall be less than a total of 4002 + L* measCycleSCell ms in this test case (note: this gives a total of 4 s for measurement reporting delay plus 2 ms for TTI insertion uncertainty). The UE shall not send event triggered measurement reports, as long as the reporting criteria are not fulfilled. The UE shall be scheduled on PCell continuously throughout the test. From the start of T1 until the measurement report is received during T2, at least 99.5\% of all expected ACK/NACKs shall be transmitted by the UE. For a test to be considered successful requirements on both event detection and percentage of transmitted ACK/NACKs have to be fulfilled simultaneously. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\%. NOTE: The actual overall delays measured in the test may be up to 2xTTI higher than the measurement reporting delays above because of TTI insertion uncertainty of the measurement report in DCCH. 8.26.3A E-UTRAN FDD-FS3 3DL Event triggered reporting on deactivated FS3 SCell and FDD PCell interruption in non-DRX 8.26.3A.1 Test purpose To verify that the UE correctly detects event A6 (Neighbour becomes better than SCell) defined in 3GPP TS 36.331 within the requirements stated in clause 8.3.3.2.1 while at the same time fulfilling the requirement on interruption rate for multiple FS3 Scell. 8.26.3A.2 Test applicability This test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE FDD release 13 and forward that support LAA for more than one FS3 Scell. The general test parameter settings are set up according to Table 8.26.3A.4.1-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 8.26.3A.4.3. There are four E-UTRA FDD carriers with one cell on one E-UTRA FDD carrier and three cells on the other E-UTRA FDD carrier specified in the test. Cell1 is PCell on the FDD primary component (RF Channel 1), Cell2 is activated SCell on the secondary component (RF Channel 2) for frame structure 3, Cell3 is deactivated SCell on the secondary component (RF Channel 3) for frame structure 3, and Cell4 is the neighbour cell on the secondary component (RF Channel 3) for frame structure 3. PCell (Cell 1) is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test. Cell 2 and Cell 3 shall be powered OFF. 8.26.3A.4.2 Test procedure In the test there are three synchronous cells: Cell1, Cell2, Cell3 and Cell4. Cell1 is PCell on the FDD primary component (RF Channel 1), Cell2 is activated SCell on the secondary component (RF Channel 2) for frame structure 3, Cell3 is deactivated SCell on the secondary component (RF Channel 3) for frame structure 3, and Cell4 is the neighbour cell on the secondary component (RF Channel 3) for frame structure 3. Cell 2, Cell 3 and Cell 4 transmit discovery signal with LBT model. The test consists of two successive time periods, with duration of T1 and T2, respectively. During T1 the UE shall not have any information of cell 4. Immediately at beginning of T2 the transmission power of cell 4 is increased to same level as for cell 3, and due to usage of an offset this shall result in reporting of Event A6. PCell is indicated by the network using IE allowInterruptions and PDCCH indicating a new transmission on the PCell shall be sent continuously to ensure that the UE sends ACK/ NACKs throughout the test. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Configure all relevant SCC's according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for all downlink physical channels. The SS shall configure the SCell's (Cell 2, Cell 3) on the SCC's as per 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.4. Cell 2 is activated, while Cell 3 is de-activated. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 8.16.3.5-1 as appropriate. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.1.1. T1 starts. The SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message with Event A6 configured. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the power setting from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 8.26.3A.5-1. UE shall transmit a MeasurementReport message triggered by Event A6. If the overall delays measured from the beginning of time period T2 is less than 8002 ms and at least 99.5\% of all expected ACK/NACKS are detected by the system simulator from the start of T1 until the measurement report is received during T2 then the number of successful tests is increased by one. If the UE fails to report the event within the overall delays measured requirement or less than 99.5\% of all expected ACK/NACKS are detected by the system simulator then the number of failure tests is increased by one. After the SS receives the MeasurementReport message in step 8) or when T2 expires, the SS shall transmit RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources. Set Cell 3 physical cell identity = ((current cell 3 physical cell identity + 1) mod 14 + 2) for next iteration of the test procedure loop. If physical cell identity of Cell 3 = physical cell identity of Cell 2 then skip this physical cell identity value for Cell 3. After the RRC connection release, the SS: transmits in Cell 1 a Paging message (including PagingRecord with UE-Identity) for the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.5.3A (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3); or switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Repeat step 3-11 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved. 8.26.3A.4.3 Message contents 8.26.3A.5 Test requirement Table 8.26.3A.4.1-1 and Table 8.26.3A.5-1 define the primary level settings including test tolerances for E-UTRAN FDD FDD Event triggered reporting on configured but deactivated SCell with PCell interruption in non-DRX test. The UE shall send one Event A6 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than 8s from the beginning of time period T2. The overall delays measured is defined as the time from the beginning of time period T2, to the moment the UE send one Event A6 triggered measurement report to Cell 3. The overall delays measured test requirement is expressed as: Overall delays measured = measurement reporting delay + TTI insertion uncertainty Measurement reporting delay = 8 s TTI insertion uncertainty = TTI = 1 ms; 2xTTI = 2 ms The overall delays measured shall be less than a total of 8002 ms in this test case (note: this gives a total of 8 s for measurement reporting delay plus 2 ms for TTI insertion uncertainty). The UE shall not send event triggered measurement reports, as long as the reporting criteria are not fulfilled. The UE shall be scheduled on PCell continuously throughout the test. From the start of T1 until the measurement report is received during T2, at least 99.5\% of all expected ACK/NACKs shall be transmitted by the UE. For a test to be considered successful requirements on both event detection and percentage of transmitted ACK/NACKs have to be fulfilled simultaneously. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\%. NOTE: The actual overall delays measured in the test may be up to 2xTTI higher than the measurement reporting delays above because of TTI insertion uncertainty of the measurement report in DCCH.

T is the time period for cell identification as specified in Table 8.26.4A.3-1, T is the time period for measurements as shown in Table 8.26.4A.3-2, T is the discovery signal measurement timing configuration periodicity of higher layer, L is the number of configured discovery signal occasions which are not available during T for cell identification at the UE due to the absence of the necessary radio signals from the cell, M is the number of configured discovery signal occasions which are not available during T for the measurements at the UE due to the absence of the necessary radio signals from the cell. A cell shall be considered detectable when the following conditions are met during the discovery signal occasions which are available during T : RSRP related side condition given in clause 9.1.19 are fulfilled for a corresponding Band, SCH_RP is according to Annex B.2.12 for a corresponding Band and SCH \^ E s/Iot is according to Table 8.26.4A.3-1. Reported measurements contained in event triggered measurement reports shall meet the requirements in clause 9. The UE shall not send any event triggered measurement reports, as long as no reporting criteria are fulfilled. The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between an event that will trigger a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface. This requirement assumes that the measurement report is not delayed by other RRC signalling on the DCCH. This measurement reporting delay excludes a delay uncertainty resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH. The delay uncertainty is: 2 x TTI . This measurement reporting delay excludes a delay which is caused by no UL resources for UE to send the measurement report or by the LBT procedure performed by the UE in order to determine that the channel is clear for performing uplink transmission. The event triggered measurement reporting delay, measured without L3 filtering shall be less than T defined in clause 8.26.4A.3. When L3 filtering is used or IDC autonomous denial is configured or LBT is performed by the UE on the carrier used for the measurement reporting an additional delay can be expected. If a cell which has been detectable at least for the time period T defined in clause 8.26.4A.3 becomes undetectable for a period $ $ 8 seconds and then the cell becomes detectable again and triggers an event, the event triggered measurement reporting delay shall be less than T provided the timing to that cell has not changed more than $ $ 50 Ts and the L3 filter has not been used. When L3 filtering is used or LBT is performed by the UE on the carrier used for the measurement reporting an additional delay can be expected. After the RRC connection release, the SS: transmits in Cell 1 a Paging message (including PagingRecord with UE-Identity) for the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.5.3A (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3); or switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Repeat step 3-12 until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in Annex G.2 is achieved.
Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN FDD-FS3 Intra-frequency event triggered reporting in non-DRX for CRS based discovery signal > Test description > Message contents
Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.6 with the following exceptions: 8.26.5.5 Test requirement Table 8.26.5.4.1-1 and Table 8.26.5.5-1 define the primary level settings including test tolerances for E-UTRAN FDD-TDD intra-frequency event triggered reporting in non-DRX for CRS based discovery signal measurement under Operation with Frame Structure 3. The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time from the beginning of time period T2 to the moment when the UE send the measurement report on PUSCH. The actual overall delays measured in the tests may be up to 2$ $TTI higher than the measurement reporting delays above because of TTI insertion uncertainty of the measurement report in DCCH. The event triggered measurement reporting delay, measured without L3 filtering shall be less than T The overall delays measured test requirement for Event A6 is expressed as: Overall delays measured = measurement reporting delay + TTI insertion uncertainty Where: measurement reporting delay = T T = (24+L) * T T = 40 ms L is the number of configured discovery signal occasions which are not available during T for cell identification at the UE due to the absence of the necessary radio signals from the cell TTI insertion uncertainty = 2xTTI = 2 ms The UE shall send one Event A6 triggered measurement report with a measurement reporting delay of less than 962+L*40 ms from the beginning of time T2 (note: this gives a total of 960+L*40 ms for measurement reporting delay plus 2 ms for TTI insertion uncertainty). The UE shall not send event triggered measurement reports as long as the reporting criteria are not fulfilled. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\% with a confidence level of 95\%. 8.26.5A E-UTRAN FDD-FS3 Intra-frequency event triggered reporting in non-DRX for CRS based discovery signal with 2 SCells Editor's notes: This test case is incomplete. The following items are missing or incomplete: - Test tolerance is missing - Annex E-2 needs to be updated - Annex F.1.2 needs to be updated - Annex F.3.2 needs to be updated 8.26.5A.1 Test purpose The purpose of the test is to verify that the UE makes correct reporting of an event under operation with frame structure 3. The test will partly verify new intra-frequency FS3 cells in non-DRX requirements in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.11.2. 8.26.5A.2 Test applicability This test case applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 13 and forward that support LAA for more than one FS3 SCells. Applicability requires support of FGI bit 111. 8.26.5A.3 Minimum conformance requirements When no DRX is in use the UE shall be able to identify a new detectable FS3 intra-frequency cell within the cell identification time T where the identification time of a cell shall include detection of the cell and additionally performing a single measurement with measurement period of T , where: T is the intra-frequency cell identification period as specified in Table 8.26.5A.3-1, T is the intra-frequency period for measurements as shown in Table 8.26.5A.3-2, T is the discovery signal measurement timing configuration periodicity of higher layer, L is the number of configured discovery signal occasions which are not available during T for cell identification at the UE due to the absence of the necessary radio signals from the cell or due to the corresponding downlink subframe being configured as an uplink subframe, M is the number of configured discovery signal occasions which are not available during T for the measurements at the UE due to the absence of the necessary radio signals from the cell or due to the corresponding downlink subframe being configured as an uplink subframe. A cell shall be considered detectable when the following conditions are met during the discovery signal occasions which are available during T : RSRP related side conditions given in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.18.2 are fulfilled for a corresponding Band, RSRQ related side conditions given in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.18.3 are fulfilled for a corresponding Band, SCH_RP is according to 3GPP TS 36.133 Annex B.2.12 for a corresponding Band and SCH \^ E s/Iot is according to Table 8.26.5A.3-1. If higher layer filtering is used, an additional cell identification delay can be expected. In the RRC_CONNECTED state the measurement period for intra-frequency measurements is T as shown in Table 8.26.5A.3-2, when no DRX is in use. The UE shall be capable of performing RSRP and RSRQ measurements for 3 identified intra-frequency cells, and the UE physical layer shall be capable of reporting measurements to higher layers within the measurement period of T . The RSRP measurement accuracy for all measured cells shall be as specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.18.2, and the RSRQ measurement accuracy for all measured cells shall be as specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.18.3. Reported RSRP and RSRQ measurements contained in event triggered measurement reports shall meet the requirements in 3GPP TS 36.133 clauses 9.1.18.2 and 9.1.18.3, respectively. The UE shall not send any event triggered measurement reports, as long as no reporting criteria are fulfilled. The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between an event that will trigger a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface. This requirement assumes that the measurement report is not delayed by other RRC signalling on the DCCH. This measurement reporting delay excludes a delay uncertainty resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH. The delay uncertainty is: 2 x TTI . This measurement reporting delay excludes a delay which caused by no UL resources for UE to send the measurement report or by the LBT procedure performed by the UE in order to determine that the channel is clear for performing uplink transmission. The event triggered measurement reporting delay, measured without L3 filtering shall be less than T defined in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.11.2.1.1.1. When L3 filtering is used or IDC autonomous denial is configured or LBT is performed by the UE on the carrier used for the measurement reporting an additional delay can be expected. If a cell which has been detectable at least for the time period T defined in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.11.2.1.1.1 becomes undetectable for a period $ $ 8 seconds and then the cell becomes detectable again and triggers an event, the event triggered measurement reporting delay shall be less than T provided the timing to that cell has not changed more than $ $ 50 Ts and the L3 filter has not been used. When L3 filtering is used or IDC autonomous denial is configured or LBT is performed by the UE on the carrier used for the measurement reporting, an additional delay can be expected. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.11.2 and A.8.26.5A. 8.26.5A.4 Test description 8.26.5A.4.1 Initial conditions Test Environment: Normal, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E Table E-2 and 3GPP TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1 for different CA bandwidth classes. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: The largest aggregated bandwidth combination supported by UE from Table 8.26.5A.5-1 as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1 for different CA configurations as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 5.4.2A. Connect the SS (node B emulator) and faders and AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A figure A.42. The general test parameter settings are set up according to Table 8.26.5A.4.1-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 8.26.5A.4.3. Cell 1 is PCell on the FDD primary component carrier (RF Channel 1), Cell 2 and Cell 4 are activated SCell on the secondary component carrier (RF Channel 2 and RF Channel 3 respectively) for Frame Structure 3, and Cell 3 is the neighbour cell on the secondary component carrier (RF Channel 2) for frame structure 3. LBT model is applied on cell 3. Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test, Cell 2, Cell 3 and Cell 4 shall be powered OFF. 8.26.5A.4.2 Test procedure The test consists of two successive time periods, with time duration of T1 and T2 respectively. During time duration T1, the UE shall not have any timing information of cell 3. Immediately at beginning of T2 the transmission power of cell 3 is increased, and due to usage of an offset this shall result in reporting of Event A6. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Configure SCC according to Annex C.0, C.1 for all downlink physical channels. The SS shall configure SCell (Cell 2 and Cell 4) on the SCC as per 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.4 with the message content exceptions defined in clause 8.26.5A.4.3. SS activates SCC by sending the activation MAC-CE (Refer TS 36.321 , clauses 5.13, 6.1.3.8). Wait for at least 2 seconds (Refer TS 36.133 , clauses 8.3.3.2). Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 8.26.5A.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.1.1 and B.2.2. T1 starts. After 2s from start of T1, SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message with event A6 configured. The UE shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the power setting from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 8.26.5A.5-1. The UE shall transmit a MeasurementReport message triggered by Event A6. If the measurement reporting delay from the beginning of time period T2 is less than 962+L*40 ms, where L is the number of configured discovery signal occasions which are not available due to the absence of the necessary radio signals from cell3, then count a success for the event "A6". Otherwise count a fail for the event "A6". After the SS receives the MeasurementReport message in step 9) or when T2 expires, the SS shall transmit a RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources. Set Cell 3 physical cell identity = ((current cell 3 physical cell identity + 1) mod 14 + 2) for next iteration of the test procedure loop. If physical cell identity of Cell 3 = physical cell identity of Cell 2 then skip this physical cell identity value for Cell 3. After the RRC connection release, the SS: transmits in Cell 1 a Paging message (including PagingRecord with UE-Identity) for the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.5.3A (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3); or switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Repeat step 3-12 until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in Annex G.2 is achieved. 8.26.5A.4.3 Message contents Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.6 with the following exceptions: 8.26.5A.5 Test requirement Table 8.26.5A.4.1-1 and Table 8.26.5A.5-1 define the primary level settings including test tolerances for E-UTRAN FDD-FS3 intra-frequency event triggered reporting in non-DRX for CRS based discovery signal measurement under Operation with Frame Structure 3. Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN FDD-FS3 Intra-frequency event triggered reporting in DRX for CRS based discovery signal > Test applicability
Content: This test case applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 13 and forward that support DL LAA. Applicability requires support for FGI bits 5 and 111.
Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN FDD-FS3 Intra-frequency event triggered reporting in DRX for CRS based discovery signal > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: When DRX is in use the UE shall be able to identify a new detectable FS3 intra-frequency cell within the cell identification time T , where the cell identification time of a cell shall include detection of the cell and additionally performing a single measurement with measurement period of T , where: T is the intra-frequency period for cell identification as shown in Table 8.26.7.3-1, T is the intra-frequency period for measurements as shown in Table 8.26.7.3-2, T is the discovery signal measurement timing configuration periodicity of higher layer, L is the number of configured discovery signal occasions during ON DURATION and which are not available during T for cell identification at the UE due to the absence of the necessary radio signals from the cell or due to the corresponding downlink subframe being configured as an uplink subframe, M is the number of configured discovery signal occasions during ON DURATION and which are not available during T for the measurements at the UE due to the absence of the necessary radio signals from the cell or due to the corresponding downlink subframe being configured as an uplink subframe. A cell shall be considered detectable when the following conditions are met during the discovery signal occasions which are available during T : RSRP related side conditions given in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.18.2 are fulfilled for a corresponding Band, RSRQ related side conditions given in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.18.3 are fulfilled for a corresponding Band, SCH_RP is according to 3GPP TS 36.133 Annex B.2.12 for a corresponding Band and SCH \^ E s/Iot is according to Table 8.26.7.3-1. If higher layer filtering is used, an additional cell identification delay can be expected. In the RRC_CONNECTED state the measurement period for intra-frequency measurements is T as shown in Table 8.26.7.3-2, when DRX is in use. The UE shall be capable of performing RSRP and RSRQ measurements for 3 identified intra-frequency cells, and the UE physical layer shall be capable of reporting measurements to higher layers within the measurement period of T . The RSRP measurement accuracy for all measured cells shall be as specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.18.2, and the RSRQ measurement accuracy for all measured cells shall be as specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.18.3. Reported RSRP and RSRQ measurements contained in event triggered measurement reports shall meet the requirements in 3GPP TS 36.133 clauses 9.1.18.2 and 9.1.18.3, respectively. The UE shall not send any event triggered measurement reports, as long as no reporting criteria are fulfilled. The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between an event that will trigger a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface. This requirement assumes that the measurement report is not delayed by other RRC signalling on the DCCH. This measurement reporting delay excludes a delay uncertainty resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH. The delay uncertainty is: 2 x TTI . This measurement reporting delay excludes a delay which caused by no UL resources for UE to send the measurement report or by the LBT procedure performed by the UE in order to determine that the channel is clear for performing uplink transmission. The event triggered measurement reporting delay, measured without L3 filtering shall be less than T defined in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.11.2.1.1.2. When L3 filtering is used or IDC autonomous denial is configured or LBT is performed by the UE on the carrier used for the measurement reporting an additional delay can be expected. If a cell which has been detectable at least for the time period T defined in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.11.2.1.1.2 becomes undetectable for a period $ $ 8 seconds and then the cell becomes detectable again and triggers an event, the event triggered measurement reporting delay shall be less than T provided the timing to that cell has not changed more than $ $ 50 Ts and the L3 filter has not been used. When L3 filtering is used or IDC autonomous denial is configured or LBT is performed by the UE on the carrier used for the measurement reporting, an additional delay can be expected. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.11.2 and A.8.26.7.
Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN FDD-FS3 Intra-frequency event triggered reporting in DRX for CRS based discovery signal > Test description > Initial conditions
Content: Test Environment: Normal, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and 3GPP TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1 for different CA bandwidth classes. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: The largest aggregated bandwidth combination supported by UE from Table 8.26.7.5-1 as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1 for different CA configurations as defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 5.4.2A. Connect the SS (node B emulator) and faders and AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A figure A.42. The general test parameter settings are set up according to Table 8.26.7.4.1-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 8.26.7.4.3. Cell 1 is PCell on the FDD primary component carrier (RF Channel 1), Cell 2 is activated SCell on the secondary component carrier (RF Channel 2) for Frame Structure 3, and Cell 3 is the neighbour cell on the secondary component carrier (RF Channel 2) frame structure 3. LBT model is applied on cell 3. Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test, Cell 2 and Cell 3 shall be powered OFF.
Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN FDD-FS3 Intra-frequency event triggered reporting in DRX for CRS based discovery signal > Test description > Test procedure
Content: The test consists of two successive time periods, with time duration of T1 and T2 respectively. During time duration T1, the UE shall not have any timing information of cell 3. Immediately at beginning of T2 the transmission power of cell 3 is increased, and due to usage of an offset this shall result in reporting of Event A6. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Configure SCC according to Annex C.0, C.1 for all downlink physical channels. The SS shall configure SCell (Cell 2) on the SCC as per 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.4 with the message content exceptions defined in clause 8.26.7.4.3. SS activates SCC by sending the activation MAC-CE (Refer TS 36.321 , clauses 5.13, 6.1.3.8). Wait for at least 2 seconds (Refer TS 36.133 , clauses 8.3.3.2). Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 8.26.7.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.1.1 and B.2.2. T1 starts. After 2s from start of T1, SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message with event A6 configured. The UE shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the power setting from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 8.26.7.5-1. The UE shall transmit a MeasurementReport message triggered by Event A6. If the measurement reporting delay from the beginning of time period T2 is less than 7682+L*320 ms, where L is the number of configured discovery signal occasions which are not available due to the absence of the necessary radio signals from cell 3, then count a success for the event "A6". Otherwise count a fail for the event "A6". After the SS receives the MeasurementReport message in step 9) or when T2 expires, the SS shall transmit a RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources. Set Cell 3 physical cell identity = ((current cell 3 physical cell identity + 1) mod 14 + 2) for next iteration of the test procedure loop. If physical cell identity of Cell 3 = physical cell identity of Cell 2 then skip this physical cell identity value for Cell 3. After the RRC connection release, the SS: transmits in Cell 1 a Paging message (including PagingRecord with UE-Identity) for the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.5.3A (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3); or switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Repeat step 3-12 until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in Annex G.2 is achieved.
Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN FDD-FS3 Intra-frequency event triggered reporting in DRX for CRS based discovery signal > Test description > Message contents
Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.6 with the following exceptions: 8.26.7.5 Test requirement Table 8.26.7.4.1-1 and Table 8.26.7.5-1 define the primary level settings including test tolerances for E-UTRAN FDD-TDD intra-frequency event triggered reporting in DRX for CRS based discovery signal measurement under Operation with Frame Structure 3. The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time from the beginning of time period T2 to the moment when the UE send the measurement report on PUSCH. The actual overall delays measured in the tests may be up to 2$ $TTI higher than the measurement reporting delays above because of TTI insertion uncertainty of the measurement report in DCCH. The event triggered measurement reporting delay, measured without L3 filtering shall be less than T The overall delays measured test requirement for Event A6 is expressed as: Overall delays measured = measurement reporting delay + TTI insertion uncertainty Where: measurement reporting delay = T T = (24+L)*k1*k2*DRX cycle length (as DRX cycle length of 320ms is longer than T of 40ms) k1 = 1 and k2 = 1 as no overlaps of measurement gaps or DMTC occasions, and DRX cycle length = 320ms. L is the number of configured discovery signal occasions during ON DURATION which are not available during T for cell identification at the UE due to the absence of the necessary radio signals from the cell TTI insertion uncertainty = 2xTTI = 2 ms The UE shall send one Event A6 triggered measurement report with a measurement reporting delay of less than 7682+L*320 ms from the beginning of time T2 (note: this gives a total of 7680+L*320 ms for measurement reporting delay plus 2 ms for TTI insertion uncertainty). The UE shall not send event triggered measurement reports as long as the reporting criteria are not fulfilled. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\% with a confidence level of 95\%.
Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN TDD-FS3 Intra-frequency event triggered reporting in DRX for CRS based discovery signal > Test purpose
Content: The purpose of the test is to verify that the UE makes correct reporting of an event under operation with frame structure 3. The test will partly verify new intra-frequency FS3 cells in DRX requirements in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.11.2.

Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN FDD-FS3 Inter-frequency event triggered reporting under fading propagation conditions in synchronous cells > Test applicability
Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE supporting FDD and FS3 release 13 and forward. Applicability requires support for FGI bit 25.
Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN FDD-FS3 Inter-frequency event triggered reporting under fading propagation conditions in synchronous cells > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: This clause defines the measurement requirements of a secondary component carrier with deactivated SCell based on the parameter measCycleSCell defined in 3GPP TS 36.331 . When no DRX is in use the UE shall be able to identify a new detectable FDD or TDD cell on a secondary component carrier within T , according to the parameter measCycleSCell where T = 20 measCycleSCell A cell shall be considered detectable when RSRP related side conditions given in clause 9.1 in 3GPP TS 36.133 are fulfilled for a corresponding Band, RSRQ related side conditions given in clause 9.1 in 3GPP TS 36.133 are fulfilled for a corresponding Band, RS-SINR related side conditions given in clause 9.1.17.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.133 are fulfilled for a corresponding Band, SCH_RP and SCH \^ E s/Iot according to Annex I.2.7 for a corresponding Band. The measurement period for deactivated scell measurements is T according to the parameter measCycleSCell where T = 5 measCycleSCell. The UE shall be capable of performing RSRP, RSRQ, and RS-SINR measurements for 8 identified cells on a secondary component carrier, and the UE physical layer shall be capable of reporting measurements to higher layers with the measurement period of T . The measurement accuracy for all measured cells shall be as specified in the clause 9.1.11 in 3GPP TS 36.133 (Carrier aggregation measurement accuracy) A UE may reconfigure the receiver bandwidth or turn on/off one of the RF chains when performing measurements on up to four SCCs with deactivated SCell. This may cause interruptions on PCell or activated SCell(s) or both that are specified in clause 7.8 in 3GPP TS 36.133 . Reported RSRP, RSRQ, and RS-SINR measurements contained in event triggered measurement reports shall meet the applicable requirements in clause 9 in 3GPP TS 36.133 . The UE shall not send any event triggered measurement reports, as long as no reporting criteria are fulfilled. The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between an event that will trigger a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface. This requirement assumes that the measurement report is not delayed by other RRC signalling on the DCCH. This measurement reporting delay excludes a delay uncertainty resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH. The delay uncertainty is: 2 x TTI . This measurement reporting delay excludes a delay which is caused by no UL resources for UE to send the measurement report. The event triggered measurement reporting delay, measured without L3 filtering shall be less than T defined in clause 8.3.3.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.133 . When L3 filtering is used or IDC autonomous denial is configured, or the UE is configured to perform SRS carrier based switching, an additional delay can be expected. If a cell which has been detectable at least for the time period T defined in clause 8.3.3.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.133 becomes undetectable for a period $ $ 5 seconds and then the cell becomes detectable again and triggers an event, the event triggered measurement reporting delay shall be less than T provided the timing to that cell has not changed more than $ $ 50 Ts and the L3 filter has not been used. When L3 filtering, or the UE is configured to perform SRS carrier based switching, is used an additional delay can be expected. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.3.3.2.1 and A.8.26.9.
Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN FDD-FS3 Inter-frequency event triggered reporting under fading propagation conditions in synchronous cells > Test description > Initial conditions
Content: Test Environment: Normal, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and 3GPP TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: The largest bandwidth of the corresponding to be tested E-UTRAN band as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1. Connect the SS (node B emulator), faders and the AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A figure A.15. The general test parameter settings are set up according to Table 8.26.9.4.1-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 8.26.9.4.3. There are two E-UTRA carriers and one E-UTRA FDD Cell 1 and one E-UTRA FS3 Cell 2 on each carrier specified in the test. Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test.
Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN FDD-FS3 Inter-frequency event triggered reporting under fading propagation conditions in synchronous cells > Test description > Test procedure
Content: The test consists of two successive time periods, with time durations of T1 and T2 respectively. During time duration T1, the UE shall not have any timing information of cell 2. Gap pattern configuration \#0 is configured before T2 begins to enable inter-frequency monitoring. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 8.26.9.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.1.1 and B.2.2. T1 starts. SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the power setting from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 8.26.9.5-1. UE shall transmit a MeasurementReport message triggered by Event A4. If the measurement reporting delay from the beginning of time period T2 is less than (3+L)*40 + 2 ms the number of successful tests is increased by one. If the UE fails to report the event within the measurement reporting delay requirement then the number of failure tests is increased by one. After the SS receive the MeasurementReport message in step 6) or when T2 expires, the SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources. Set Cell 2 physical cell identity = ((current cell 2 physical cell identity + 1) mod 14 + 2) for next iteration of the test procedure loop. After the RRC connection release, the SS: transmits in Cell 1 a Paging message (including PagingRecord with ue-Identity) for the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.5.3A (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3); or switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Repeat step 2-9 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.
Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN FDD-FS3 Inter-frequency event triggered reporting under fading propagation conditions in synchronous cells > Test description > Message contents
Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.6 with the following exceptions: 8.26.9.5 Test requirement Tables 8.26.9.4.1-1 and 8.26.9.5-1 define the primary level settings including test tolerances for event triggered reporting under fading propagation conditions in synchronous FDD-FS3 inter frequency cells test. The UE shall send one Event A4 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than (3+L)*40 ms from the beginning of time period T2. L is the number of configured discovery signal occasions which are not available during the time for cell identification at the UE during measurement gaps due to the absence of the necessary radio signals from the measured cell. The overall delays measured is defined as the time from the beginning of time period T2, to the moment the UE send one Event A4 triggered measurement report to Cell 2. The overall delays measured in the test may be up to 2xTTI higher than the measurement reporting delays because of TTI insertion uncertainty of the measurement report in DCCH. The overall delays measured test requirement is expressed as: Overall delays measured = measurement reporting delay + TTI insertion uncertainty Measurement reporting delay = (3+L)*40 ms L is 1 in this case giving a measurement reporting delay of 160ms TTI insertion uncertainty = TTI = 1 ms; 2xTTI = 2 ms The overall delays measured shall be less than a total of 162 ms in this test case (note: a total of 160 ms for measurement reporting delay plus 2 ms for TTI insertion uncertainty). The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\% with a confidence level of 95\%.
Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN TDD-FS3 Inter-frequency event triggered reporting under fading propagation conditions in synchronous cells > Test purpose
Content: To verify the UE's ability to make a correct reporting of a event A4 under fading propagation conditions in synchronous cells within the E-UTRA TDD - Frame Structure 3 inter-frequency cell search requirements. Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN TDD-FS3 Inter-frequency event triggered reporting under fading propagation conditions in synchronous cells > Test applicability

Title Path: UE Measurements Procedures > Frame Structure 3 (FS3) > E-UTRAN TDD-FS3 Inter-frequency event triggered reporting under fading propagation conditions in synchronous cells > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: This clause defines the measurement requirements of a secondary component carrier with deactivated SCell based on the parameter measCycleSCell defined in 3GPP TS 36.331 . When no DRX is in use the UE shall be able to identify a new detectable FDD or TDD cell on a secondary component carrier within T , according to the parameter measCycleSCell where T = 20 measCycleSCell A cell shall be considered detectable when RSRP related side conditions given in clause 9.1 in 3GPP TS 36.133 are fulfilled for a corresponding Band, RSRQ related side conditions given in clause 9.1 in 3GPP TS 36.133 are fulfilled for a corresponding Band, RS-SINR related side conditions given in clause 9.1.17.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.133 are fulfilled for a corresponding Band, SCH_RP and SCH \^ E s/Iot according to clause I.2.7 for a corresponding Band. The measurement period for deactivated scell measurements is T according to the parameter measCycleSCell where T = 5 measCycleSCell. The UE shall be capable of performing RSRP, RSRQ, and RS-SINR measurements for 8 identified cells on a secondary component carrier, and the UE physical layer shall be capable of reporting measurements to higher layers with the measurement period of T . The measurement accuracy for all measured cells shall be as specified in the clause 9.1.11 in 3GPP TS 36.133 (Carrier aggregation measurement accuracy) A UE may reconfigure the receiver bandwidth or turn on/off one of the RF chains when performing measurements on up to four SCCs with deactivated SCell. This may cause interruptions on PCell or activated SCell(s) or both that are specified in clause 7.8 in 3GPP TS 36.133 . Reported RSRP, RSRQ, and RS-SINR measurements contained in event triggered measurement reports shall meet the applicable requirements in clause 9 in 3GPP TS 36.133 . The UE shall not send any event triggered measurement reports, as long as no reporting criteria are fulfilled. The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between an event that will trigger a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface. This requirement assumes that the measurement report is not delayed by other RRC signalling on the DCCH. This measurement reporting delay excludes a delay uncertainty resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH. The delay uncertainty is: 2 x TTI .This measurement reporting delay excludes a delay which is caused by no UL resources for UE to send the measurement report. The event triggered measurement reporting delay, measured without L3 filtering shall be less than T defined in clause 8.3.3.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.133 . When L3 filtering is used or IDC autonomous denial is configured, or the UE is configured to perform SRS carrier based switching, an additional delay can be expected. If a cell which has been detectable at least for the time period T defined in clause 8.3.3.2.1 in 3GPP TS 36.133 becomes undetectable for a period $ $ 5 seconds and then the cell becomes detectable again and triggers an event, the event triggered measurement reporting delay shall be less than T provided the timing to that cell has not changed more than $ $ 50 Ts and the L3 filter has not been used. When L3 filtering, or the UE is configured to perform SRS carrier based switching, is used an additional delay can be expected. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.3.3.2.1 and A.8.26.10.
