Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > 3DL RSRP for E-UTRAN in Carrier Aggregation with generic duplex modes > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Test equipment shall select either baseline test method or alternative test method. Applied test method shall be identified in the test result. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Configure SCells according to Annex C.0,C.1 and C.2 for all downlink physical channels. The SS shall configure SCells (Cell 2 and Cell 4) on the SCCs as per 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.4 [with the message content exceptions defined in clause 9.1.68.4.3]. SS activates SCCs by sending the activation MAC-CE (Refer 3GPP TS 36.321 , clauses 5.13, 6.1.3.8). Wait for at least 2 seconds (Refer 3GPP TS 36.133 , clauses 8.3.3.2). Set the parameters according to Tables 9.1.68.5-1 as appropriate. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1. SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message on Cell 1. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. UE shall transmit periodically MeasurementReport messages. Baseline test method: After 10s wait from Step 6, SS shall check the reported RSRP values in periodical MeasurementReport messages. The reported RSRP values for Cell 1, Cell 2 and Cell 4 are compared to the actual RSRP values according to Table 9.1.68.5-2. These count respectively as a Pass or Fail for the events "Cell 1", "Cell 2" and "Cell 4". If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2 or Cell 4, the number of failed iterations for the respective event is increased by one. The reported RSRP values for Cell 2, Cell 3, Cell 4 and Cell 5 are compared to the reported RSRP value of other cells for each MeasurementReport message according to Table 9.1.68.5-3. These count respectively as a Pass or Fail for the events "Cell 1-2", "Cell 1-4", "Cell 2-3" and "Cell 4-5". If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, Cell 3, Cell 4, or Cell 5, the number of failed iterations for the respective event is increased by one. SS shall check the MeasurementReport messages transmitted by the UE until a test verdict has been achieved. If test configuration is Inter-band carrier aggregation, repeat steps 1-10 for all relevant PCell/SCells scenarios defined in Table E-2 according to the UE declared capability for UL support (within CA operation) in the individual bands. Alternative test method: The neighbouring cell specified in Table 9.1.68.4.2-1 shall be powered ON and other neighbouring cells shall be powered OFF. After 10s wait from Step 9, SS shall check the reported RSRP values in periodical MeasurementReport messages. The reported RSRP values for cells specified in Table 9.1.68.4.2-1 are compared to the actual RSRP values according to Table 9.1.68.5-2 and Table 9.1.68.5-3. This counts respectively as a Pass or Fail for the events specified in Table 9.1.68.4.2-1. If the UE fails to report the measurement value for cells in Table 9.1.68.4.2-1, the number of failed iterations for the respective event is increased by one. SS shall check the MeasurementReport messages transmitted by the UE until a test verdict has been achieved. Repeat Step 9 - 11 for each remaining rows of Table 9.1.68.4.2-1. If test configuration is Inter-band carrier aggregation, repeat steps 1-12 for all relevant PCell/SCells scenarios defined in Table E-2 according to the UE declared capability for UL support (within CA operation) in the individual bands. Each of the events "Cell 1", "Cell 2", "Cell 4", "Cell 1-2", "Cell 1-4", "Cell 2-3"and "Cell 4-5 is evaluated independently for the statistic, resulting in an event verdict: pass or fail. Each event is evaluated only until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in clause G.2 is achieved. Different events may require different times for a verdict. If all events pass for each configuration (without and with switched PCell/SCells scenario), the test passes. If one event fails, the test fails.

Connect the SS (node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors as follows: For UEs supporting only 2Rx in all the bands under test, use TS 36.508 Annex A, Figure A.66a as appropriate. For UEs supporting 4Rx in any of the bands under test use TS 36.508 Annex A, Figure A.90, without neighbour on Pcell. Use the 2Rx module for cells on bands supporting 2Rx and the 4Rx module for cells on bands supporting 4Rx. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 9.1.69.4.3. Cell 1 is PCell on channel 1, and Cell 2, Cell 4 and Cell 6 are activated SCells on secondary component carriers SCC1, SCC2 and SCC3 respectively. Cell 3, Cell 5 and Cell 7 are neighbouring cells on secondary component carriers SCC1, SCC2 and SCC3 respectively. Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power levels set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test. Cell 2, Cell 3, Cell 4, Cell 5, Cell 6 and Cell 7 shall be powered OFF.
Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > 4 DL RSRP for E-UTRAN in Carrier Aggregation with generic duplex modes > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Test equipment shall select either baseline test method or alternative test method. Applied test method shall be identified in the test result. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Configure SCells according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for all downlink physical channels. The SS shall configure SCells (Cell 2, Cell 4 and Cell6) on the SCCs as per 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.4 [with the message content exceptions defined in clause 9.1.69.4.3]. SS activates SCCs by sending the activation MAC-CE (Refer 3GPP TS 36.321 , clauses 5.13, 6.1.3.8). Wait for at least 2 seconds (Refer 3GPP TS 36.133 , clauses 8.3.3.2). Set the parameters according to Tables 9.1.69.5-1, 9.1.69.5-2 and 9.1.69.5-3 as appropriate. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1. SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message on Cell 1. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. UE shall transmit periodically MeasurementReport messages. Baseline test method: After 10s wait from Step 6, SS shall check the reported RSRP values in periodical MeasurementReport messages. The reported RSRP values for Cell 1, Cell 2, Cell 4 and Cell 6 are compared to the actual RSRP values according to Table 9.1.69.5-4. These count respectively as a Pass or Fail for the events "Cell 1", "Cell 2", "Cell 4" and Cell 6. If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, Cell 4 or Cell 6, the number of failed iterations for the respective event is increased by one. The reported RSRP values for Cell 2, Cell 3, Cell 4, Cell 5, Cell 6 and Cell 7 are compared to the reported RSRP value of other cells for each MeasurementReport message according to Table 9.1.69.5-5. These count respectively as a Pass or Fail for the events "Cell 1-2", "Cell 1-4", "Cell 1-6", "Cell 2-3", "Cell 4-5" and "Cell 6-7". If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, Cell 3, Cell 4, Cell 5, Cell 6 or Cell 7, the number of failed iterations for the respective event is increased by one. SS shall check the MeasurementReport messages transmitted by the UE until a test verdict has been achieved. If test configuration is Inter-band carrier aggregation, repeat steps 1-10 for all relevant PCell/SCells scenarios defined in Table E-5 according to the UE declared capability for UL support (within CA operation) in the individual bands. Alternative test method: The neighbouring cell specified in Table 9.1.69.4.2-1 shall be powered ON and other neighbouring cells shall be powered OFF. After 10s wait from Step 9, SS shall check the reported RSRP values in periodical MeasurementReport messages. The reported RSRP values for cells specified in Table 9.1.69.4.2-1 are compared to the actual RSRP values according to Table 9.1.69.5-4. This counts respectively as a Pass or Fail for the events specified in Table 9.1.69.4.2-1. If the UE fails to report the measurement value for cells in Table 9.1.69.4.2-1, the number of failed iterations for the respective event is increased by one. SS shall check the MeasurementReport messages transmitted by the UE until a test verdict has been achieved. Repeat Step 9 - 11 for each remaining rows of Table 9.1.69.4.2-1. If test configuration is Inter-band carrier aggregation, repeat steps 1-12 for all relevant PCell/SCells scenarios defined in Table E-5 according to the UE declared capability for UL support (within CA operation) in the individual bands. Each of the events "Cell 1", "Cell 2", "Cell 4", "Cell 6", "Cell 1-2", "Cell 1-4", "Cell 1-6", "Cell 2-3", "Cell 4-5", and "Cell 6-7" is evaluated independently for the statistic, resulting in an event verdict: pass or fail. Each event is evaluated only until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in clause G.2 is achieved. Different events may require different times for a verdict. If all events pass for each configuration (without and with switched PCell/SCells scenario), the test passes. If one event fails, the test fails.

Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > 4 DL RSRP for E-UTRAN in Carrier Aggregation with generic duplex modes > Test requirement

Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > 5 DL RSRP for E-UTRAN in Carrier Aggregation with generic duplex modes > Test purpose
Content: To verify that RSRP absolute and relative measurement accuracy in carrier aggregation are within the specified limits under AWGN propagation conditions. This test will verify the absolute RSRP accuracy requirements of the primary component carrier, the absolute RSRP accuracy requirements of the secondary component carriers, and the relative RSRP accuracy requirements of the secondary component carriers. The test will also verify the primary and secondary component carriers' relative RSRP accuracy requirement.
Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > 5 DL RSRP for E-UTRAN in Carrier Aggregation with generic duplex modes > Test applicability

This test case also applies to all types of E-UTRA TDD UE release 11 and forward that support 5DL CA. This test case also applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 12 and forward that support E-UTRA FDD, E-UTRA TDD and 5DL CA. Note on the applicability: If the generic duplex-mode test case 9.1.70 is tested with FDD PCell, the specific duplex-mode test cases 9.1.48 and 9.1.50 do not need to be tested. If the generic duplex-mode test case 9.1.70 is tested with TDD PCell, the specific duplex-mode test cases 9.1.49 and 9.1.51 do not need to be tested

Each RSRQ FDD - FDD inter frequency absolute accuracy test shall meet the reported values test requirements in Table 9.2.3.1.5-3. For the test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each test shall be more than 90\% with a confidence level of 95\%. 9.2.3.1_2 FDD - FDD Inter Frequency Absolute RSRQ Accuracy for UE category 1bis 9.2.3.1_2.1 Test purpose To verify that the FDD - FDD inter frequency absolute RSRQ measurement accuracy is within the specified limit for all bands. 9.2.3.1_2.2 Test applicability This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 13 and forward of UE category 1bis. Applicability requires support for FGI bits 16 and 25. 9.2.3.1_2.3 Minimum conformance requirements The absolute accuracy of RSRQ is defined as the RSRQ measured from a cell that has different carrier frequency from the serving cell. The accuracy requirements in table 9.2.3.1_2.3-1 are valid under the following conditions: Cell specific reference signals are transmitted either from one, two or four antenna ports. Conditions defined in 3GPP TS 36.101 clause 7.3 for reference sensitivity are fulfilled. RSRP dBm according to clause I.3.3 for a corresponding Band. The reporting range of RSRQ is defined from -19.5 dB to -3 with 0.5 dB resolution. The mapping of measured quantity is defined in Table 9.2.3.1_2.3-2. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.6.5 and A.9.2.3. 9.2.3.1_2.4 Test description 9.2.3.1_2.4.1 Initial conditions Test Environment: Normal, TL/VL, TL/VH, TH/VL, TH/VH; as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and 3GPP TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1.1. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: 10 MHz as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1.1. [] Connect the SS (node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A figure A.14 using only main UE Tx/Rx antenna. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 9.2.3.1_2.4.3. There are two E-UTRA FDD carriers and one cell on each carrier specified in each test. Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test. Each RSRQ FDD - FDD inter frequency absolute accuracy test shall meet the reported values test requirements in Table 9.2.3.1_2.5-3. For the test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each test shall be more than 90\% with a confidence level of 95\%. 9.2.3.1_3 FDD - FDD Inter Frequency Absolute RSRQ Accuracy for CA Idle Mode Measurements for Overlapping Carrier 9.2.3.1_3.1 Test purpose To verify that the FDD - FDD inter frequency absolute RSRQ measurement accuracy for CA idle mode measurements for overlapping carriers is within the specified limit for all bands. 9.2.3.1_3.2 Test applicability This test applies to E-UTRA FDD UE release 15 and forward capable of IDLE mode measurements for CA. This information is received from UECapabilityInformation. 9.2.3.1_3.3 Minimum conformance requirements The absolute accuracy of RSRQ is defined as the RSRQ measured from a cell that has different carrier frequency from the serving cell. The accuracy requirements in table 9.2.3.1_3.3-1 are valid under the following conditions: Cell specific reference signals are transmitted either from one, two or four antenna ports. The reporting range of RSRQ is defined from -19.5 dB to -3 with 0.5 dB resolution. The mapping of measured quantity is defined in Table 9.2.3.1_3.3-2. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.6B.2 and A.9.2.61. 9.2.3.1_3.4 Test description 9.2.3.1_3.4.1 Initial conditions Test Environment: Normal, TL/VL, TL/VH, TH/VL, TH/VH; as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and 3GPP TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1.1. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: 10 MHz as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1.1. [] Connect the SS (node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A figure A.14 for UE with 2Rx RF band and Annex A, Figure A.78 (without using the faders) for 4Rx capable UE without any 2Rx RF bands. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 9.2.3.1_3.4.3. There are two E-UTRA FDD carriers and one cell on each carrier specified in each test. Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test. [9.2.3.1_3.4.2]Test procedure The three tests consist of Cell 1, serving cell and Cell 2, target cell. The absolute accuracy of RSRQ is defined as the RSRQ measured from a cell that has different carrier frequency from the serving cell, Cell 1. [] System information combination 3 as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.4.3.1 is used in E-UTRA cells. The UE is in state Generic RB Established (state 3) on Cell 1 according to 3GPP TS 36.508 . The SS transmits an RRCConnectionRelease message including the measIdleConfig on cell 1. Wait for 30 s for the UE to enter E-UTRA RRC_IDLE state on Cell 1 and do measurements over cells 1 and 2. The SS sends RRC Paging message with UE S-TMSI on the cell 1. The UE shall transmit an RRCConnectionRequest message on the cell 1. The SS transmits a RRCConnectionSetup message. The UE shall transmit a RRCConnectionSetupComplete message with idleMeasAvailable. The SS transmits a SecurityModeCommand message to activate AS security. The UE shall transmit a SecurityModeComplete message. The SS transmits a RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to establish the default bearer with condition SRB2-DRB(1, 0). The UE shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration complete message. The SS transmits UEInformationRequest message with idleModeMeasurementReq included. The UE shall transmit UEInformationResponse message including measResultListIdle. SS shall check the RSRQ value of Cell 1 and Cell 2 from measResultListIdle message. The RSRQ value of Cell 2 reported by the UE is compared to the actual RSRQ value according to the Table 9.2.3.1_3.5.2. If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, the number of failed iterations is increased by one. SS shall check the MeasurementReport messages transmitted by the UE until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in clause G.2 is achieved. Repeat step 1-16 for each sub-test in Table 9.2.3.1_3.5.2 as appropriate. Content: The relative accuracy of RSRQ in inter frequency case is defined as the RSRQ measured from one cell compared to the RSRQ measured from another cell on a different frequency. The accuracy requirements in table 9.2.3.2.3-1 are valid under the following conditions: Cell specific reference signals are transmitted either from one, two or four antenna ports. Conditions defined in 3GPP TS 36.101 clause 7.3 for reference sensitivity are fulfilled. The mapping of measured quantity is defined in Table 9.2.3.2.3-2. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.6.2 and A.9.2.3.
Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > FDD - FDD Inter frequency RSRQ Accuracy > FDD - FDD Inter Frequency Relative Accuracy of RSRQ > Test description
Content: 9.2.3.2.4.1 Initial conditions Test Environment: Normal, TL/VL, TL/VH, TH/VL, TH/VH; as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and 3GPP TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: 10 MHz as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1. Connect the SS (node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A figure A.14 for UE with 2Rx RF band and Annex A, Figure A.78 (without using the faders) for 4Rx capable UE without any 2Rx RF bands. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 9.2.3.2.4.3. There are two E-UTRA FDD carriers and one cell on each carrier specified in the test. Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test.
Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > FDD - FDD Inter frequency RSRQ Accuracy > FDD - FDD Inter Frequency Relative Accuracy of RSRQ > Test description > Test procedure
Content: The three tests consist of Cell 1, serving cell and Cell 2, target cell. The relative accuracy of RSRQ is defined as the RSRQ measured from one cell compared to the RSRQ measured from another cell on a different frequency. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Set the parameters according to Table 9.2.3.2.5-2 for the test interval as appropriate. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1.1. SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. UE shall transmit periodically MeasurementReport messages. After 10s wait from Step 3, SS shall check the RSRQ value of Cell 1 and Cell 2 in periodical MeasurementReport messages. The reported RSRQ value for Cell 2 is compared to the reported RSRQ value for Cell 1 for each MeasurementReport message. If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, the number of failed iterations is increased by one. The SS shall check MeasurementReport messages transmitted by the UE until the confidence level according to G.2.3-1 in clause G.2 is achieved. Repeat step 1-7 for each test interval in Table 9.2.3.2.5-2 as appropriate.

If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, the number of failed iterations is increased by one. The SS shall check MeasurementReport messages transmitted by the UE until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in clause G.2 is achieved. Repeat step 1-7 for each test interval in Table 9.2.4.1.5-2 as appropriate.

Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > TDD - TDD Inter frequency RSRQ Accuracy > TDD - TDD Inter Frequency Relative Accuracy of RSRQ > Test description
Content: 9.2.4.2.4.1 Initial conditions Test Environment: Normal, TL/VL, TL/VH, TH/VL, TH/VH; as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and 3GPP TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: 10 MHz as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1. Connect the SS (node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A figure A.14 for UE with 2Rx RF band and Annex A, Figure A.78 (without using the faders) for 4Rx capable UE without any 2Rx RF bands. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 9.2.4.2.4.3. There are two E-UTRA TDD carriers and one cell on each carrier specified in the test. Cell 1 is the cell used for call setup with the power level set according to clause C.0 and C.1 for this test.
Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > TDD - TDD Inter frequency RSRQ Accuracy > TDD - TDD Inter Frequency Relative Accuracy of RSRQ > Test description > Test procedure
Content: The three tests consist of Cell 1, serving cell and Cell 2, target cell. The relative accuracy of RSRQ is defined as the RSRQ measured from one cell compared to the RSRQ measured from another cell on a different frequency. The Gap pattern configuration is with id\#0 as defined in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.1.2.1. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Set the parameters according to Table 9.2.4.2.5-2 for the test interval as appropriate. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1.1. SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. UE shall transmit periodically MeasurementReport messages. After 10s wait from Step 3, SS shall check the RSRQ value of Cell 1 and Cell 2 in periodical MeasurementReport messages. The reported RSRQ value for Cell 2 is compared to the reported RSRQ value for Cell 1 for each MeasurementReport message according to Table 9.2.4.2.5-3. If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, the number of failed iterations is increased by one. The SS shall check MeasurementReport messages transmitted by the UE until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in clause G.2 is achieved. Repeat step 1-7 for each test interval in Table 9.2.4.2.5-2 as appropriate.

Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > FDD RSRQ for E-UTRA Carrier Aggregation > FDD Absolute RSRQ Accuracy for E-UTRA Carrier Aggregation > Test description > Test procedure
Content: The test consists of Cell 1 the PCell, Cell 2 the SCell on the Secondary Component Carrier (SCC), and Cell 3 the neighbouring cell on the SCC. The SCell (Cell 2) and neighbouring cell (Cell 3) on the SCC are configured. The SCell (Cell 2) on the SCC is activated. The absolute accuracy of RSRQ is defined as the RSRQ measured from the primary component carrier (Cell 1) and the RSRQ measured from the secondary component carrier (Cell 2). Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Configure SCC according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for all downlink physical channels. The SS shall configure the SCell (Cell 2) on the SCC as per 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.4. SS activates SCC by sending the MAC-CE according to 3GPP TS 36.321 clauses 5.13 and 6.1.3.8. Wait for at least 2 seconds as per 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.3.3.2. Set the parameters according to Table 9.2.5.1.5-1 as appropriate. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1.1. SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. UE shall transmit periodically MeasurementReport messages. After 10s wait from Step 6, SS shall check the reported RSRQ values in periodical MeasurementReport messages. The reported RSRQ values for Cell 1 and Cell 2 by the UE are compared to the actual RSRQ values according to Table 9.2.5.1.5-2. This counts respectively as a Pass or Fail for the events "Cell 1" and "Cell 2". If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, the number of failed iterations for the respective event "Cell 2" is increased by one. The SS shall check MeasurementReport messages transmitted by the UE until a test verdict has been achieved. Each of the events "Cell 1" and "Cell 2" is evaluated independently for the statistic, resulting in an event verdict: pass or fail. Each event is evaluated only until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in clause G.2 is achieved. Different events may require different times for a verdict. If both events pass, the test passes. If one event fails, the test fails. 9.2.5.1.4.3 Message contents Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 values 4.6 with the following exceptions:

Content: The requirements for absolute accuracy of RSRQ in this clause shall apply to a cell on the same frequency as that of the serving cell when a time domain measurement resource restriction pattern for performing RSRQ measurements of this cell is configured by higher layers according to 3GPP TS 36.331 . Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > FDD RSRQ Accuracy under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with Non-MBSFN ABS > FDD RSRQ under Time Domain Measurement Resource Restriction with Non-MBSFN ABS (eICIC) > Test description
Content: 9.2.7.1.4.1 Initial conditions Test Environment: Normal, TL/VL, TL/VH, TH/VL, TH/VH; as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and 3GPP TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: 10 MHz as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1. Connect the SS (node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A figure A.20. The general test parameter settings are set up according to Table 9.2.7.1.4.1-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 9.2.7.1.4.3. There is one E-UTRA FDD carrier and two cells specified in each test. Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test. 9.2.7.1.4.2 Test procedure In this test case all cells are on the same carrier frequency. The absolute accuracy of RSRQ intra frequency measurements under time domain measurement resource restriction is tested by using the parameters in Table 9.2.7.1.4.1-1 and Table 9.2.7.1.5-1 for non-MBSFN ABS with non-colliding CRS. In all test cases, Cell 1 is the serving cell and also the aggressor cell to Cell 2. Cell 2 is the target cell to be measured for RSRQ. The UE is configured by higher layers via Cell 1 with a time-domain measurement resource restriction pattern for performing E-UTRAN FDD intra-frequency measurements on neighbour cells and provided with a neighbour cell list associated with the pattern, where the cell list includes Cell 2. The UE is also configured with a time-domain measurement resource restriction pattern for the serving cell measurements. The information for both patterns shall be provided to the UE before the measurements start. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Set the parameters according to Table 9.2.7.1.5-1 as appropriate. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1.1. SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. UE shall transmit periodically MeasurementReport messages. After 10s wait from Step 3, SS shall check the RSRQ value in periodical MeasurementReport messages. The RSRQ value of Cell 2 reported by the UE is compared to the actual RSRQ value according to Table 9.2.7.1.5-2. If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, the number of failed iterations is increased by one. The SS shall check MeasurementReport messages transmitted by the UE until the confidence level according to G.2.3-1 in clause G.2 is achieved. Repeat step 1-7 for each sub-test in Table 9.2.7.1.5-1 as appropriate.

Content: The test consists of Cell 1 the PCell, Cell 2 the SCell on the Secondary Component Carrier (SCC), and Cell 3 the neighbouring cell on the SCC. This counts respectively as a Pass or Fail for the events "Cell 1" and "Cell 2". If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, the number of failed iterations for the respective event "Cell 2" is increased by one. The SS shall check MeasurementReport messages transmitted by the UE until a test verdict has been achieved. Each of the events "Cell 1" and "Cell 2" is evaluated independently for the statistic, resulting in an event verdict: pass or fail. Each event is evaluated only until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in clause G.2 is achieved. Different events may require different times for a verdict. If both events pass, the test passes. If one event fails, the test fails. 9.2.11.1.4.3 Message contents Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 values 4.6 with the following exceptions:

Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > TDD RSRQ for E-UTRA Carrier Aggregation for 20MHz > TDD Absolute RSRQ Accuracy for E-UTRA Carrier Aggregation for 20MHz > Test description > Test procedure
Content: The test consists of Cell 1 the PCell, Cell 2 the SCell on the Secondary Component Carrier (SCC), and Cell 3 the neighbouring cell on the SCC. The SCell (Cell 2) and neighbouring cell (Cell 3) on the SCC are configured. The SCell (Cell 2) on the SCC is activated. The absolute accuracy of RSRQ is defined as the RSRQ measured from the primary component carrier (Cell 1) and the RSRQ measured from the secondary component carrier (Cell 2). Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Configure SCC according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for all downlink physical channels. The SS shall configure the SCell (Cell 2) on the SCC as per 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.4. The SS activates SCC by sending the MAC-CE according to 3GPP TS 36.321 clauses 5.13 and 6.1.3.8. Wait for at least 2 seconds as per 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.3.3.2. Set the parameters according to Table 9.2.12.1.5-1 as appropriate. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1.1. The SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. UE shall transmit periodically MeasurementReport messages. After 10s wait from Step 6, The SS shall check the reported RSRQ values in periodical MeasurementReport messages. The reported RSRQ values for Cell 1 and Cell 2 by the UE are compared to the actual RSRQ values according to Table 9.2.12.1.5-2. This counts respectively as a Pass or Fail for the events "Cell 1" and "Cell 2". If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, the number of failed iterations for the respective event "Cell 2" is increased by one. The SS shall check MeasurementReport messages transmitted by the UE until a test verdict has been achieved. Each of the events "Cell 1" and "Cell 2" is evaluated independently for the statistic, resulting in an event verdict: pass or fail. Each event is evaluated only until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in clause G.2 is achieved. Different events may require different times for a verdict. If both events pass, the test passes. If one event fails, the test fails. 9.2.12.1.4.3 Message contents Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 values 4.6 with the following exceptions:

Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > FDD-FDD Inter Frequency WB-RSRQ > FDD-FDD Inter Frequency absolute WB-RSRQ accuracy > Test purpose

Content: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 11 and forward that support WB-RSRQ measurement. Applicability requires support for FGI bits 16 and 25.
Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > FDD-FDD Inter Frequency WB-RSRQ > FDD-FDD Inter Frequency absolute WB-RSRQ accuracy > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: The requirements in this clause shall apply when the measurement configuration message received by the UE contains widebandRSRQ-Meas parameter in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The WB-RSRQ accuracy figures in Table 9.2.19.1.3-1 are relative to the value that would be obtained by using the AllowedMeasBandwidth in 3GPP TS 36.331 . The accuracy requirements in Table 9.2.19.1.3-1 are valid under the following conditions: The value of the parameter, AllowedMeasBandwidth in 3GPP TS 36.331 , is 50 resource blocks or larger Cell specific reference signals are transmitted either from one, two or four antenna ports. Conditions defined in 3GPP TS 36.101 clause 7.3 for reference sensitivity are fulfilled. RSRP dBm according to clause B.3.1 for a corresponding Band. The reporting range of RSRQ is defined from -19.5 dB to -3 with 0.5 dB resolution. The mapping of measured quantity is defined in Table 9.2.19.1.3-2. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.6.3 and A.9.2.19.
Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > FDD-FDD Inter Frequency WB-RSRQ > FDD-FDD Inter Frequency absolute WB-RSRQ accuracy > Test description
Content: 9.2.19.1.4.1 Initial conditions Test Environment: Normal, TL/VL, TL/VH, TH/VL, TH/VH; as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and 3GPP TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1.1. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: 10 MHz as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1.1. Connect the SS (node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A figure A.14 for UE with 2Rx RF band and Annex A, Figure A.78 (without using the faders) for 4Rx capable UE without any 2Rx RF bands. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 9.2.19.1.4.3. There are two E-UTRA FDD carriers and one cell on each carrier specified in each test. Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test.
Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > FDD-FDD Inter Frequency WB-RSRQ > FDD-FDD Inter Frequency absolute WB-RSRQ accuracy > Test description > Test procedure
Content: The test consists of Cell 1, serving cell and Cell 2, target cell. The absolute accuracy of WB-RSRQ is defined as the RSRQ measured from a cell that has different carrier frequency from the serving cell, Cell 1. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Set the parameters according to Table 9.2.19.1.5-1 as appropriate. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1.1. SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. UE shall transmit periodically MeasurementReport messages. After 10s wait from Step 3, SS shall check the RSRQ value in periodical MeasurementReport messages. The RSRQ value of Cell 2 reported by the UE is compared to the actual RSRQ value according to Table 9.2.19.1.5-1. If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, the number of failed iterations is increased by one. The SS shall check MeasurementReport messages transmitted by the UE until the confidence level according to table G.2.3-1 in clause G.2 is achieved.

For the test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each test shall be more than 90\% with a confidence level of 95\%.

Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > RSRQ for E-UTRAN TDD-FDD Carrier Aggregation with PCell in FDD > Absolute RSRQ Accuracy for E-UTRAN TDD-FDD Carrier Aggregation with PCell in FDD > Test description > Test procedure
Content: The test consists of Cell 1 the PCell, and Cell 2 the SCell on the Secondary Component Carrier (SCC). The SCell (Cell 2) is configured. The SCell (Cell 2) on the SCC is activated. The absolute accuracy of RSRQ is defined as the RSRQ measured from the primary component carrier (Cell 1) and the RSRQ measured from the secondary component carrier (Cell 2). Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Configure SCC according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for all downlink physical channels. The SS shall configure the SCell (Cell 2) on the SCC as per 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.4. SS activates SCC by sending the MAC-CE according to 3GPP TS 36.321 clauses 5.13 and 6.1.3.8. Wait for at least 2 seconds as per 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.3.3.2. Set the parameters according to Table 9.2.25.1.5-1 as appropriate. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1.1. SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. UE shall transmit periodically MeasurementReport messages. After 10s wait from Step 6, SS shall check the reported RSRQ values in periodical MeasurementReport messages. The reported RSRQ values for Cell 1 and Cell 2 by the UE are compared to the actual RSRQ values according to Table 9.2.25.1.5-2. This counts respectively as a Pass or Fail for the events "Cell 1" and "Cell 2". If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, the number of failed iterations for the respective event "Cell 2" is increased by one. The SS shall check MeasurementReport messages transmitted by the UE until a test verdict has been achieved. Each of the events "Cell 1" and "Cell 2" is evaluated independently for the statistic, resulting in an event verdict: pass or fail. Each event is evaluated only until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in clause G.2 is achieved. Different events may require different times for a verdict. If both events pass, the test passes. If one event fails, the test fails. 9.2.25.1.4.3 Message contents Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 with the following exceptions: 9.2.25.1.5 Test requirement Table 9.2.25.1.5-1 defines the primary level settings including test tolerances for all tests. The RSRQ absolute accuracy for carrier aggregation test shall meet the reported values test requirements in Table 9.2.25.1.5-2. For the test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each test shall be more than 90\% with a confidence level of 95\%.

Content: To verify that TDD-FDD relative RSRQ measurement accuracy in carrier aggregation is within the specified limits under AWGN propagation conditions. This test will verify the TDD-FDD relative RSRQ accuracy requirements between the primary and secondary component carriers.

Content: 9.2.25.2.4.1 Initial conditions Test Environment: Normal, TL/VL, TL/VH, TH/VL, TH/VH; as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > RSRQ for E-UTRAN TDD-FDD Carrier Aggregation with PCell in FDD > Relative RSRQ Accuracy for E-UTRAN TDD-FDD Carrier Aggregation with PCell in FDD > Test description > Test procedure
Content: The test consists of Cell 1 the PCell, and Cell 2 the SCell on the Secondary Component Carrier (SCC). The SCell (Cell 2)is configured. The SCell (Cell 2) on the SCC is activated. The relative accuracy of RSRQ is defined as the RSRQ measured from the secondary component carrier (Cell 2) compared with the RSRQ measured from the primary component carrier (Cell 1). Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Configure SCC according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for all downlink physical channels. The SS shall configure the SCell (Cell 2) on the SCC as per 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.4. SS activates SCC by sending the MAC-CE according to 3GPP TS 36.321 clauses 5.13 and 6.1.3.8. Wait for at least 2 seconds as per 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.3.3.2. Set the parameters according to Table 9.2.25.2.5-1 as appropriate. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1.1. SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. UE shall transmit periodically MeasurementReport messages. After 10s wait from Step 6, SS shall check the reported RSRQ values in periodical MeasurementReport messages. The reported RSRQ value for Cell 2 is compared to the reported RSRQ value for Cell 1 for each MeasurementReport message according to Table 9.2.25.2.5-2. If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, the number of failed iterations is increased by one. The SS shall check MeasurementReport messages transmitted by the UE until the confidence level according to table G.2.3-1 in clause G.2 is achieved.

Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > RSRQ for E-UTRAN TDD-FDD Carrier Aggregation with PCell in TDD > Absolute RSRQ Accuracy for E-UTRAN TDD-FDD Carrier Aggregation with PCell in TDD > Test description > Test procedure
Content: The test consists of Cell 1 the PCell, and Cell 2 the SCell on the Secondary Component Carrier (SCC). The SCell (Cell 2) is configured. The SCell (Cell 2) on the SCC is activated. The absolute accuracy of RSRQ is defined as the RSRQ measured from the primary component carrier (Cell 1) and the RSRQ measured from the secondary component carrier (Cell 2). Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Configure SCC according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for all downlink physical channels. The SS shall configure the SCell (Cell 2) on the SCC as per 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.4. SS activates SCC by sending the MAC-CE according to 3GPP TS 36.321 clauses 5.13 and 6.1.3.8. Wait for at least 2 seconds as per 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.3.3.2. Set the parameters according to Table 9.2.26.1.5-1 as appropriate. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1.1. SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. UE shall transmit periodically MeasurementReport messages. After 10s wait from Step 6, SS shall check the reported RSRQ values in periodical MeasurementReport messages. The reported RSRQ values for Cell 1 and Cell 2 by the UE are compared to the actual RSRQ values according to Table 9.2.26.1.5-2. This counts respectively as a Pass or Fail for the events "Cell 1" and "Cell 2". If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, the number of failed iterations for the respective event "Cell 2" is increased by one. The SS shall check MeasurementReport messages transmitted by the UE until a test verdict has been achieved. Each of the events "Cell 1" and "Cell 2" is evaluated independently for the statistic, resulting in an event verdict: pass or fail. Each event is evaluated only until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in clause G.2 is achieved. Different events may require different times for a verdict. If both events pass, the test passes. If one event fails, the test fails. 9.2.26.1.4.3 Message contents Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 with the following exceptions: 9.2.26.1.5 Test requirement Table 9.2.26.1.5-1 defines the primary level settings including test tolerances for all tests. The RSRQ absolute accuracy for carrier aggregation test shall meet the reported values test requirements in Table 9.2.26.1.5-2. For the test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each test shall be more than 90\% with a confidence level of 95\%.

Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > FDD intra-frequency absolute RSRQ accuracy with CRS based discovery signal > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: Intra-frequency absolute RSRQ measurement accuracy requirements in discovery signal occasions are the same as specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.5.1. The requirements for absolute accuracy of RSRQ in this clause apply to a cell on the same frequency as that of the serving cell. The accuracy requirements in Table 9.2.28.3-1 are valid under the following conditions: Cell specific reference signals are transmitted either from one, two or four antenna ports. Conditions defined in 3GPP TS 36.101 clause 7.3 for reference sensitivity are fulfilled. RSRP dBm according to clause I.3.1 for a corresponding Band The reporting range of RSRQ is defined from -34 dB to 2.5 dB with 0.5 dB resolution. The mapping of measured quantity is defined in table 9.2.28.3-2. The range in the signalling may be larger than the guaranteed accuracy range. Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > FDD-FDD inter-frequency absolute and relative RSRQ accuracies with CRS based discovery signal > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Ensure that the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Set the parameters according to Table 9.2.30.5-1 as appropriate. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1.1. SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message on cell 1. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. UE shall transmit periodically MeasurementReport messages. After 10s wait from Step 3, SS shall check the reported RSRQ values in periodical MeasurementReport messages. The reported RSRQ value of Cell 2 reported by the UE is compared to actual RSRQ value according to Table 9.2.30.5-2. This counts as a Pass or Fail for the events "Cell 2". If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, the number of failed iterations is increased by one. The reported RSRQ value for Cell 2 is compared to the reported RSRQ value for Cell 1 for each MeasurementReport message according to Table 9.2.30.5-3. This counts as a Pass or Fail for the events "Cell 1-2". If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, the number of failed iterations is increased by one. SS shall check the MeasurementReport messages transmitted by the UE until a test verdict has been achieved. Each of the events "Cell 1" and "Cell 1-2" is evaluated independently for the statistic, resulting in an event verdict: pass or fail. Each event is evaluated only until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in clause G.2 is achieved. Different events may require different times for a verdict. If all events pass for each scenario, the test passes. If one event fails, the test fails.

Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > FS3 Intra frequency absolute and relative RSRQ accuracies with FDD PCell > Test description > Test procedure
Content: In this test case, Cell1 is PCell on the primary component carrier, Cell2 is SCell on the secondary component carrier with frame structure 3 and activated, and Cell3 is the neighbouring cell on the same secondary component carrier of Cell2. The test parameters are given in Table 9.2.51.5-1. The DMTC configuration for Cell2 and Cell3 is provided to the UE in the measDS-Config before the start of the test in test procedure step 8. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Configure SCells according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for all downlink physical channels. The SS shall configure SCell (Cell2) on the SCC as per 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.4. The SS activates SCC by sending the MAC-CE according to 3GPP TS 36.321 clauses 5.13 and 6.1.3.8. Wait for at least 2 seconds as per 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.3.3.2. Set the parameters according to Table 9.2.51.5-1 as appropriate. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1. The SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message on Cell 1. The UE shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. The UE shall transmit periodically MeasurementReport messages. After 10s wait from Step 6, SS shall check the reported RSRQ values in periodical MeasurementReport messages. []The reported RSRQ values for Cell 3 by the UE are compared to the actual RSRQ values according to Table 9.2.51.5-2. This counts respectively as a Pass or Fail for the events "Cell 3". If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 3, the number of failed iterations for the respective event "Cell 3" is increased by one. []The reported RSRQ values for Cell3 are compared to the reported RSRQ value for other cells for each MeasurementReport message according to Table 9.2.51.5-3. These count respectively as a Pass or Fail for the event "Cell 1-3". If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 3, the number of failed iterations is increased by one. The SS shall check the MeasurementReport messages transmitted by the UE until a test verdict has been achieved. Each of the events "Cell 3", "Cell 1-3", is evaluated independently for the statistic, resulting in an event verdict: pass or fail. Each event is evaluated only until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in clause G.2 is achieved. Different events may require different times for a verdict. If both events pass for each scenario, the test passes. If one event fails, the test fails.
Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > FS3 Intra frequency absolute and relative RSRQ accuracies with FDD PCell > Test description > Message contents

For the test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each test shall be more than 90\% with a confidence level of 95\%.

Connect the SS (node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors as follows: For UEs supporting only 2Rx in all the bands under test, use 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A, Figure group A.63 as appropriate. Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > RSRP > 4 DL RSRQ for E-UTRAN in Carrier Aggregation with generic duplex modes > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Configure SCells according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for all downlink physical channels. The SS shall configure SCells (Cell 2, Cell 3, and Cell 4) on the SCCs as per 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 5.2A.4. The SS activates SCCs by sending the MAC-CE according to 3GPP TS 36.321 clauses 5.13 and 6.1.3.8. Wait for at least 2 seconds as per 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.3.3.2. Set the parameters according to Table 9.2.56.5-1 as appropriate. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1. The SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message on Cell 1. The UE shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. The UE shall transmit periodically MeasurementReport messages. After 10s wait from Step 6, the SS shall check the reported RSRQ values in periodical MeasurementReport messages. []The reported RSRQ values for Cell 1, Cell 2, Cell 3, and Cell 4 are compared to the actual RSRQ values according to Table 9.2.56.5-2. This counts respectively as a Pass or Fail for the events "Cell 1", "Cell 2", "Cell 3", and "Cell 4". If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 1, Cell 2, Cell 3, or Cell 4, the number of failed iterations for the respective event is increased by one. []The reported RSRQ values for Cell 2, Cell 3 and Cell 4 are compared to the reported RSRQ value for Cell 1 for each MeasurementReport message according to Table 9.2.56.5-3. These count respectively as a Pass or Fail for the events "Cell 1-2", "Cell 1-3", and "Cell 1-4". If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, Cell 3, or Cell 4, the number of failed iterations for the respective event is increased by one. The SS shall check the MeasurementReport messages transmitted by the UE until a test verdict has been achieved. Each of the events "Cell 1", "Cell 2", "Cell 3", "Cell 4", "Cell 1-2", "Cell 1-3", and "Cell 1-4" is evaluated independently for the statistic, resulting in an event verdict: pass or fail. Each event is evaluated only until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in clause G.2 is achieved. Different events may require different times for a verdict. If all events pass for each scenario, the test passes. If one event fails, the test fails.

Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > UTRA FDD CPICH RSCP > E-UTRAN FDD - UTRA FDD CPICH RSCP absolute accuracy > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Set the parameters according to Tables 9.3.1.5-1 and 9.3.1.5-2 for Test 1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1.1. SS shall transmit a RRCConnectionReconfiguration message on Cell 1. The UE shall transmit a RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. UE shall transmit periodically MeasurementReport messages. After 10s wait from Step 3, SS shall check CPICH_RSCP reported values of Cell 2 in periodical MeasurementReport messages according to Table 9.3.1.5-3 as appropriate for Test 1. If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, the number of failed iterations is increased by one. SS shall check the MeasurementReport message transmitted by the UE until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G.2 is achieved. Set the parameters according to Tables 9.3.1.5-1 and 9.3.1.5-2 for Test 2. While RF parameters are being changed any MeasurementReport messages send from the UE shall be ignored by the SS. SS shall wait for an additional 1s and still ignore any MeasurementReport messages send from the UE. Then, step 6 and 7 above are repeated as appropriate for Test 2.

Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and 3GPP TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: 10MHz as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1. Connect the SS (node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A figure A.22 for UE with 2Rx RF band and Annex A, Figure A.86 for 4Rx capable UE without any 2Rx RF bands. The general test parameter settings are set up according to Table 9.5.1.4.1-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 9.5.1.4.3. Cell 1 is the serving E-UTRAN FDD cell and Cell 2 is the target UTRAN TDD cell. Cell 1 is the cell used for connection setup with the power levels set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test.
Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > UTRAN TDD P-CCPCH RSCP > E-UTRAN FDD - UTRA TDD P-CCPCH RSCP absolute accuracy > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Set the parameters according to Table 9.5.1.5-1 as appropriate. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.1.1. SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message on Cell 1. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. UE shall transmit periodically MeasurementReport messages. After 10s wait from Step 3, SS shall check P-CCPCH RSCP reported values of Cell 2 in periodical MeasurementReport messages according to Table 9.5.1.5-3. If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, the number of failed iterations is increased by one. SS shall check the MeasurementReport message transmitted by the UE until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G.2 is achieved. Repeat step 1-7 for each sub-test in Table 9.5.1.5-1 as appropriate.
Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > UTRAN TDD P-CCPCH RSCP > E-UTRAN FDD - UTRA TDD P-CCPCH RSCP absolute accuracy > Test description > Message contents
Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.6 with the following exceptions: 9.5.1.5 Test requirement The test parameters are given in Tables 9.5.1.4.1-1, 9.5.1.5-1 and 9.5.1.5-2 as below. Table 9.5.1.5-2 and 9.5.1.5-3 define the primary level settings including test tolerances for all tests. Each UTRAN TDD P-CCPCH RSCP absolute measurement accuracy test shall meet the reported values test requirements in table 9.5.1.5-3. For the test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each test shall be more than 90\% with a confidence level of 95\%.

Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > GSM carrier RSSI > GSM RSSI accuracy for E-UTRAN FDD > Test purpose
Content: To verify that the GSM RSSI measurement accuracy is within the specified limits.
Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > GSM carrier RSSI > GSM RSSI accuracy for E-UTRAN FDD > Test applicability
Content: This test applies all the types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 9 and forward that support GSM. Applicability requires support for FGI bits 16 and 23.
Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > GSM carrier RSSI > GSM RSSI accuracy for E-UTRAN FDD > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: Absolute accuracy The R.M.S received signal level at the receiver input shall be measured by the MS and the BSS over the full range of 110 dBm to 48 dBm with an absolute accuracy of $ $4 dB from 110 dBm to 70 dBm under normal conditions and $ $6 dB over the full range under both normal and extreme conditions. The R.M.S received signal level at the receiver input shall be measured by the MS above -48 dBm up to -38 dBm with an absolute accuracy of $ $ 9 dB under both normal and extreme conditions. This requirement is summarized in Table 9.6.1.3-1. The reporting range and mapping for RXLEV is summarized in Table 9.6.1.3-2. Relative accuracy The relative accuracy shall be as follows: If signals of level x1 and x2 dBm are received (where x1 $ $ x2) and levels y1 and y2 dBm respectively are measured, if x2 x1 20 dB and x1 is not below the reference sensitivity level, then y1 and y2 shall be such that: (x2 x1) a $ $ y2 y1 $ $ (x2 x1 + b) if the measurements are on the same or on different RF channel within the same frequency band; and (x2 x1 ) c $ $ y2 y1 $ $( x2 x1 + d) if the measurements are on different frequency bands: a, b, c and d are in dB and depend on the value of x1 as follows: For single band MS and measurements between ARFCN in the same band for a multiband MS: s = reference sensitivity level as specified in Table 9.6.1.3-3 (normative reference 3GPP TS 45.005 Table 6.2-1a) For measurements between ARFCN in different bands: s = the reference sensitivity level as specified in Table 9.6.1.3-3 (normative reference 3GPP TS 45.005 Table 6.2-1a) for the band including x1. The normative reference for this requirement is: For E-UTRA: 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.4.1 and A.9.6.1 For GSM: TS 45.008 clause 8.1.2 and 8.1.4 and 3GPP TS 45.005 .
Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > GSM carrier RSSI > GSM RSSI accuracy for E-UTRAN FDD > Test description > Initial conditions
Content: Test Environment: Normal, TL/VL, TH/VH; as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and 3GPP TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: 10 MHz as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.3.1. Connect the SS (node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors as shown in 3GPP TS 36.508 Annex A figure A.14 for UE with 2Rx RF band and Annex A, Figure A.78 (without using the faders) for 4Rx capable UE without any 2Rx RF bands. The general test parameter settings are set up according to Table 9.6.1.4.1-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clause B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 9.6.1.4.3. There is one E-UTRA FDD cell (Cell 1) and two GSM cells (Cell 2 and Cell 3) specified in each test. Cell 1 is the cell used for call setup with the power level set according to Annex C.0 and C.1 for this test. Cell 2 (BCCH1) and Cell 3 (BCCH other than BCCH1 according to sub-test) are measured and reported by the UE.
Title Path: Measurement Performance Requirements > GSM carrier RSSI > GSM RSSI accuracy for E-UTRAN FDD > Test description > Test procedure
Content: Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3. Set the parameters according to Table 9.6.1.5-1, 9.6 1.5-2 and 9.6 1.5-3 as appropriate. Propagation conditions for the E-UTRA cell are set according to Annex B clause B.1. For sub-test 4 and sub-test 12 GERAN cell is initialized to -95dBm. SS shall transmit an RRCConnectionReconfiguration message. The UE shall transmit RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete message. UE shall transmit periodically MeasurementReport messages. Only for sub-tests 4 and 12, SS waits for 10s for initial measurement report by UE and ignores measurement reports received at this stage. If SS receives the measurement reports, then adjust the power levels of Cell 2 according to Table 9.6.1.5-2. SS ignores measurement reports for 1 reportInterval cycle (1024ms) and continues with step 7, else fail the UE for the relevant subtest and skip to Step.9 SS shall check the reported GSM RSSI values in periodical MeasurementReport messages. The reported RSSI value for Cell 2 is compared to the actual RSSI value according to Table 9.6.1.5-4. This counts as a Pass or Fail for the event "Absolute". Also the reported RSSI value for Cell 3 is compared to the reported RSSI value for Cell 2 for each MeasurementReport message according to Table 9.6.1.5-5. This counts as a Pass or Fail for the event "Relative". If the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, the number of failed iterations for the event "Absolute" is increased by one. If the UE fails to report the measurement value for any of Cell 2 or Cell 3, the number of failed iterations for the event "Relative" is increased by one. The SS shall check the periodical MeasurementReport messages transmitted by the UE until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in Annex G.2 is achieved for each of the events "Absolute" and "Relative". Each event is evaluated only until the confidence level is achieved. Different events may require different times for a verdict. Repeat step 1-9 for each sub-test in Table 9.6.1.5-2 as appropriate.

The GSM RSSI measurement accuracy test for the reported values shall meet the requirements in Table 9.6.1.5-4 and Table 9.6.1.5-5. For the test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each sub-test for absolute and relative accuracy shall be more than 90\% with a confidence level of 95\%.

Title Path: Proximity-based Services in Any Cell Selection > E-UTRAN FDD - Initiation/Cease of SLSS Transmission with ProSe Direct Communication > Test purpose
Content: To verify the ProSe UE's ability to initiate and cease SLSS transmissions during cell selection state and if the UE meets the maximum evaluation time.
Title Path: Proximity-based Services in Any Cell Selection > E-UTRAN FDD - Initiation/Cease of SLSS Transmission with ProSe Direct Communication > Test applicability
Content: This test case applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 12 and forward which support ProSe Direct Communication.
Title Path: Proximity-based Services in Any Cell Selection > E-UTRAN FDD - Initiation/Cease of SLSS Transmission with ProSe Direct Communication > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: The SLSS transmission initiation delay is defined as the time from the beginning of time period T2 up to the moment when the UE initiates the SLSS transmission. The SLSS transmission initiation delay shall be less than 0.84 s. The SLSS transmission cease delay is defined as the time from the beginning of time period T3 up to the moment when the UE ceases the SLSS transmission. The SLSS transmission cease delay shall be less than 0.84 s. The rate of correct initiation/cease delay of SLSS transmissions observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\%. NOTE: The initiation/cease delay of SLSS transmissions can be expressed as: T + SLSS period, Where: is the evaluation time for initiate/cease of SLSS, and is 0.8 sec (clause 11.3.2) for the parameters in this test; [SLSS period]is set as 40ms in this test. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 11.3, and A.10.2.
Title Path: Proximity-based Services in Any Cell Selection > E-UTRAN FDD - Initiation/Cease of SLSS Transmission with ProSe Direct Communication > Test description > Initial conditions

Title Path: Proximity-based Services in Any Cell Selection > E-UTRAN FDD - Initiation/Cease of SLSS Transmission with ProSe Direct Communication > Test description > Test procedure
Content: There are no active cells in this test. There is one active SyncRef UE (SyncRef UE 1) in this test. The test system shall emulate SyncRef UE 1 to transmit SLSS and MIB-SL every synchronization period Prior to start of test, test system is required to ensure that the ProSe UE is synchronized to the SyncRef UE 1 and is transmitting SLSS + MIB-SL as derived from the SLSS + MIB-SL of SyncRef. The test consists of three successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2 and T3 respectively. During T1, the S-RSRP of SyncRef UE 1 is above syncTxThreshOOC and the UE is not expected to be transmitting SLSS. During T2, the S-RSRP of SyncRef UE 1 is lowered below syncTxThreshOOC and the UE is expected to initiate SLSS transmissions. During T3, the S-RSRP of SyncRef UE 1 is increased back to be above syncTxThreshOOC and the UE is expected to cease SLSS transmissions. Ensure the UE is in State 4 according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.5.4 and UE test loop Mode E is activated on a EUTRA cell. EUTRA cell is powered down for the remaining duration of the test case. SS would ensure that it enables a SyncRefUE1 at this stage and the ProSe UE under test is synchronized to SyncRefUE1. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 10.2.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.1.1 and B.2.2. T1 starts. During T1, SS checks if the UE is not transmitting SLSS. When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the power setting from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 10.2.5-1. UE is expected to initiate a SLSS transmissions inside 0.84 s from the start of T2. If the UE initiates SLSS transmission consider the loop to be pass, else the loop is considered as fail. After the SS is able to measure the SLSS in step 6) or when T2 expires, the SS shall switch the power setting from T2 to T3 as specified in Table 10.2.5-1 UE is expected to cease SLSS transmission inside 0.84s from the start of T3. If the UE ceases SLSS transmission consider the loop to be pass, else the loop is considered as fail. After the RRC connection release, the SS switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 4 with test loop mode E activated according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.5.4. Repeat step 2-9 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved for both the events.

Title Path: Proximity-based Services in Any Cell Selection > E-UTRAN FDD - Initiation/Cease of SLSS Transmission with ProSe Direct Communication > Test requirement
Content: Tables 10.2.4.1-2 and 10.2.5-1 define the primary level settings including test tolerances for E-UTRAN FDD- Initiation/Cease of SLSS Transmission with ProSe Direct Discovery. The SLSS transmission initiation delay is defined as the time from the beginning of time period T2 up to the moment when the UE initiates the SLSS transmission. The SLSS transmission initiation delay shall be less than 0.84 s. The SLSS transmission cease delay is defined as the time from the beginning of time period T3 up to the moment when the UE ceases the SLSS transmission. The SLSS transmission cease delay shall be less than 0.84 s. The rate of correct initiation/cease delay of SLSS transmissions observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\%. NOTE: The initiation/cease delay of SLSS transmissions can be expressed as: T + SLSS period, Where: is the evaluation time for initiate/cease of SLSS, and is 0.8 sec (clause 11.3.2) for the parameters in this test; [SLSS period]is set as 40ms in this test.

Title Path: Proximity-based Services in Any Cell Selection > E-UTRAN FDD - Initiation/Cease of SLSS Transmission with ProSe Direct Communication > Test description > Test procedure
Content: There is one active cell (Cell 1) and active SyncRef UE (SyncRef UE 1) in this test. The test system shall emulate SyncRef UE 1 to transmit SLSS and MIB-SL every SLSS period (40ms). The test consists of two successive time periods, with time duration of T1 and T2 respectively. During T1, the cell is powered OFF and the ProSe UE is synchronized to SyncRef UE 1. During T2, the cell is powered ON and the ProSe UE will detect the cell and attempt to camp on the cell. Ensure the UE is in State 4 according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.5.4 and UE test loop Mode D is activated. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 10.4.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.1.1 and B.2.2. At the start of T1, cell 1 is powered off and UE is expected to synchronize with SyncRefUE1.Also TE is expected to verify that UE is able to transmit SLSS + MIB-SL before the end of T1. When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the power setting from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 10.4.5-1. UE is expected to initiate PRACH preambles inside 7.68 s from the start of T2. If the UE sends PRACH inside 7.68s consider the loop to be pass, else UE fails the iteration. Set Cell 2 physical cell identity = ((current cell 2 physical cell identity + 1) mod 14 + 2) for next iteration of the test procedure loop. After the RRC connection release, the SS switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 4 with test loop mode 4 activated according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.5.4. Repeat step 2-6 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.

Title Path: V2V Sidelink Communication for V2V Operation on Dedicated V2V Carrier > Initiation/Cease of SLSS Transmission with V2X Sidelink Communication > Initiation/Cease of SLSS Transmission with V2X Sidelink Communication for eNB as Timing Reference > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: The requirements apply when the Serving cell / PCell is used as synchronization reference source and when the UE is - out of coverage on the V2X sidelink carrier and in-coverage with a serving cell on a non-V2X sidelink carrier, and when the conditions for SLSS transmissions specified in are met; networkControlledSyncTx is not configured; and syncTxThreshIC is included in SystemInformationBlockType21. The UE shall be capable of measuring the RSRP of the cell used as synchronization reference source to evaluate to initiate/cease SLSS transmissions within T where, T = 0.4 seconds when UE is not configured with DRX. T = as specified in Table 12.2.1.3-1 when UE is configured with DRX. If higher layer filtering is configured, an additional delay in evaluation to initiate/cease SLSS transmissions can be expected. For the cell as synchronization reference source: RSRP related side conditions given in 3GPP TS 36.133 Clauses 9.1.2.1 and 9.1.2.2 and RSRQ related side conditions given in 3GPP TS 36.133 Clause 9.1.5.1 for a corresponding Band are fulfilled, SCH_RP and SCH \^ E s/Iot according to 3GPP TS 36.133 clause B.2.1 for a corresponding Band are fulfilled. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 13.3.1.1 and A.12.2.1.
Title Path: V2V Sidelink Communication for V2V Operation on Dedicated V2V Carrier > Initiation/Cease of SLSS Transmission with V2X Sidelink Communication > Initiation/Cease of SLSS Transmission with V2X Sidelink Communication for eNB as Timing Reference > Test description > Initial conditions
Content: Test Environment: Normal, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.1. Frequencies to be tested: According to Annex E table E-1 and 3GPP TS 36.508 clauses 4.4.2 and 4.3.1. Channel Bandwidth to be tested: 10MHz for E-UTRA Cell, largest supported V2X channel bandwidth. Connect the SS (node B and SS-V2X-UE emulator) and AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors using TS 36.508 Annex A, Figure A.93a as appropriate. The E-UTRA Cell 1 is powered OFF. Ensure the UE is in State5A-V2X in Transmit Mode according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.5.9. Turn on the Cell 1. The general test parameter settings are set up according to Table 12.2.1.4.1-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.0. Message contents are defined in clause 12.2.1.4.3. Cell1 is serving Cell on the E-UTRA RF channel 1, and is used for connection setup with the power levels set according to Annex C.0 and C.1. Ensure the UE is in State 3A-RF-V2X on the E-UTRA RF channel 1 according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3C.
Title Path: V2V Sidelink Communication for V2V Operation on Dedicated V2V Carrier > Initiation/Cease of SLSS Transmission with V2X Sidelink Communication > Initiation/Cease of SLSS Transmission with V2X Sidelink Communication for eNB as Timing Reference > Test description > Test procedure
Content: The test consists of three successive time periods, with duration of T1, T2 and T3, respectively. There are two carriers, E-UTRA RF channel 1 is used for E-UTRA Cell 1, and E-UTRA RF channel 2 is used for V2X communication. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 12.2.1.5-1. Propagation conditions are set according to Annex B clauses B.1.1 and B.2.2. T1 starts. When T1 expires, set the parameters according to T2 in Table 12.2.1.5-1. T2 starts. If the SLSS transmission is received by the SS with an overall delay measured from the beginning of time period T2 less than 0.56s, the number of success for the event "Initiation" is increased by one. Otherwise, count a fail for the event "Initiation" and go to step 6. When T2 expires, set the parameters according to T3 in Table 12.2.1.5-1. T3 starts. If the last SLSS transmission is received by the SS with an overall delay measured from the beginning of time period T3 less than 0.56s, the number of success for the event "Cease" is increased by one. Otherwise, count a fail for the event "Cease". When T3 expires, or a fail was counted for the event "Initiation" in step 3, the SS shall transmit a RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources. Set Cell 1 physical cell identity = ((current cell 1 physical cell identity + 1) mod 14 + 2) for next iteration of the test procedure loop. After the RRC connection release, the SS: transmits in Cell 1 a Paging message (including PagingRecord with UE-Identity) for the UE and ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF-V2X according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3C; or switches off and on the UE and ensures the UE is in State 5A-V2X in Transmit Mode according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.5.9, then in State 3A-RF-V2X according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 7.2A.3C. Repeat steps 1-8 until a test verdict has been achieved. Each of the events "Initiation" and "Cease" is evaluated independently for the statistic, resulting in an event verdict: pass or fail. Each event is evaluated only until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in Annex G.2 is achieved. Different events may require different times for a verdict. If all events pass, the test passes. If one event fails, the test fails.
Title Path: V2V Sidelink Communication for V2V Operation on Dedicated V2V Carrier > Initiation/Cease of SLSS Transmission with V2X Sidelink Communication > Initiation/Cease of SLSS Transmission with V2X Sidelink Communication for eNB as Timing Reference > Test description > Message contents
Content: Message contents are according to 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.6 with the following exceptions: 12.2.1.5 Test requirement Table 12.2.1.5-1 defines the primary level settings including test tolerances for Initiation/Cease of SLSS Transmissions Test for eNB as Timing Reference. The SLSS transmission initiation delay is defined as the time from the beginning of time period T2 up to the moment when the UE initiates the SLSS transmission. The SLSS transmission initiation delay shall be less than 0.56 s. The SLSS transmission cease delay is defined as the time from the beginning of time period T3 up to the moment when the UE ceases the SLSS transmission. The SLSS transmission cease delay shall be less than 0.56 s. The rate of correct initiation/cease delay of SLSS transmissions observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90\%. NOTE: The initiation/cease delay of SLSS transmissions can be expressed as: T + SLSS period, Where: is the evaluation time for initiate/cease of SLSS, and is 0.4 sec (clause 13.3.1.1) for the parameters in this test; [SLSS period]is set as 160ms in this test. All of the above test requirements shall be fulfilled in order for the of SLSS transmission initiation and cease delay to be counted as correct. The rate of correct observed SLSS transmission initiation and SLSS transmission cease delay during repeated tests shall be at least 90\% with a confidence level of 95\% for each of the events. The statistical pass/ fail decisions are done separately for initiation and cease. Decide the test pass, if initiation and cease are passed, otherwise fail the UE.

Content: To verify the requirements related to the evaluation time allowed to initiate and cease SLSS transmissions defined in clause 13.3.1.3, when SyncRef UE is used as timing reference.

Content: This test applies to all types of UE that support V2X Communication and Band 47 and SLSS transmission.
Title Path: V2V Sidelink Communication for V2V Operation on Dedicated V2V Carrier > Initiation/Cease of SLSS Transmission with V2X Sidelink Communication > Initiation/Cease of SLSS Transmission with V2X Sidelink Communication for SyncRef UE as Timing Reference > Minimum conformance requirements
Content: The requirements apply when SyncRef UE is used as synchronization reference source and when the UE is in any cell selection state, or out of coverage on the V2X sidelink carrier and is associated with a serving cell on a non-V2X sidelink carrier, and when the conditions for SLSS transmissions specified in are met and when SyncRef UE is used as synchronization reference source and if syncTxThreshOoC is included in the preconfigured V2X parameters. The UE shall be capable of measuring the S-RSRP of the selected SyncRef UE used as synchronization reference source and evaluate it to initiate/cease SLSS transmissions within T = 0.64 seconds. If higher layer filtering for S-RSRP measurements is pre-configured, an additional delay in evaluation to initiate/cease SLSS transmissions can be expected. For the selected SyncRef UE used to derive transmission timing for V2X sidelink communication: S-RSRP related side conditions given in 3GPP TS 36.133 Clause 13.4 for a corresponding Band are fulfilled, V2X SCH_RP and SCH \^ E s/Iot according to 3GPP TS 36.133 Annex B.6.4 for a corresponding Band are fulfilled. The normative reference for this requirement is 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 13.3.1.3 and A.12.2.2.
